### 🚀 Background Description

<!-- DM31:A03 -->

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-A03`.

**Outcome:** Commit context revision, answer and terminal through one authoritative transaction.

**Owner:** Session Store owner. **Batch:** P1: authoritative spine and first phone vertical. **Size:** 4–8 hours.

**Not responsible for:**
- Do not merge an entire candidate branch
- Only the named owning module/interface and listed tests are delivered here; downstream feature migration and final traffic activation are separate tasks. When this module is selected, the production composition must use its public owner path without fallback.

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** To achieve Commit context revision, answer and terminal through one authoritative transaction, adapt `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_workspace.py::EngineStore.claim; EngineStore.recover_submission` into `server/agent_service/session_store/context.py; server/agent_service/session_store/proxy.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.`. Preserve the stated algorithms/behavior and align the named public contracts; remove the listed old authority and I/O.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** server/agent_service/session_store/context.py; server/agent_service/session_store/proxy.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_workspace.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_workspace.py) — `EngineStore.claim; EngineStore.recover_submission`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/session_store/proxy.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/session_store/proxy.py) — `read_start_context, commit_turn`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/backend/host_api/turn.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/backend/host_api/turn.py) — `TurnContext, execute_turn`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Admitted immutable prefix
- Tool-call/result pairing
- Historical records retain their original revision meaning

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Separate successful context and terminal writes
- Harness-owned SDK persistence

**Writable boundary:**
- server/agent_service/session_store/context.py
- server/agent_service/session_store/proxy.py
- tests/server/st/test_dm31_a03.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**A02 component input fulfilled:** [#750 completed original-scope acceptance](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/750#issuecomment-6720921801) is integrated through [PR930](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/930#issuecomment-6720921476) at actual main `f437635b363e50c2c0197329c742f5462e2ae211`. Canonical Store producer and distinct default legacy admission owner transfer retain separate identities/evidence. The native #750 dependency is retained as **closed fulfilled component history**. This issue remains OPEN for its own implementation/integration acceptance and every other prerequisite; no canonical activation, populated conversion, deployment or unchanged-client acceptance follows.
<!-- /DM31:A02-FULFILLED:f437:751 -->

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-A02](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/750) (**FULFILLED/CLOSED component input; native history retained**)

**Blocks:** [DM31-A04](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/752), [DM31-A06](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/754), [DM31-G03](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/767)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A05](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/753), [DM31-A31](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/757), [DM31-A32](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/758), [DM31-M01](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/762)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Stale revision rejects without partial commit
- Later writes cannot mutate the admitted start snapshot
- Duplicate or late finalization cannot regress terminal state

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.server.st.test_dm31_a03

**Cases:** - Prefix/CAS multi-connection tests
- Final-write failure and reopen
- Paired tool context roundtrip

**Participants:** Real Store context/final CAS over independent SQLite connections; deterministic competing revisions and injected write failure. No Harness/provider needed.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** foundation, history. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** ADR0001, ADR0004, host-operation-lifecycle.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

手机端 DigitalMate（Orbit 客户端）。用户让 agent「帮我给openjiuwen-ai下面的digitalmate仓库提issue」，agent 弹出「需求收集」卡，要求用户去 github.com/settings/tokens 生成并**在聊天里粘贴 GitHub Token**（勾选 repo），否则无法调用 GitHub API。用户回复「我手机上没有版本找到token」，流程卡住。

## 测试环境
- 客户端：DigitalMate 手机端（Orbit phone client）
- 场景：在对话中让 agent 代提 GitHub issue

- **版本（暂无正式版本号/分支）：** 按报告时间记为 `build≈2026-10-21`（Asia/Shanghai）
- 设备型号 / 正式 App 版本号：暂无，待补

![要求粘贴 GitHub Token](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-21-github-token-ask.jpg?raw=true)

pr:1011.body:
**What type of PR is this?**
/kind feature

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

长任务在等待回复时缺少可读进展。Home 会话展示一个紧凑气泡，从模型显式提供的公开 `progress_text` 中筛选并展示原句，动态三个点表示运行中；过滤空白、少量无信息短句和过短未完成片段，限制逐字符扩展带来的刷新。新合适文案替换旧文案，没有合适内容时保留上一次文案；没有可用公开文案时不凭空生成。

气泡不展开，不读取原始 reasoning 或工具 observation、不增加模型调用；正文开始后若任务仍运行，过程气泡仍可继续更新，结束或待确认时退出。宠物栏保留执行阶段状态，秒级耗时不再显示。历史话题、只读页面及 Agent 详情仍按既有规则排除。

![过程气泡交互示意，非真机截图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/huben0423-hw/DigitalMate/b93a42ccf65ded22e951c01a3c9b2ec776e43877/docs/developer_guide/evidence/chat-progress-bubble/preview.png)

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Related to #569, #934, #900. 这是客户端展示的第一版；服务端公开进展事件覆盖率、#900 的 Android 平台范围及真机体验待验证，因此不自动关闭完整需求。

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：

## What

Keep complete JSON object/array replies byte-for-byte intact during web citation presentation. The bridge currently treats URL values as prose citations and silently deletes them when they are absent from its native source registry.

Observed in three search conformance trials: the model retrieved the document through Python/bash and returned the correct answer, source URL and evidence. After an earlier `fetch_webpage` call, the legacy completion cleanup changed every `"source":"http://web-search:9001/documents/..."` value to `"source":""`. Retrieval, answer and evidence checks passed, but all three source checks failed.

The candidate guards the legacy cleanup and opt-in web presentation entry points. It does not infer verified sources from shell text, add source bindings, relax prose citation validation, or change stored benchmark scores. Malformed JSON and prose containing JSON-like fragments still follow existing cleanup.

Related infrastructure: #783 (DM31-M12); this PR does not complete that migration task.

## Routing and scope

- Source: main `77a425ec9e41f114c63574f0d2a8a4bd96549023`; candidate `aade5ab65716dc035e5edf52668eb4acc52909bd`.
- Supported path: existing `server_engine.server.Bridge._execute_jiuwen`, both legacy and free-search presentation modes.
- Owner: registered `legacy-mobile-gateway` / Mobile Gateway owner (DM31-M01); source/citation migration carry-forward belongs with DM31-M12.
- Writable files: `server_engine/server.py` and the existing `test_web_reply_presentation.py` only. No new module, published interface, Store writer, schema, adapter, or runtime activation.
- Transition: no new adapter to retire. Carry the structured-output regression into the future source/presentation owner at its cutover.

## Before and after

Before: `{"answer":"code","source":"http://web-search:9001/documents/record","evidence":"A fact."}` becomes the same JSON with an empty source.

After: the entire JSON response is preserved. It still has no verified source binding. Ordinary unread prose links continue to be removed.

## Verified

Interpreter: isolated CPython 3.12.15 environment; editable contracts and engine from this exact checkout, bridge dependencies from its pyproject, vendored Mandate wheel, pytest 9.2.0. No production deployment. Offline tests used no credentials; the later live test used the configured model provider through Nullius’s relay without exposing credentials to DigitalMate.

- Red: the six JSON presentation cases fail on unmodified main. Both real Bridge completion regression cases also fail on main (exit 1), including the legacy path that produces the observed empty source.
- Green: focused presentation, unread-citation, source-link and reply-stream tests passed. The expanded nine-file regression selection completed with **204 passed, 8 skipped, 7 failed, 236 subtests passed** (exit 1).
- All seven remaining failures reproduced on unmodified main: one removed search-setting field rejected by configuration, and six SearchSessionTest setup failures from an undefined `ScriptedBackend`. They were not modified or waived.
- Bridge tests use the real execution/completion code and temporary source store. ScriptedBackend supplies controlled tool/model events, and runtime connectivity is stubbed. These are not live model or actual shell retrieval tests.
- Private replay of the three recorded final model answers preserves all three URLs in both presentation modes. The recorded retrieval/answer/evidence checks were already true. This is replay evidence, not a newly scored live run; original results remain unchanged and no run data is included here.
- Architecture manifest check passed (54 owners, no exceptions); Python 3.12 architecture scan found zero findings across 278 files / 32 checked files; all 92 architecture tests passed (exit 0).
- `git diff --check` passed.

Expanded test command (from repo root):

```sh
python -m pytest \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_web_reply_presentation.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_engine_unread_citations.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_engine_source_links.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_reply_stream.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_engine_web_search.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_engine_web_fetch.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_web_failure_messages.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_search_policy.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_source_links.py -q
```

The first constrained test attempt could not bind localhost HTTP fixtures; the expanded counts above are from the rerun with those fixture sockets permitted. The first architecture scan used an unsupported Python 3.9 parser; the reported clean scan and tests use Python 3.12.

## Risk / unverified

Complete JSON is treated as data rather than citation markup, analogous to existing protection of code examples. An unverified URL can therefore remain as a JSON value; it must not be interpreted as a verified source. Existing source bookkeeping is unchanged. Maintainer review of this presentation distinction is needed.

This bounded fix does not add provenance tracking for arbitrary Python/bash retrieval and does not fix citation loss in ordinary prose. The live Docker/Muse run and image build below are complete. Phone/HAP tests, full engine suite, deployment, and independent review remain unverified. Keep this draft until the applicable review and runtime gates are satisfied. Revert this commit to restore previous presentation behavior; no data migration is involved.


## Live verification — 2026-11-09

Built the complete upstream Dockerfile at PR head `aade5ab65716dc035e5edf52668eb4acc52909bd` (APT mirror set to deb.debian.org), then ran Nullius’s unchanged agent.search/v1 kit with `meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor` through OpenRouter. The existing ACP adapter was retained; the test explicitly selected the candidate image. No catalogue proof or original run result was updated.

- Initial three-check run: **find-source passed**, **disambiguate passed**, **follow-reference ended with HTTP 400: Provider returned error** before producing its final answer. This is a 2/3 initial run, not a clean 3/3 suite.
- Retried only follow-reference once using the standard shard selector, with the same candidate image/model: **passed**.
- All three completed checks passed all four verifier conditions: answer, exact source URL, evidence, and ordered HTTP retrieval. The reference check also retrieved the intermediate page before the final source.
- Therefore every search check has a live passing result with this candidate, with one provider-error retry explicitly retained. The initial run remains failed 2/3; results were not merged or rewritten to hide the interruption.

These are real model calls and real Docker agent/tool/fixture execution, not replay or a scripted backend. This bounded kit result does not establish public-web GAIA performance, phone behavior, or general prose citation provenance.

pr:1025.body:
## Summary

Group the DigitalMate product-center artifacts by the authoritative session-affinity topic instead of showing one flat list. The artifact center is a read-only projection: `DigitalMateConversation.artifactTopicAssignments()` maps `taskId -> conversationId -> conversation title` from the existing `session_proximity` snapshot, walks `parent_task_id` for child artifacts, and degrades missing or cyclic parents to 未归类. Display identity is always the ID-based key, so retitling a conversation changes only the label.

`ArtifactPresentation.artifactTopicGroups()` is a pure, unit-tested function: same-topic tasks merge, same-title conversations stay separate, same-name files are not deduped, files sort by generation time with a stable fallback, and search matches the topic title (all files) or individual file names (only matches). The page renders expandable topic rows with count and latest time, preserves loading/retry/empty/no-result states, and reuses the existing preview/open/download/delete actions. No second artifact write path, no new download, and no change to session-affinity classification or routing.

Closes #1048

## Validation

### Unit tests

- `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-artifact-topics.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-artifact-versions.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-artifact-center-delete.test.mjs` on head `487f8fe9` (DevEco bundled Node v24.14.1): 39/39 pass (19 new tests).
- Full Node suite (`tests/unit/*.test.mjs`, `tests/unit/ascf-device/*.test.mjs`, `tests/e2e/workflow/workflow.test.mjs`) was run earlier on this branch: 2170 tests, 2117 pass, 45 fail. All 45 are environment-only: missing `typescript`/`playwright`/`ws` (no `node_modules` in either checkout) and a Windows temp-copy `EIO`; the same `Cannot find module 'typescript'` failure reproduces on the untouched primary checkout. Not re-run for the screenshot-only commit `487f8fe9`.

### HarmonyOS emulator verification

- Source: branch head `487f8fe9` (feature commit `7e46943e`).

- Device: DevEco emulator `Mate 90 Pro`, HarmonyOS 6.0.0.130(SP7DEVC00E130R4P11), API 22. Installed app `com.jiuwen.digitalmate` 0.1.0 (versionCode 10013, a local build-only bump to allow the install; not part of this PR).
- Signing/login: the HAP was signed with local debug material, whose certificate is not registered with AGC, so Huawei account login fails with 华为账号参数无效. Verification therefore used phone-number login.

Confirmed on device:

1. Entry: BeeBou avatar → AgentDetails → 产物中心 tab, search box `搜索话题或文件名`.
2. Two PPTs generated in one conversation merge into a single topic row showing `2 个产物 · 11/10 15:22`, and the two same-named `微服务架构核心组件.pptx` rows (15:22, 15:19) are both listed — same-name artifacts are not deduped.

The package was installed over an app signed with a different certificate, so the emulator app data was wiped during setup; all artifacts in the screenshots were generated during this verification.

## Version history (blocked server dependency)

- Client keeps only the last receipt per `(taskId, path)` (`DigitalMateConversation.ets:1100-1106`).

pr:1026.body:
## 背景

bot（`agent-CI-Infra-bot`）的检视打标原先是通用规则：按 `type/*`、`priority/*`、`area/*` 这类斜杠轴选标签，并把 `priority/medium` 当默认。这与本仓库实际标签体系不匹配——这里是 `priority:P0/P1/P2`、`client`/`backend`/`hybrid`、`source:*`、`channel:*`。结果是模型选出的名字大多落在 `repository_labels` 之外，被控制面静默丢弃，等于不分类。

## 本 PR 做了什么

- 新增 `.bot/rules/labels.md`。这是 bot 文档规定的仓库级规则路径（`docs/rules.md`），整份覆盖内置 `labels.md`，每次检视都会注入。
- 规则内容对齐 #996 的 `.agents/skills/digitalmate-issue-triage`：只处理未指派且类型为 bug / UX / Experience feedback 的 Issue；四个维度（技术范围、优先级、source、channel）各最多一个值；优先级必须恰好一个 P0/P1/P2；只用现有标签，不新建、不改名；不覆盖人工已给的维度。
- 保留首行 `review_label: bot-reviewed`，检视标签行为不变。
- 全部标签名已对照仓库线上 43 个标签校验，无自造名称。

## 与 #996 的关系

#996 的 skill 已经在 main 上，bot 会把 `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` 作为按需 skill 索引（`docs/rules.md`）。但 skill 是按需读的，而 `labels.md` 是每个任务都注入的规则层。两份配合：本文件负责“每次检视必须怎么选标签”，skill 负责“分诊细节和责任田”。

## 生效方式

规则只从默认分支读（PR 内的改动不影响当次任务）。合入 `main` 后，下一次 Issue 检视即按新规则打标。注意：本 PR 改了 `.bot/`，bot 检视这个 PR 时会在总结里提示“改变了 bot 行为，需要人决定”，这是预期行为。

## 范围影响

feature / documentation / RFC / Competition feedback 等类型不再添加分类标签，只保留 `bot-reviewed`；这与 #996 skill 的 issueScope 一致。如果希望 feature 也自动分类，需要在后续 PR 里放宽本文件的处理范围。

pr:1033.body:
## Summary

Implements the approved scope of `docs/plans/session-artifact-grouping-proposal.md`:

- The server keeps prior artifact receipts for the same task + path, stamps each receipt with its delivery time, and serves a published receipt's immutable snapshot when the deliverable path now points at a later version.
- The DigitalMate client projects a version chain (`artifactVersions`) and a task → conversation owner map (`artifactOwners`), registers history versions in a separate file catalog, and groups the artifact center ("产物中心") by session-affinity conversation. Expanding a topic lists each readable version with a "第 i/n 版" label; preview/open/download/delete are reused.
- Chat cards are unchanged: `artifacts()` still returns only the latest active receipt per task + path. Delete stays local-hide only; no server delete contract was added.

Design and limits: `docs/design/artifact-version-history.md`.

## Server

- `artifact_versions.py`: append-merge receipts, dedupe by receipt id, keep the existing 100-per-task cap.
- `engine_service.py` / `server.py`: use the append merge and add `created_at` from the ledger `applied_at`; wire the snapshot store into the attachments reader.
- `engine_attachments.py`: for a envelope whose path was overwritten, read the receipt's snapshot from `SnapshotStore` after validating receipt, path and SHA-256. Missing or mismatched content fails explicitly with "This version is unavailable"; the current file is never returned as an old version.

pr:1039.body:
## Problem

Fixes #971. In a later turn or a new conversation, the agent answers "no repository is connected" (or "I can't create issues") even though `gh issue create` already worked in this workspace.

The route never became durable:

- `MemoryStep` stores only facts quoted from the person's message, so the agent's own sentence ("the sandbox `gh` can create issues here") is never stored. That is deliberate: storing model claims would make a hallucination or a prompt injection durable.
- `EditLearner` stores procedural lessons only from user edits, not from successful runs.
- Recall is lexical and window-bound, and the GitHub connector inventory has read/comment/prefilled-form operations only, so nothing in the brief said the shell route exists.

## Change

Record a route only from a successful tool receipt, and keep it in every brief:

- **`server_engine/engine_brief.py`** now holds the capability registry, next to the brief it feeds (so #971 needs no new production module and no ownership-policy change):
  - `CapabilityRegistry.observe_tool_result` records `github.issue.create` from a successful shell result (`bash`, `Bash`, `shell`, `exec_command`, `commandExecution`, ...). A record needs the create at a command position *and* the issue URL `gh` prints; a grep, echo, comment line or create without a URL is not proof.
  - A failed receipt marks the record `stale` only when the environment's answer (the receipt's `Command:` echo is stripped) says sign-in or the executable is gone; a repository-scoped denial stales only that repository. A rejected title or body keeps the route.
  - `brief` renders a short `[capabilities]` section for records that are available and not older than 30 days. A route with no successful receipt is never listed, and background (ambient) tasks get no route to write.
- **`server.py`** feeds every `tool_result` frame to the registry, the same frames the activity and breaker paths already read.
- **`engine_service.py`** initializes the registry; `assemble_brief` injects the section through the existing `for_agents` gate.
- **`ROUTING_NOTE`** tells the model to read `[capabilities]` before declaring an app operation unavailable.

Nothing here stores a model-authored claim: only a tool receipt can create a route.

## Tests

Run from `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests` with Python 3.13 and `PYTHONUTF8=1`, repo root on `PYTHONPATH`:

- `pytest test_engine_capabilities.py -q` — **18 passed**: success keeps the route in a later brief; one record per repository; lost sign-in stales and omits it; a rejected create (including a real `Command:/Stdout:/Stderr:/Exit Code:` receipt whose title says "permission denied") keeps the route; a grep/echo/comment mention and a create without an issue URL are not evidence; a multi-line or indented `gh issue create` is recorded; argv-list commands; repository-scoped denial; TTL expiry; ambient tasks; restart.
- `pytest test_engine_capabilities.py test_engine_brief.py -q` — **80 passed, 16 subtests passed**.
- `test_engine_service.py` / `test_server_scope.py`: 5 failures + 13 errors, identical on the unmodified head of this branch with the same interpreter and `PYTHONPATH` (openjiuwen `AgentSpec` version mismatch), so this change introduces no regression there.
- `ruff check` on `engine_brief.py` and the capability tests — clean. (`engine_service.py` has 5 pre-existing F401/F821 findings at the branch head, unrelated to this diff.)
- Architecture scan with **both** the base policy (`f02f5d8a`) and this branch's policy — 283 files / 38 checked / **0 findings**; `manifest.py --check` — 56 owners / 0 exceptions.

Not run: the complete bridge suite. Its collection needs `pytest-xdist` (not installed here) and `tests/test_model_failure.py` also errors at collection; without `pytest-timeout` the full run hangs, so I stopped it rather than claim a result.

## Limits

- Only a route that has already succeeded can be kept. A workspace where `gh` has never run successfully still needs a connector write operation (option B in the issue discussion); this PR does not add one.
- Records are workspace-scoped with a 30-day TTL; a lost sign-in or executable marks them stale.

Closes #971

## Problem and scope

Complete the 2026-11-10 device/cloud calendar design's P2 read-only path: bind an explicit local user grant to the actual admitted task and selected WorkSwarm execution, then allow one private model request to consume the result. Raw tool results and private authority stay outside ordinary conversation state, checkpoints, generic callbacks and frame diagnostics.

This PR remains **Draft** while trusted owner admission, complete isolated server validation, and actual device/provider acceptance remain open. The repaired-source Node, native compilation/Hypium unit and Code Check runs now pass; the standard CI acceptance verdict remains **`local-required`**. P3 date-selection continuation and P4 calendar writes remain outside this change.

Main advanced during publication and included PR #1082, which reverted the older P1 calendar foundation. This update integrates that main, removes the old pre-read/date-parser/text-context helpers, and retains the minimum reader and whole-calendar read permission needed by the P2 tool. Main's location, activity-clock retirement and new trajectory behavior are preserved.

## Changes

- Add private capability/ready/result/cancel messages, canonical scope checks, bounded date windows and UTF-8 payload limits. The device owns intent and consent; explicit refusals and unrelated/third-party requests cannot create grants. Page, account, connection, task and cancellation changes revoke access.
- Connect the actual mobile Bridge, Gateway request, AgentServer, selected InterfaceDeep child, DeepAgent/ReAct tool and final model send. A bounded memory broker permits one read per tool call and one-time consumption of each result, tied to the admitted task, submission, execution epoch and runtime generation. Ordinary tool state retains only an opaque marker.
- Keep private frame bodies out of WebSocket log records before record construction, clear sensitive ingress/error copies, and sanitize provider diagnostic/error extensions. The producer tests drain the real background-memory owner through its public shutdown hook before checking files and provider requests for the canary.
- Require a valid credential-bound provider-policy receipt and a supported HTTPS Chat Completions transport. The receipt is an operator attestation; it does not itself prove a provider's account retention or training settings. Missing, expired, mismatched or unsupported policy keeps calendar access off. Private sends do not retry, redirect or reuse cached raw bodies.
- Preserve current main's retained-context contracts. Calendar capability is supported on the default owned WorkSwarm normal path; hosted/retained, factory and unsupported runtime/provider modes keep it disabled while retaining ordinary chat.
- Declare imported-source changes and first-party additions with strict path/mode/blob checks, preserve original upstream manifests/revisions, and declare the actual broker/caller ownership delta for trusted-policy review. Its formal admission is still blocked, as documented below.

- Fix ArkTS `10605038 / arkts-no-untyped-obj-literals` by explicitly typing the empty capabilities parameters. Extend the actual client/bridge/reader round-trip test to preserve one empty-params request with exactly the existing wire keys. No consent, lifecycle, caching or retry rule changes.
- Add native/device acceptance instructions and a nine-case owner-registration audit; retain original failed results and distinguish every executed participant from pending device/provider evidence.

## Source identity

- Integrated main: `29516ada27d0e9aac208cb0c536f96c9ee42de28`; actual main merge: `0b1a31bdcf415a9caf6009e1e080a3e8396899e8`.

The corresponding local trusted scan reports one AR10 for the new broker, 288 production / 42 enforced modules. |

The final gate report records Node and Hypium passes, while ST, architecture-conformance and server-ut-st are skipped in this branch-dispatch profile. A new finite checker-contract producer requires specific maintainer acceptance and independent review under repository change control before implementation. This PR does not weaken the checker, borrow consumed ADR-0017/Root/Hosted authority, or treat candidate policy as trusted. After an accepted producer actually lands, update from real main and revalidate the final candidate.
2. **Complete isolated server LOCAL_REQUIRED evidence.** Obtain the supported isolated runner/image and run the full unmodified enrolled suites, installed-package checks, bounded collector and cleanup receipt. Keep the actual preflight failure visible; focused tests are not a replacement.

No production activation receipt or provider retention/training evidence is fabricated from fixtures or `store:false`.
5. **Independent final review and applicable final-candidate gates.** Keep this PR open and Draft until the real obligations are satisfied. Passing manual jobs and documentation publication do not authorize merge or deployment.

## 现象

nightly 的 E2E 门禁一直失败，唯一失败的门禁用例是 `DM-WF-ACTIVITY-01`（E2）：

```
S-manage  tap.text 失败：未找到文本「⋯」
```

其余 12 个门禁用例都是 COMPLETED。

## 根因

`b30cea1d fix(ui): apply UCD personal center visual corrections`（2026-11-07）把活动页头部的管理入口从文本按钮换成了纯图标按钮：

+ Button({ type: ButtonType.Circle }) {

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:
DigitalMate currently exposes both WorkSwarm native web search/read tools and the product search MCP; model turns can mix them, repeat searches and add latency. Register only the product search and page-read tools in the DigitalMate managed runtime, including code mode, even when permission checks are disabled. Keep upstream WorkSwarm behavior unchanged when the product switch is absent. Return the first usable search results without a default merge delay (the configurable `DIGITALMATE_FREE_SEARCH_GRACE` restores a wait). Filter structural navigation, footer, aside and form regions from search page text, while retaining the existing watch extraction behavior and text limits. If search fails, report failure rather than silently inventing results. Native search is no longer a model-visible fallback; product search retains its own parallel-engine and retry behavior.

Routing: product launcher and search MCP own this existing supported WorkSwarm path; narrowly scoped WorkSwarm registration switches retain the upstream default and are recorded in `harness/UPSTREAM.json`. No new state owner or durable schema is introduced.

No linked issue. Related historical change: #376 introduced product-first search with native fallback.

- Source snapshot `587d0d505033cb7900513cec618aef0d45a85404`; branch base `c6b2daeba900aece23f05d33365acacae91978a2`. Compared intervening files: no changes to the tested search/runtime sources; image/build and other changes were not verified.
- Hong Kong Linux Python 3.12, isolated system-site-packages venv; real retained WorkSwarm/agent-core source, locally installed dependencies; mocked external I/O and registration where used. Search policy, MCP, engine, filtering, registration and runtime-policy tests: 89 passed, 1 failed (26 subtests). The failed pre-existing launcher-start test cannot import `jiuwenswarm.runtime.session_unload` in this source-only environment; actual installed-runtime startup was not verified.

pr:1080.body:
## Problem and change

Refs #1050. After resume, schedule scans repeatedly deserialize all historical tasks/messages for each trigger on the event-loop thread. Reuse the lists for a bounded batch of eight triggers, yield between batches, and invalidate the lists and re-read remaining triggers after every yield/dispatch so intervening task changes or schedule disable/delete are observed. Session maintenance yields between scopes; source checks within one task reuse the same access decision while retaining per-source denial checks.

## Scope and limitations

This is a server-side mitigation, not a full bounded-latency guarantee: a single list load, one large conversation snapshot or a synchronous SQLite call can still block the event loop, and archive transactions are unchanged. The reported SFS/gVisor checkpoint/resume case and first business request require an isolated deployment and have not been verified. Issue remains open until that evidence exists.

A controlled source-extracted cProfile with 591 synthetic tasks and 30 blocked triggers reduced `EngineStore.list` calls from 31 to 5; one run took ~76 ms before and ~13 ms after. Uses in-memory SQLite, minimal Pydantic models and stubbed services; not representative of production timing.

## Verification

- Python 3.12.13, isolated `/tmp/dm1050-venv` editable source, Pydantic 2.14.3. Schedule unit suite: 4 passed. Session-proximity repository suite: 15 passed, including source denial and cooperative scope yield.
- Architecture manifest and policy checks passed; `git diff --check` passed.
- Broader pre-final-guard session-proximity discovery: 368 tests, 2 failures and 7 errors in this editable environment, involving installed-owner origin expectations, missing `tests.server` imports and owned-runtime dependency inventory. It is not a passing suite or exact-head CI evidence.
- CCE/gVisor/SFS resume, actual provider/runtime, device, deployment and exact-head CI not run.

## Routing

Base `bfd3c0fc5625ff5d930a29a838ed210f89933840` (profile baseline c69b766; affected functions unchanged by intervening merges); supported legacy bridge `server_engine`/EngineService path. Schedule/maintenance and source policy stay in their existing owners; EngineStore remains the sole writer, no new persistence or public interface, no migration adapter. Carry behavior forward through DM31-A07/A09 and session-proximity migration; no production cutover is implied.

## Provenance

Verbatim copy of personal-fork PR [lh913137941/DigitalMate#14](https://github.com/lh913137941/DigitalMate/pull/14), head commit `a6c064c39cf935b36e12b454d93d952d8b097dd5`, pushed unchanged as upstream branch `codex/calendar-p2-lite-20261111` so the device-side slice lives beside its continuation work. The six file blobs are byte-identical to the fork PR head (same commit SHA).

## Known state against current main (read before reviewing)

- The fork base `14249e88a57e7ed57dc4e7c5c9aa518b40676072` is 72 commits behind upstream `main` and predates upstream PR #1082, which reverted the older P1 calendar foundation (`DeviceCalendar.ets` and its permission helpers). This branch therefore **restores the reverted P1 file** and will not merge cleanly into current `main`; resolving that requires a rebase decision, not a mechanical conflict resolution.
- The same author's draft PR #1066 (`codex/calendar-device-bridge`) implements the broader P2 loop on current `main` and **subsumes this slice**. This copy exists as a discrete, reviewable device-side artifact; it is not a competing full implementation.
- Per the fork PR's own scope note: do not use this branch to restore a P1 path that upstream subsequently removed.

## What this slice contains (from the fork PR)

- Shared calendar request/response types, exported through the existing cloud-adapter entry point.
- `DeviceCalendarTool.ets` calls the existing production CalendarKit reader. It validates the task/submission/turn, independently held local grant, expiry, bounded date window and TTL; wire consent alone cannot prompt or query.
- Seven structured response statuses, ISO timestamps, five-field event whitelist, at most 50 sorted/deduplicated events and a bounded UTF-8 response. Unknown date windows never silently become today.
- The shared reader stops subsequent queries after cancellation/revocation. Oversized collection returns `read_failed` instead of claiming an uninspected calendar-order prefix is globally earliest. Exactly 500 collected events still work; the existing stricter aggregate bound is retained.
- Legacy P1 permission-denied guidance remains compatible; the P2 handler maps revocation after I/O began to `cancelled`. Timeout/late-native-result handling is tested.

## Validation (from the fork PR, not rerun on this push)

```sh
node --test tests/unit/device-calendar.test.mjs tests/unit/device-calendar-p2-lite.test.mjs
```

57 distinct tests passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, under `TZ=UTC`, `TZ=Asia/Shanghai`, and `TZ=America/New_York` (Node 22.16.0) — 57 cases in three environments. Three targeted revocation/collection regressions fail on the original reader and pass on this patch. Native ArkTS build, Hypium UT, real-device ST, full repository CI and cloud/provider E2E **not run** for this commit; no GitHub check-runs exist for it.

## Remaining for the minimal P2 loop (unchanged from the fork PR)

- [x] Device-side handler, shared types and focused production-source tests.
- [ ] Actual page-owned grant issuance/expiry and authenticated task/connection binding; duplicate/stale-call rejection.
- [ ] Existing task transport -> device handler -> structured response -> actual agent tool consumer.
- [ ] Capability negotiation and one explicit old-client fallback; suppress P1 pre-read for admitted P2 submissions; untrusted-title model-result treatment.
- [ ] Native/device tests and complete required CI/architecture gates.
- [ ] Rebase decision on current `main` (P1 revert in scope) and coordination with #1066.

pr:296.body:
## 关联 Issue

- #233（`==` 标记泄漏，已由 #257 修）与 #278（等号比较被吞，已由 #269 修）
- #241（停止按钮无响应，已由 #268 修）

三个 issue 的修复都已在 main 上。本 PR **不改产品代码**，只把这三处行为补成设备级 ST 回归，避免以后同一个正则或同一处任务定位再退化。

## 做了什么

新增两条 Orbit 真实业务 ST 用例，并保持既有用例行为不变。

### `markup` — 等号比较与高亮标记解析（#233 / #278）

- 把**生产**的 `CloudMarkdown.ets` / `CloudMath.ets` 一起编译进独立 ST HAP，断言直接调用 `parseInline` / `parseMarkdownTable`，而不是复制一份正则到测试里（复制出来的正则会和生产实现漂移，正是这两个 issue 的成因）。
- 先要求模型原样回显一行混合文本，再对**该任务实际返回的回复**做断言：
  1. 每个带空格的比较片段（`a == b`、`if x == 0`）必须原样保留在可见文本里；
  2. 比较不得被渲染成 highlight（这正是 #278 里操作数被删掉的原因）；
  3. 紧贴文字的 `==标记==` 仍然高亮，且原始 `==标记==` 不残留在气泡文本里（#233 的症状）；
  4. 表格单元格路径同样成立：`` `a == b == c` `` 保持字面量，裸 `==25%==` 仍高亮。
- 不写死期望字符串：断言遍历回复中**实际出现**的比较片段，模型多说或少说不会被误判成通过。

### `stop` — 停止正在运行的任务（#241）

- 用 `extractRuntimeMethods` 从 `OrbitTaskRuntime.ets` **逐字提取** `topLevelTaskId` / `stopTarget` / `stopTask`，包进 `OrbitStopTarget`，仅补 `current` 与 `client`。停哪个任务、发什么请求，全部是生产代码。
- 真实流程：提交一条长任务 → 要求它此刻仍是 `pending`/`running`/`waiting` → 经生产 `stopTarget` 算出目标 → 发真实 `task.cancel` → 在同一预算内观察到**同一个 task** 变成 `cancelled`。
- 明确失败而非静默通过：`NOT_ACTIVE`、`READ_ONLY_ROOM`、`STOP_TARGET_MISMATCH`、`NO_CANCEL_SENT`、`STOP_IGNORED`、`CANCEL_UNCONFIRMED`。任务先跑到 `completed` 会被判 `STOP_IGNORED`，不会因为"反正结束了"算过。

### 配套改动

- `orb-rst-scenes.mjs`：注册两个新 key。两条新用例**不进** `all` / `smoke` / `core`，需显式 `-Cases markup,stop`；隔离规则改成按用例名判断，不再靠数组位置。
- `prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs`：新增 `extractRuntimeMethods`（源码结构变化即抛错，不静默降级），并把解析器与 `OrbitStopTarget` 纳入生成清单与 `source-manifest.json`。
- `LiveBusiness.test.ets`：`submit()` / `waitTask()` 增加 `untilActive` 分支，让用例能观察运行中的任务，同时仍正确收尾自己的 task trace。
- `run-orbit-device-st.ps1`：HAP 符号门禁补上两个新用例名（原先只校验六条）。
- `orbit-st-report-view.mjs`：补阶段中文名与用例标题，报告里不再显示裸 key。
- `nightly.yml`：`st_cases` 说明同步。
- `README.md`：用例表、选择器说明、以及**每条用例的真实通过条件**。

## 验证

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `node tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs` | 28 条，26 通过，2 失败 |
| 失败项 | `native stderr warnings…` / `native nonzero exit…` |
| 失败原因 | 本机沙箱禁止 `child_process.spawnSync` 捕获输出（`EPERM`），与本次改动无关：这两条用例及其依赖的 `runNative`（`scripts/orbit-st-tools.mjs`）在 main 上均未改动 |
| `scripts/prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs --compile-only` | 通过，27 个源文件，`OrbitStopTarget.ets` / `CloudMarkdown.ets` 均生成 |
| 生成物语法 | 用 SDK 自带 TypeScript 解析器全量解析 `.ets`，无语法错误 |
| `git diff --check` | 通过 |
| CI `node-ut` | **success**（含 `tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs` 全量 28 条，含本次新增断言） |
| CI `ArkTS Code Check` | **success** |
| CI `hypium-ut` | skipped（仓库变量 `ENABLE_HYPIUM_UT` 未开启，与本次改动无关） |

**未完成、不能算通过：**

- 本机真实 HAP 编译未跑成：hvigor 在 `C:\Users\qq567\.hvigor` 写缓存、并在 `node_modules\@ohos\hvigor` 建符号链接，本机沙箱分别报 `EPERM mkdir` 和 `EPERM symlink`（后者即 WinError 1314）。**CI 也没有跑 HAP 编译那条路**（`hypium-ut` skipped），所以 ST 工程的 ArkTS 编译门禁**仍未真正通过**；生成物只做了 TypeScript 语法解析。
- 两条新用例**从未在真实后端跑过**。`all` / `smoke` / `core` 里没有它们，Nightly 也不会自动跑到，需要显式 `-Cases markup,stop` 并配好 Gateway Bearer 与设备。
- 因此本 PR 不宣称 #233/#278/#241 的 ST 回归"已验证通过"，只提供可执行的回归用例与明确失败判据。跑通后再补真实回执。

## 复现

```powershell
# 离线断言
node tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs

# 生成 + 编译（需要可用的 DevEco 与符号链接权限）
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases 'markup,stop' -OutputDirectory "$env:TEMP\ST-IssueCases"

# 真实运行（需要 ST_DEVICE_ID / ST_ORBIT_URL / ST_ORBIT_BEARER）
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -Run -Cases 'markup,stop' -OutputDirectory "$env:TEMP\ST-IssueCases"
```

## 说明

- 提交内容只有上述 8 个文件，未包含签名材料、本地配置或凭据。
- `markup` 与 `stop` 跑通后会各自留下真实通过记录，届时再考虑是否纳入默认套件；本 PR 不预先放宽或收紧既有五条用例。

## 关于 PR 来源

本 PR 与 #294 是同一提交（`c6e0812f`）。#294 从私有 fork 发起，CI 的 `Download source snapshot` 用 base 仓库 token 去取 fork 的 tarball 返回 404，两个门禁只跑了收尾步骤就失败，实际未验证任何代码。改为从本仓库分支 `test/st-issue-regression-cases` 发起后，tarball 走 `github.repository`，两个门禁均已真实执行并通过。#294 已关闭。

pr:300.body:
## 问题

最新 main 上，Orbit 设备 ST 的测试 HAP **编译不出来**。

```
.\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases core
→ COMPILE RESULT:FAIL {ERROR:22 WARN:100}
  Error: Property 'trajectory' does not exist on type 'ProductionComposer'
  Error: Property 'profilingEnabled' does not exist on type 'ProductionComposer'
  Error: Cannot find name 'OrbitResponse' / 'OrbitRequest'
  Error: Cannot find module '@loop/cloud-adapter'
```

## 根因

`tests/dfx/stability/orbit-device/ComposerHost.ets` 是一个**手写**的 host 类，承载 `prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs` 从生产 `OrbitHome/Index.ets` **逐字提取**的 `send` / `drainSend` 方法体。

生产代码这阵子给这两个方法加了 trajectory 打点、profiling 开关和 draft 行状态，但 host 没跟着声明。提取是逐字的，所以方法体里引用了 host 上不存在的成员——编译必失败。

这是 main 上的既有缺陷，**与任何新用例无关**。已用未修改的 main（`5d574e36`）直接复现。

## 改动

| 文件 | 改动 |
|---|---|
| `ComposerHost.ets` | 引入并实例化生产 `OrbitTrajectory` 作为 `trajectory`；补 `profilingEnabled`（关闭）、`traceSubmissionId`、`draftNeedsOwnRow`；补 `OrbitRequest`/`OrbitResponse` 导入 |
| `prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs` | 拷贝 `OrbitTrajectory.ets` 并在 `orbit/index.ets` 导出；改写 `OrbitDeviceContext.ets` 的 `'@loop/cloud-adapter'` 别名 |
| `tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs` | 两个新守卫 |

### 为什么用真实 `OrbitTrajectory` 而不是空实现

它是纯逻辑类，只依赖 `hilog` 和 `OrbitProtocol` 的计时类型，没有 UI 依赖。用真实实现意味着提取出来的 `send`/`drainSend` 仍然调用**产品本来的**记录器，而不是我在测试里伪造一个。这符合这套 ST 的原则：产品方法逐字执行，测试只补 UI 生命周期。

`profilingEnabled` 设为 `false`，与页面默认值一致，让产品 `send` 走非诊断分支。`traceSubmissionId` / `draftNeedsOwnRow` 也取页面初始值。

### 两个守卫

这次问题的本质是「手写 host 与逐字提取的方法体失配」，而且**只有到真机跑才会发现**。所以补了两个单元守卫：

1. **成员完备性**：提取出的方法体里每个 `this.<member>`，必须能在 host 上解析（`extractSupport` 注入的方法算数）。缺失即报 `ProductionComposer is missing: x, y`。
2. **别名改写**：直接对生成产物断言，任何生成的 `.ets` 都不得残留 `'@loop/'`。这比匹配 prepare 的源码写法可靠。

守卫已验证有效：删掉 `trajectory` 那一行，立刻报
```
AssertionError: ProductionComposer is missing: trajectory
```

## 验证

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `node tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs`（干净 main + 本 commit） | **25/25 通过** |
| 守卫有效性 | 移除 `trajectory` → 报 `missing: trajectory`；恢复 → 全绿 |
| `-CompileOnly -Cases core`（本分支） | **`CompileOnly succeeded`**，`Verified test HAP: SDK runner and all six business case implementations are present.` |
| 生成物别名 | 生成后 `OrbitDeviceContext.ets` 内已无 `@loop` |
| `git diff --check` | 通过 |

编译是**实际执行**的，不是推断：本机 hvigor 已跑通，输出见上。

**未做：** 没有在真机跑业务用例（需要 Gateway Bearer，当前环境没有）。本 PR 只修编译，不改任何用例语义。

## 复现

```powershell
# 修复前
git checkout 5d574e36
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases core
# → COMPILE RESULT:FAIL {ERROR:22}

# 修复后
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases core
# → CompileOnly succeeded
```

## 与其他 PR 的关系

与 #296（新增 #233/#278、#241 的 ST 回归用例）**相互独立**，可分别合并。#296 也包含同样的编译修复（否则它自己的新用例也编不过）；本 PR 先合入后，#296 可以 rebase 掉这部分。

pr:334.body:
Closes #242。与 #235 的状态栏内容重叠是另一类问题，本 PR 只处理 Beebou 形象浮层。

## 问题

收起态的 Beebou 是页面 `Stack` 上的绝对定位浮层：头像 `x: '50%'`、名字胶囊 `width('100%')` 居中、提醒气泡居中，三层都在 `topInset` 附近的阅读区上方。列表顶部的占位只在滚到顶部时生效，一旦上滑（#242 截图就是把用户提问滚到最上层再看），消息就从这三层底下穿过，用户无法核对自己刚发的内容。名字胶囊还是整条横幅的点击区，顶部这条横带被它拦截。

## 改动

`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/OrbitHome/Index.ets`
- 收起态头像**贴右边缘停靠**：`x: '100%'` + `translate(-52)`，82vp 的盒子里 52vp 可见，其余出屏；可见条同时是点击区（≥44vp 触控标准）。徽标改到可见侧，避免跑到屏外。打开实时活动面板时仍回到面板原来居中的位置（面板里 `Blank().height(72)` 早已为它留位）。
- 删除常驻居中的「Beebou」胶囊。名字 + 进度文案改为**只在 `petCaption()` 非空时**出现的小胶囊，停在头像左侧，外层 Row 用 `HitTestMode.Transparent`，不再拦截顶部按钮；点按进实时活动、长按看进展的行为保留。
- 提醒气泡从屏幕中间移到头像下方右侧边缘，仍可 × 关闭（临时提示）。
- `digitalmate-live-activity` 这个 id 移到头像容器上，`DM-WF-BACK-01` 的选择器不变。

`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/OrbitHome/OrbitPetAvatar.ets`
- 空闲时**隔一会动一会**：以静帧为主，每 4–9s 抖动 1.4s（200ms 交叉淡化），三张图常驻挂载避免换源闪动；`aboutToDisappear` 清定时器；`reduceMotion` 仍只用静帧；任务执行中保持连续播放（进度信号）。

## 验证

- 新增 `tests/unit/orbit-pet-dock.test.mjs`：停靠位置、身份胶囊不再横跨顶部且点击不被拦截、空闲抖动节律（用假定时器跑组件真实分支）。三个用例在 main 源码上全部失败，本分支全部通过。
- `node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs`：2144 个用例，2130 通过；7 个失败均为本机环境原因（缺 `playwright`、`EPERM: fsync`），与改动无关。
- **未验证**：本机没有 HarmonyOS SDK/hvigor，未做 ArkTS 编译，也没有真机/模拟器截图，视觉与手感需要在设备上确认。

## 已知取舍

顶部横带（抽屉按钮、标题所在）本来就是内容从底下滚过的沉浸式设计，头像停靠在这条横带的右端：气泡正文中间完全让开了，但消息滚到最顶端时仍会从头像下方经过，与抽屉按钮一致。若 UCD 方案要求任何滚动位置都零遮挡，需要把顶部改成真正的布局区（列表不再滚到顶栏之下），属于更大的结构改动，可在此基础继续。#242 的评论提到 UCD 方案还在跟进，允许的话请一并确认方向。

pr:391.body:
E2E DAG validation compares fixed component states before and after each action, showing paired expected/actual endpoint values in HTML. Non-applicable checks are hidden. Generated reply wording, intermediate animation sequences and DAG-specific screenshots are excluded. Missing captures, invalid paths, ineffective actions and component mismatches fail the artifact gate.

One shared allowlist enables 12 reviewed cases for both CI execution and independent artifact validation. BACK-01, QUOTE-01 and TRAVEL-01 retain their standards but are deferred. ST and UT do not run application DAG/component gates.

CI validation uses the effective target consistently for job naming, simulator startup and signing checks. The dedicated upstream validation branch builds and installs the checkout on the simulator, launches it without an interactive window, and skips ST/cloud image deployment. Standard/checker tests run before device operations. The CLI resolves canonical entry paths so macOS temporary-directory symlinks cannot silently skip execution. Page preflight reuses the workflow driver's readiness checks and reports login or system-blocking conditions explicitly.

Validation:
- 40 DAG/component checker tests passed locally and on the macOS CI runner, including a symlink-entry regression.
- Remote simulator startup, device connection, native build and HAP installation passed.
- Four device/signing scenarios and two emulator-launch branches checked locally with mocked build/device executables.
- Local three-round E2E experiment (one attempt per case, frozen standards): 12/12, 1/12, 1/12. Of 22 failures, 20 showed reply failure, one showed cloud session recovery failure and one failed foreground readiness. The controlled component case passed 3/3. This does not establish stability of all business terminal-state checks.
- Latest remote run: https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/41620367760 . E2E execution is currently blocked because the remote simulator opens the DigitalMate login page. Authentication must be restored before rerunning; no remote E2E pass is claimed.

Readiness limit: an action boundary is captured after its driver returns and a quiet layout or completed frame. This does not independently guarantee completion of all asynchronous business work. Reply-completion readiness currently includes UI heuristics and a stable-text fallback; fixed endpoint controls are checked against the reviewed standard.

pr:396.body: ## What this fixes Reply bubbles could print unresolved tool-protocol payloads verbatim, e.g. ``` 好的，<|DSML|native_read_source {"path":"attachment-1"}|> ``` Three client-side text paths had no filter at all: `CloudSession.flush()` (`+=` on every stream delta), `applyFinalAnswer()` (`target.text = content`), and `applyHistory()` (rebuilds bubbles from stored raw text, so leaked history showed up again after a cold start). This PR adds the last line of defence: whatever the server does, the user only sees natural language. Fixes #395. Root cause of the original report (unregistered/unexecuted tool, DSML emitted by the model) stays in #330 — this PR does not touch the server, it only guarantees the bubble never renders protocol text. ## How it works New pure module `digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudProtocolText.ets`: - `splitToolProtocol(text)` → `{ visible, hold }`: complete `<|...|>` spans are removed; a trailing incomplete span whose marker name matches a known protocol prefix (`dsml`, `tool_call`, `tool_result`, `endoftext`, `eot_id`, `im_start`, `im_end`) is held back until it closes (or is dropped at end of turn); anything else — a plain `<`, a `` tag, an over-long `<|` that does not look like a protocol marker — is left untouched. - `stripToolProtocol(text)` → `visible` only. `CloudSession` now keeps the unfiltered stream per message in `rawText` and recomputes `row.text` through `stripToolProtocol(raw)` on every delta, so a marker split across deltas never leaks a partial fragment. The same filter is applied to non-streaming `chat.final` (append / replace_turn / patch paths, with `rawText` kept in sync) and to history reconstruction. Nothing else in the session lifecycle changes; no new dependency, no protocol change, no permission change, no prompt/response logging. ## Tests (failing first) `tests/unit/cloud-reply-protocol-text.test.mjs` — 6 cases, loads the real classes through the existing `tests/support/cloud-test-loader.mjs`, no device or backend needed. Red first: before the module existed the suite failed with `ENOENT ... CloudProtocolText.ets`. | Case | Expectation | | --- | --- | | plain text | `你好，我在。` unchanged | | complete DSML block | dropped | | `<|endoftext|>` | dropped | | `a < b` | preserved | | `` form | dropped | | empty input | empty | Session-level: | Case | Expectation | | --- | --- | | marker split across three deltas | bubble is `好的，我看看文件。` | | trailing unclosed fragment | dropped, bubble is `查完了。` | | non-streaming `chat.final` | bubble is `查一下好的` | | history rebuild after resume | bubble is `这是历史回复` | | ordinary `` tags in text | preserved: `第一段，和 粗体 标签。` | Green after the fix: **193 pass / 0 fail** across `cloud-reply-protocol-text`, `cloud-chat`, `cloud-reply-content`, `cloud-reply-images`, `cloud-page-state`, `cloud-task-recovery`. Full `tests/unit` sweep on this base: 999 pass / 6 fail; all 6 failures are missing local devDependencies (`typescript`, `playwright`) that the `ut.yml` workflow installs, and none of them is touched by this PR. ## Non-goals - No server-side tool parsing/registration work; #330 keeps the root cause. - No new dependencies, no protocol change, no permission widening, no prompt/response content logged. - Tool failures are still reported to the user through the existing error surface — this only stops the raw protocol text from being rendered as body copy. - Pre-existing history rows already stored upstream are not rewritten; they are simply no longer displayed. ## Risk The only failure mode is over-filtering legitimate text. It is bounded to closed `<|...|>` spans and to unclosed tails whose marker name matches a known protocol prefix; every other `<` keeps its behaviour, and two of the six tests pin that down. Rollback is a single revert of three files. Fledge · DigitalMate · Lead · maintained

pr:399.body:
## 这个 PR 做什么

新增七条原生业务 E2E（`DM-WF-REGRESSION-01`～`07`），覆盖 #339、#152、#62、#239、#255、#157 的回归场景，外加一条设备侧探针，用来判断依赖预置数据的两条用例能不能跑。

用例登记在 `tests/cases/case-catalog.yaml`（`ci-gates/case-catalog@1`）：

| 用例 | 关联 | 执行方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 01 | #339 未合并双卡、独立输入、反序回答 | Nightly |
| 02 | #152 主题澄清后长作文交付 | Nightly |
| 03 | #62 真实搜索结论与来源 | Nightly |
| 04 | #239 真实图片产物与预览 | Nightly |
| 05 | #255 失败提醒读取与恢复 | `fixture-required` |
| 06 | #157 主对话与活动入口一致性 | Nightly |
| 07 | #339 静默结果恢复不泄露 | `fixture-required` |

## 为什么 05/07 要单独处理

01/02/03/04/06 在会话内自造状态，可以直接跑。05/07 需要云端真实产生的记录：

- **05**：两条不同的「真实 failed + 未读」任务，加一张 waiting 的未答授权卡
- **07**：一条 completed、非 quiet、结果精确为 `[SILENT]` 的任务（无 active 产物），加一条真实失败或文件交付作对照

这些状态测试造不出来，也不允许伪造（不写库、不编 `failed`、不代用户点授权）。所以它们带 `preconditions.manualSetup` 和 `execution: fixture-required`；`runner.mjs` 的 `selectWorkflows` 会过滤掉所有带 `manualSetup` 的用例，**无人值守 Nightly 永远不会捡到它们**，不会因为缺预置把夜间绿灯打红。

## 探针的安全模型

直接复用已存在的受保护凭据，不向任何人索要 token：

- 从 `AssetCredentialStore` 内存读取 grant，校验 active owner、environment、有效期
- 必须先用 `room.home` 拿到已认证快照，才允许准备记录
- 只导出账号指纹（64 位 hex）和按 marker 匹配的任务元数据，**不导出 token，也不读取其他会话**

## 本轮修复的三个真实缺陷

前几次 CI 失败都不是业务断言失败，而是证据链断裂：

**① 探针写了 0 个文件。** `createModuleContext('entry')` 原本在 `try` 之外，设备上 wrapper 被拒时直接抛断言错，`finally` 里的写文件根本没执行 —— 于是表现为 `Failure: 1` 且没有 `probe.json`。现在上下文解析进 `try`，写入路径独立解析并覆盖 `entry` / `entry_test` / app `filesDir` 三个候选，实际写入路径记录在 `writtenTo`。

**② 收集器信任了退出码。** `hdc file recv` 在远端文件不存在时会打印 `Error opening file` 但 **exit 0**，且不产生本地文件。上一轮「收集成功」其实是空文件。现在必须本地文件非空且含本次 `fixtureRunId` 才算成功；缺失即报「证据缺失，不能判定账号或前置状态」。

**③ ohosTest 编译缺少依赖。** CI 上 `E2E_INSTALL_APP=false` 会跳过 App 构建，`oh_modules` 从未生成；而探针 import 的 `@loop/agent-core`、`@loop/cloud-adapter` 是 `file:../*` 本地依赖，需要 `ohpm install` 后才可解析。表现为 `Cannot find module` + `COMPILE RESULT:FAIL {ERROR:167}`，探针一行都没执行。现在脚本在编译前先 `"$OHPM" install --all`，nightly 也把 `OHPM` 传入该步骤。

同时把阻塞原因分类（`no-active-account` / `no-saved-grant` / `stale-grant` / `unexpected-endpoint` / `cloud-unauthorized` / `tls-failure` / `timeout` / `authenticated-read-empty`），不再一律折叠成 `blocked`。

## 用例本身的一处收紧

05 的 S11 改为陈述「相对 S05 基线，关注数只减少甲这一项」。该计数按 **distinct taskId** 计算（`DigitalMateNoticePresentation.ets:27`），所以用例自己发出的普通问答不会干扰差值；措辞也不再诱导按总数理解。

## 校验

- `node tests/e2e/workflow/run-workflow.mjs --validate` → **21/21 通过**
- `node scripts/gate/gate.mjs verify-cases` → **23 total, 23 ready**
- 定向 Node 测试 **93 项通过**，含用假 hdc 复现「exit 0 但无文件」
- native `entry@ohosTest` HAP 本地编译通过
- `actionlint` 与 shell 语法检查通过（仅报既有自托管 runner 标签未登记，属既有状态）

## 当前真实状态（不要误读）

**没有任何一条业务 E2E 被验证通过。**

运行 `41380817343`（`inspect-fixtures`）的预检**已通过**（`对话页已就绪，digitalmate-* test id 可见`），说明冷启动后 UI 与 test id 正常；失败发生在探针 HAP 的 ArkTS 编译（上述缺陷 ③），探针逻辑未执行，因此**这次仍不能判定账号或前置状态**。

更早的运行停在页面预检的 `App 云端连接未就绪`，5 条自动用例的业务步骤一步都没执行。设备侧 UI 曾显示 `网络不可用，请检查网络后重试` / `正在恢复云端连接…`，属客户端连接症状，**不构成账号缺失的证明**。

本 PR 的断言一律未放宽。后续运行的价值在于把「连不上」变成可分类的结论：要么跑出逐条结果，要么明确写出是缺 grant、凭据过期、TLS 失败还是 Gateway 拒绝。

`ready` 只表示有用例可执行，不代表已部署云端或已通过真实设备验收。只有截图与评分硬门槛都通过，才能宣称业务验收通过。

pr:401.body:
## What this fixes

A turn that stops receiving events while the websocket stays healthy leaves the UI in "running" indefinitely. Reconnect reconciliation only runs when the connection drops (`CloudChatManager.reconcileAfterReconnect`), so a silent turn is never checked and the user is left with a half sentence and no way to tell whether the answer is still coming — the exact现场 in #379 (回复只有「我核对一下具体是谁说的。」，之后无任何输出，也没有失败提示或重试入口).

The session now watches that silence itself: after one minute without any event on a turn that still owes output, the conversation raises a single `warn` notice ("云端仍在处理，近一分钟没有新的输出。可以继续等待，或停止任务后重试。"). It never changes the run state, never fabricates a failure, and disappears the moment the cloud says anything again.

Fixes #398. Fixes #379 (user-visible report of the same quiet-turn hang). See also #373 (execution-time opacity).

## How it works

`CloudSession`:

- `watchQuiet()` restarts the silence clock and drops a shown hint. It is called from `beginTurn()` and on every frame the session accepts in `apply()`, so only a genuine gap counts.
- The timer fires at most once per quiet stretch (`quietHint` latches until the next event), only while `state` is `running` or `sending` — a paused turn, a turn waiting on an unanswered question, a stopped turn and a finished turn all have their own state and never see the hint.
- `settleQuiet()` stops the clock and removes the hint on `finishTurn()` and on `beginTurn()` of the next turn, so nothing leaks across turns.
- The hint is only placed when `notice` is empty: a real error/notice is never overwritten.
- The threshold is a constructor parameter (`new CloudSession(id, quietHintMs)`), defaulting to the exported `QUIET_HINT_MS = 60000`; tests pass a short value instead of sleeping a minute.

No new protocol, no server change, no new dependency, no logging of prompt/response content, no permission change. Rollback is a revert of two files.

## Tests (failing first)

`tests/unit/cloud-session-quiet-watch.test.mjs` — 7 cases, real `CloudSession` through the existing `tests/support/cloud-test-loader.mjs`, no device or backend.

Red first: before the change the suite failed with `assert.ok(session.notice)` — a silent running turn produced no notice at all.

| Case | Expectation |
| --- | --- |
| running turn, no events | `warn` notice containing「仍在处理」, `state` stays `running` |
| output resumes | notice cleared at once, bubble text continues normally |
| turn finished before the threshold | no notice, `state` is `idle` |
| turn waiting on the user (`chat.ask_user_question`) | no notice (`state` is `waiting`) |
| a real notice already shown | untouched (`连接已中断` stays) |
| silence continues | notice does not repeat |
| next turn starts | no leftover notice from the previous turn |

Green after the change: 7/7. Whole `cloud-*` unit set on this branch: 517 pass / 3 fail, and the 3 failures are the missing local devDependencies (`typescript` ×2, `playwright` ×1) that `ut.yml` installs — none of them touches `CloudSession`.

## Non-goals

- No automatic failure state, no new terminal state, no retry RPC: the client cannot verify the turn is dead, and inventing a failure would be worse than the silence.
- No server-side change; if the cloud really stops answering, a proper terminal event still has to come from the backend (#367/#379).
- No change to execution/step presentation (that is #373/#375).

## Risk

The only risk is a false alarm during a legitimately long non-streaming tool phase (#322): the notice is worded as "still working", changes no state, blocks no input, is cleared by the next event and appears once per quiet stretch, with a one-minute threshold. Worst case the user sees one informational line on a long turn.

pr:403.body:
## What this fixes

Markdown emphasis in a Chinese reply leaked its markers into the bubble and broke the sentence style:

- `***两者***` rendered as `*` + bold `两者` + `*`
- `**粗体 *内斜* 混排**` rendered as five spans (`*`, italic `粗体 `, plain `内斜`, italic ` 混排`, `*`) — the outer bold was lost entirely

Cause: the bold branch of `parsePlainInline()` only accepted content without an asterisk (`\*\*([^*]+)\*\*`), so any nested emphasis made the whole span fail and the leftover markers fell through as plain text.

Fixes #402. Same rendering pipeline as #357 (multi-line content shown unrendered) and independent of #360 (table separator rows).

## How it works

`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudMarkdown.ets`:

- The bold branch now accepts inner emphasis: `\*\*((?:[^*]|\*[^*]+\*)+)\*\*`, which covers `**粗体 *内斜* 混排**`, and `***x***` (the inner `*x*` matches, so the whole triple form lands on the bold branch).
- The captured text has its inner `*` markers removed before the span is created: `Inline` carries a single style, so the outer bold wins and no marker reaches the bubble. A numeric inner pair is the exception: `**5*3*2 = 30**` is arithmetic, so its asterisks stay literal (`boldPlainText()`), while `***x***` keeps rendering as bold `x`.
- Ordered before the backtick branch as before, so inline code and fenced code keep their asterisks literal.

No new dependency, no protocol change, no content dropped — only the markers.

## Tests (failing first)

New `tests/unit/cloud-markdown-emphasis.test.mjs`, 4 cases; red on `0fb0456` (each assertion showed the stray `*` spans above), green after the fix.

| Case | Expectation |
| --- | --- |
| `***两者***` | one bold span, text `两者` |
| `价格 ***99*** 元` | `价格 ` + bold `99` + ` 元` |
| `**粗体 *内斜* 混排**` | one bold span, text `粗体 内斜 混排` |
| `结论：**关键 *点* 已确认**。` | prefix + one bold span + `。` |
| `**粗体**`, `*斜体*`, `==高亮==`, `**粗体** 与 *斜体*` | unchanged |
| `` `a *** b` `` | literal `a *** b` inside a code span |

Whole markdown set on this branch (`cloud-markdown`, `cloud-markdown-links`, `cloud-markdown-layout`, `markdown-render-st`, plus the new suite): **65 pass / 0 fail**.

## Non-goals

- No nested rich text: `Inline` keeps its single-style contract, the outer span wins.
- No change to table recognition (#360's area) or to linkification.
- No new dependency, no logging, no permission change.

## Risk

The only new behaviour is that literal asterisks nested inside a bold span are dropped, except for a numeric inner pair, which stays literal because dropping it would change the value the user reads (`**5*3*2 = 30**` used to become `532 = 30`). A product written with one star and no closing partner (`**2*3**`) is not matched by the bold branch at all and behaves as before (verified: `*` + italic `2` + `3**` on both `0fb0456` and this branch) — the earlier example in this description was wrong. Code spans are matched first and keep their asterisks, and the existing behaviours (`**bold**`, `*italic*`, ``code``) are pinned by the tests. Rollback is a one-line regex revert plus the handler line.

## 问题

「执行步骤」卡片、子代理活动行和步骤摘要都经过 `brief()`（`CloudMessage.ets`）。它只认 `data:` URL 一种二进制形态，而且 scheme 匹配会跨过 JSON 引号：

1. **裸露 base64 不被遮蔽**：`{"image_base64":"iVBORw0KGgo" + "A"×600}` 原样输出 612 个字符（最长到 12000 字符上限），图片生成工具的字节铺满步骤卡片。
2. **多个内联 data URL 被合并**：`{"images":["data:...","data:..."]}` → `{"images":["[二进制内容]"]}`，第二张图消失——`data:[^\s]+;base64,` 会吃到最后一个 `;base64,`，把中间字段吞掉。

- 新增 `[A-Za-z0-9+/]{200,}={0,2}` —— 不带 scheme 的裸 base64（≥200 连续字符）同样折叠为 `[二进制内容]`；阈值远大于任何正常标识符，普通文本、短数字、URL 主机名与 `?download_token=` 既有遮蔽行为不变。

pr:411.body:
## 问题

`chat.final` 的落地路径先解析「这条 final 覆盖哪个分段」，`parseChatFinalSegmentId()` 把四个候选字段塞进 `string[]` 后逐个 `.trim()`。帧是服务端下发的 JSON，`Payload.segment_id?: string` 只是编译期声明；消息 id 在服务端常是整数，`||` 只吞掉 `0`/`''`，非零数字会原样进入数组并让 `.trim()` 抛 `TypeError`。

在 `0fb0456` 上实测：

```
parseChatFinalSegmentId({ segment_id: 42 })        → TypeError: value.trim is not a function
session.apply({event:'chat.final',
  payload:{request_id:'turn', content:'最终回答', stream_message_id: 98765}})
                                                   → TypeError: value.trim is not a function
```

异常发生在帧分发里，被 `CloudConnection` 的 `try/catch` 转成 `onProtocolError('消息处理失败，详见通信日志')`：这条 final 的正文整条丢失，同一轮的 `finishTurn()` 也没执行，用户看到的是通用错误提示而不是回复。

Fixes #410

## 改动

`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudFinal.ets`（+11/−6）：

- 候选值按 `string | undefined` 收集，逐个 `typeof value !== 'string'` 跳过，字符串路径仍 `trim()` 后返回；
- 四个字段都不可用时返回 `''`（表示写到客户端当前分段），不再抛异常；
- 与同文件 `parseChatFinalMode()` 已有的 `typeof raw !== 'string'` 校验保持一致。

不改协议、不改分段选择策略、不改任何网络行为；只是不再让一个可选字段的类型把整条 final 打掉。

## 测试

新增 `tests/unit/cloud-final-segment-id.test.mjs`，**先失败后通过**（`0fb0456` 上 4 条中 3 条失败）：

| 用例 | 断言 |
| --- | --- |
| 数字型 `segment_id` / `stream_message_id` | 返回 `''`，不抛异常 |
| 前一个候选不可用、后一个可用 | 取到 `'m-9'`；`'seg-1'` 原样返回；`'  seg-2  '` 被 trim |
| `parseChatFinalMode` 非字符串 | 仍返回 `''`（回归保护） |
| 带数字 `stream_message_id` 的 `chat.final` | 回复落进气泡、`completed === true`、会话回到 `idle` |

```
node --test tests/unit/cloud-final-segment-id.test.mjs   # 4/4
node --test tests/unit/cloud-*.test.mjs                  # 517 tests · 514 pass · 3 fail
```

3 条失败是本地缺依赖的既有基线（`Cannot find module 'typescript'` ×2、`'playwright'` ×1，CI 的 `ut.yml` 会安装），与本次改动无关。`CloudFinal.ets` 此前在 `tests/unit` 里没有任何覆盖，这个文件顺带补上。

## 未验证

- 服务端线上是否真的会下发数字型分段 id：仓库内没有服务端代码，无法证实。本 PR 修的是「客户端把可选字段做成硬失败点」这一可复现事实，而不是声称线上已发生。
- 真机渲染与 ArkTS 编译：沙箱无真机与 ArkTS 工具链，由 CI 的 ArkTS Code Check 覆盖。

## 风险与回滚

行为面很小：只有非字符串候选值从「抛异常」变成「跳过」。若服务端确实永远只发字符串，这个改动等价于空操作。回滚只需 revert 这一个 commit。

pr:434.body:
## What

Three interactive controls in the CloudHome chat header are drawn as a bare glyph or a bare icon with no accessible name, so a screen reader announces the character or "image" instead of the action:

| Control | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| back chevron | `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:1731` `Text('‹')` → announced as "‹" | `.accessibilityText('返回')` |
| session list | `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:1752` `Image($r('app.media.ic_session_fold'))` → announced as "image" / "图片" | `.accessibilityText('会话列表')` |
| queue-edit close | `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:2234` `Text('×')` → announced as "×" (multiplication sign) | `.accessibilityText('退出编辑')` |

One coherent defect class — *(i) icon-only / glyph-only control without accessible text* — one surface (the cloud chat page), one file changed. No layout, colour, size or interaction change; the visible glyphs are byte-identical.

`Fixes #433`

## Reachability (release path, hop by hop)

1. `digitalmate/entry/src/main/resources/base/profile/main_pages.json:6` registers `pages/CloudHome/Index`.
2. `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:363` `CLOUD_CHAT_ROUTE_URL: string = 'pages/CloudHome/Index'` routes to it.
3. `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:2572` `if (!this.contentOnly) { this.Header() }` — the header renders on every normal chat open.
4. `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:1728` `Header()` builds `:1731` (back chevron), `:1752` (session list, under `if (this.connectionState() === 'open')` at `:1751`), and `QueueBar` → `:2234` (queue-edit close, under `if (this.editingQueueId && !this.contentOnly)` at `:2231`).

No hop is behind a constant `false`, a debug flag or a dead branch: `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets` does not reference `isDebugBuild` at all, and the only conditions on the path are live UI state (`contentOnly`, `connectionState()`, `editingQueueId`).

## Test — red, green, mutation

- **Red** `c86fc69` (test only, +98) on `main` `04621bb`: `ℹ tests 2 / pass 0 / fail 2`, exit 1, verbatim:
  `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:1731 (the chat-header back chevron) must carry a non-empty accessible name, so a screen reader announces the action instead of the bare glyph or "image"`
- **Green** `7801fb2` (1 file, +3/−1): `ℹ tests 2 / pass 2 / fail 0`.
- Test file byte-identical between red and green: `git diff --stat c86fc69 7801fb2 -- tests/unit/cloud-chat-accessible-names.test.mjs` is **empty**.
- **Mutation check** (mandatory): `sed -i "s/        .accessibilityText('返回')//" …/CloudHome/Index.ets` → `ℹ tests 2 / pass 0 / fail 2`, same assertion as the red run; restored → `ℹ tests 2 / pass 2 / fail 0`.

The test reads the shipped page, finds each control's anchor line, walks its modifier chain up to the balanced `.onClick(` handler and requires a non-empty Chinese `.accessibilityText(...)` label, plus that the three names are distinct. A comment or an unrelated edit in the file cannot satisfy it; a control without its label cannot pass it.

## Chinese output

Byte-identical for every pre-existing string: all 121 distinct CJK string literals in `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets` (158 occurrences) are unchanged on the branch — zero removed or altered. The change only **adds** three labels: `返回` (6 bytes), `会话列表` (12 bytes), `退出编辑` (12 bytes). No English copy was added.

## Checks run

- `node --test tests/unit/cloud-chat-accessible-names.test.mjs` — red then green as above.
- Full suite on the branch vs `main` `04621bb`: **1806 tests / 1767 pass / 32 fail / 7 skipped** vs **1804 / 1765 / 32 / 7** — the 28 failing files are the same set on both sides (set difference empty).
- Not run: `hvigorw test` and on-device/emulator runs — this sandbox has no HarmonyOS/ArkTS toolchain, so the accessibility names were verified against the source the compiler consumes, not on a device.

## Non-goals held

No new module, no dependency, no permission, no server change, no locale framework, no change to `AboutYouPage.ets`, `AboutYouRenderer.ets`, `MemoryOverview.ets`, `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets`, `BimDailyReminder.ets`, `A2uiHomeState.ets` or `StatusBadgeView.ets` (all owned by open PRs). The only edited file is `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets`, which no open PR touches at the time of writing.

## What

The composer attachment strip announced its two controls in Chinese only, so TalkBack on an `en` device read 「report.pdf，上传失败」 and 「移除附件 report.pdf」. The two announcements now follow the existing device-language value:

- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/files/FilePresentation.ets` — new pure helpers `composerFileStatusAnnouncement(name, status, language)` and `composerFileActionAnnouncement(name, status, language)` (plus `attachmentLanguageIsEnglish`). zh strings are the exact strings that were inline before; `en*` gets `, upload failed` / `, uploading` / `, uploaded` and `Cancel upload ` / `Remove attachment `.
- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/files/ComposerFileStrip.ets` — both `.accessibilityText(...)` calls now use the helpers with `this.language = digitalmateClientContext().language` (`model/DigitalMateDeviceContext.ets:14`, the value #425/#429 already use). No new module, dependency, permission, server call or locale framework.

Fixes #437

## Reachability (release path)

1. `resources/base/profile/main_pages.json:3` → `pages/A2uiHome/Index`.
2. `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:1029` `@State private cloudBackend: string = 'workswarm'` (shipped default) → `:8896` `HomePage({ … cloudChat: true (':8928') … })`.
3. `pages/A2uiHome/components/HomePage.ets:1192` `this.CloudComposerFiles(...)` inside `if (this.cloudChat)` (`:1191`).
4. `HomePage.ets:980` `CloudComposerFiles` → `:981` `ComposerFileStrip({ files: this.cloudFiles, … })`.

No constant `false`, no debug flag, no dead branch: `cloudBackend` defaults to `'workswarm'`, `cloudChat` is set to `true` by the page, and none of the touched files references `isDebugBuild`.

## Test: red → green → mutation

- **Red** `cbc93c7` (test only, +89) on `main` `04621bb`: `ℹ tests 5 / pass 0 / fail 5`, verbatim:
  `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: FilePresentation.ets must expose composerFileStatusAnnouncement(name, status, language)` (and the same for `composerFileActionAnnouncement`).
- **Green** `716523a`: `ℹ tests 5 / pass 5 / fail 0`. Test file byte-identical: `git diff --stat cbc93c7 716523a -- tests/unit/composer-attachment-announcements.test.mjs` is **empty**.
- **Mutation** (mandatory): `sed -i "s/', upload failed'/'，上传失败'/" digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/files/FilePresentation.ets` →
  `ℹ tests 5 / pass 4 / fail 1` with
  ```
  AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: Expected values to be strictly equal:
  + actual - expected
  + 'report.pdf，上传失败'
  - 'report.pdf, upload failed'
  ```
  restored → `ℹ tests 5 / pass 5 / fail 0`.

## Content anchoring (no line numbers)

Each assertion finds its element by the function name or the call text, never by a line number — adding or removing an unrelated line cannot turn it red. Example from the wiring test:

```js
assert.ok(strip.includes(call),
  'ComposerFileStrip.ets must announce through ' + call + '…), not an inline Chinese-only string');
const start = strip.indexOf(call);
assert.match(strip.slice(start, start + 200), /this\.language|digitalmateClientContext\(\)\.language|language\)/,
  'the ' + call + '…) call must pass the device language');
```

One assertion block per control: the status announcement (zh and en) and the cancel/remove announcement (zh and en), plus one for the strip wiring.

## Chinese output

Byte-identical: the combined CJK string-literal multiset of `FilePresentation.ets` + `ComposerFileStrip.ets` is **12 literals on `main` and 12 on the branch, and the two multisets are identical** — the same strings moved from the component into the pure module. No Chinese literal was edited or retyped.

## Checks run

- `node --test tests/unit/composer-attachment-announcements.test.mjs` — red, green and mutation as above.
- Full suite on the branch vs `main` `04621bb`: **1809 tests / 1770 pass / 32 fail / 7 skipped** vs **1804 / 1765 / 32 / 7**, with the same 28 failing files on both sides (baseline measured on the same `04621bb` tree; failing-file set compared).
- Not run: `hvigorw test`, device/emulator — no ArkTS toolchain or screen reader in this environment.

**What type of PR is this?**
/kind bug

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:
Internal-branch counterpart: #871. It originally used the same squashed 92dfe825 commit; #871 is now rebased onto main 64d37d7a at 65a6ff9a to pick up the read-only CI fixture fix. The attachment patch is unchanged. #462 remains open at its older head; use #871 for current CI evidence. No gate has been skipped or overridden.

An image pasted/uploaded into a room could fail with `The source is private to a different audience` before reaching the model. Uploads granted only the uploader, while source visibility requires all people already in the room to be authorized.

- Preserve the original #462 fix: record the current room member audience on new uploads, without weakening source_visible_in_room or task/image binding checks.
- Recognize `research` as a retired built-in agent in migrated rooms, alongside the existing legacy IDs. This restores visibility of existing image, message and document sources through the shared `people_in_room` / `source_visible_in_room` check without editing their ACLs. Existing `person` identities and the current principal remain people; this does not register or reactivate a research executor.
- If an actually restricted older upload or another restricted source cannot be read, keep the denial and provide a Chinese instruction to check sharing permissions or re-upload an attachment in the current conversation. Do not copy the internal English exception into the reply.
- Do not retroactively grant access to existing uploads or people who join later. Other-room access, other-principal access, revocation and byte-integrity checks remain enforced.
- Extend the original regression with actual PNG-byte checks, later-member denial, different linked-room denial and a real task.run failure/recovery-instruction check for a legacy private upload.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
Fixes #453
Fixes #839 (the reproduced source-audience failure; this does not claim that every model supports vision).

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：

Squashed head: 92dfe825148e87cee25962d25ff42454afdfe03a; single commit above main merge-base 34f30d96e38e5d4e8391ea6afe89961d56d86da2. Original author huben is preserved. - Red/green regression: before adding `research` to LEGACY_AGENT_IDS, an existing private PNG in a migrated room fails the expected people/audience check; the same real EngineService/Attachments/EngineStore test now pins its source and returns identical PNG bytes. The old allowed_actor_ids remains uploader-only. A real Person named research remains a person and its access is denied.
- Focused attachment/access regressions: **9 passed, 27 deselected**, exit 0 (Python 3.12, local orbit-2368-import-2412 test venv, candidate src/tests on PYTHONPATH).
