pr:466.body:
Fixes #451 — 底部导航的两个标签对读屏只念「对话」「发现」，没有角色、也没有选中态。

## 改动

`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/components/HomeBottomNav.ets:49-66`（对话 tab）与 `:67-86`（发现 tab）：每个 tab 的 `Column` 上补三行——

```ets
.accessibilityGroup(true)   // 图标 + 文字合并成一个被播报的节点
.accessibilityLevel('yes')  // 该节点保持可聚焦
.accessibilityText(this.activeIndex === 0 ? '对话，标签页，已选中' : '对话，标签页，未选中')
```

选中态直接绑在 `activeIndex` 上（`:58` / `:79`），没有引入新状态；`.onClick(() => this.onSwitchTab(0|1))` 原样不动，布局、尺寸、图标切换逻辑一行未改。

## 为什么这样修

`HomeBottomNav.ets` 原本 88 行内没有任何可访问属性（`grep -c accessibilityText` = 0）：每个 tab 是自绘 `Column` + `Text`，选中与否只体现在填充/描边图标上，读屏拿不到「这是标签页」和「我在哪一页」。会话页 `pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets:3998-4001` 与发现页 `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:9325-9335` 各渲染一次，唯一条件是键盘收起 / `homeBottomNavVisibleNow()`，release 可达、无 debug 闸门；`entryability/EntryAbility.ets:660-661` 首启即进这条壳。因此补名、补角色、补状态。

## 测试（`tests/unit/home-bottom-nav-a11y.test.mjs`，新增 3 条）

先红后绿，命令均为 `node --test tests/unit/home-bottom-nav-a11y.test.mjs`：

1. **红**（组件仍是 main `9eea155` 的版本）：`ℹ tests 3 / pass 0 / fail 3`——两个 tab 的 `accessibilityText` / `accessibilityGroup` 都缺失，`accessibilityLevel('yes')` 计数为 0。
2. **绿**（本 PR `77b4e74`）：`ℹ tests 3 / pass 3 / fail 0`。
3. **变异**：把对话 tab 的名字改成常量 `'对话，标签页'`（去掉选中态分支）→ `pass 2 / fail 1`（`the 对话 tab announces its role and selection state` 变红）→ 还原 → `pass 3 / fail 0`。

测试断言的是结构而不是某一行文本：从每个 `Text('对话'|'发现')` 到该 tab 自己的 `.onClick` + `})` 之间，必须出现 `accessibilityGroup(true)`、可访问名里含标签文字 + `标签页` + `已选中`/`未选中` + `activeIndex === 0|1`，并保持 `onSwitchTab(0|1)` 仍在同一块内。

## 非目标 / 风险 / 回滚

- 非目标：不改布局、不换图标、不改切换逻辑、不新增组件、不做导航结构重构。
- 风险：低。纯增量属性，最坏情况是读屏文案多一行，视觉与交互零变化。
- 回滚：revert 本 PR 即可，无数据迁移、无配置项、无新增依赖。

## 没跑

`hvigor` 构建、Hypium、真机/TalkBack（沙箱无 ArkTS 工具链与设备）。相关文件 `tests/unit/ai-generated-label.test.mjs` 在本分支与 main 上都有同一条既有失败（`HTML current and historical replies keep one visible disclosure…`），与本次改动无关。

pr:474.body:
## What & why

Issue #353 asks for a WeChat-style "新消息" experience. The bot review on the
issue correctly found that the floating "↓" button already exists
(`showJumpToLatest` / `jumpToLatest`), so this PR implements only the part that
was actually missing:

- **Unread boundary.** When the reader leaves the bottom of the list, the last
  settled row is recorded. A live stream row is skipped on purpose: when it
  commits it becomes a different row id, and the finished reply must still
  count as new.
- **"新消息" divider.** The first assistant reply after that boundary carries a
  blue "新消息" divider (rendered inside its `ListItem`, so list indices used by
  `scrollToIndex` stay stable).
- **"↓ 新消息" button.** The existing floating button now shows the unread label
  and count (capped at `99+`), plus an accessibility label. With no unread
  replies it stays the plain "↓" as before.
- **Clearing.** Reaching the first unseen reply advances the boundary (the
  divider moves to the next unseen one); jumping to the latest or reaching the
  bottom clears the state. Switching room/topic or changing account resets it.

Nothing changes when the user is at the bottom: the list keeps auto-following
and no hint appears.

## Tests

New `tests/unit/digitalmate-unread-indicator.test.mjs` covers the three states
from the issue (at bottom / reading history / returning to the page), the
stream-row edge case, divider advancement and jump clearing.

`gateway-cloud-ui.test.mjs` loads the new helpers because it exercises
`setFollowLatest`/`render` in isolation.

```
node --test tests/unit/gateway-cloud-ui.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-pending-card-in-stream.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-topic-async.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-notifications.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-stream-presentation.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-unread-indicator.test.mjs
# 184 tests, 184 pass
```

The full `tests/unit/*.test.mjs` run has 5 failures that are environmental on
this machine (missing Playwright browser binaries; `EPERM: fsync` in the
worktree for the AGC SMS tests) and unrelated to this change.

**Not verified on a HarmonyOS device** (no build/device available here), so no
screenshot/recording is attached. Please run the ArkTS check and a device smoke
test before merge.

Fixes #353

## 决定：URL 边界与 #408 同构（方案 a），另补回基线本来就排除的 `]` 和 `}`

执行过程提取来源链接时，采用 #408 在 `CloudMessage.ets:143` 定下的那条边界——`https?:\/\/` 后不允许空白、引号、尖括号、`(`/`)` 以及 CJK/全角标点区段（`\u2000-\u206f`、`\u3000-\u303f`、`\u3400-\u4dbf`、`\u4e00-\u9fff`、`\uff00-\uffef`）。理由：`brief()` 遮的是同一类工具文本，本函数从同一份 `step.text` 里取链接，两处边界一旦分叉，同一句中文里的同一个 URL 会在遮罩面和点击面得到两个不同结果。

在这条边界上只有三处**为「可点击」服务**的差异，都写进了代码注释：

1. **补回 `]` `}`**：基线原类 `[^\s"'<>\]\}]+` 本来就排除这两个字符，而 `#408` 的遮蔽类省掉了它们。遮蔽时多带一个字符无害；这里要把 URL 交给 `openLink`，`见 [https://example.com/a] 结束` 就会点开 `https://example.com/a]`（404）。所以边界用「#408 的类 + `\]` `\}`」。
1b. **CJK 汉字留在地址里**（评审 High，已在 `376d004` 修）：#408 的类停在中日韩汉字上，那对**遮蔽**是对的（它替换字节），但对**要打开的链接**会把 `https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/中文` 砍成站点根 `https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/`（实测），这比「吞一句正文」更糟。所以地址里允许 CJK 汉字、只以 CJK/全角**标点**收尾——这正是气泡自动链接 `CloudMarkdown.ets:75` 已经在用的同一套切法。标注一句残余：`https://example.com/a其中3条`（汉字紧贴 ASCII 且无标点）仍会被吞进地址，与气泡行为一致，属已知取舍。
2. **成对括号回接**：边界把 `(` 整组切掉，而维基式地址 `https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Function_(mathematics)` 的括号属于地址。这里在边界之后仅回接**配平**的括号组（含嵌套）；不配平的 `(`/`)` 仍留在地址外。
3. **ASCII 句末标点**：`.,;:!?*` 不属于地址（`。`、`，` 已由区段排除）。尾部连续剥掉；路径里的 `/`、`%`、`=`、`&`、`#`、`?` 不动（有测试钉住）。`https://x.com/a?` 这类空查询会被剥成 `https://x.com/a`，打开的是同一页面，判断为可接受。

没有把 `CloudMessage.ets` 里的字符类抽成共享常量：该文件正被 #408 占用，本轮不碰（这是本轮唯一的重复，注释里写明指向 `CloudMessage.ets:143`）。

## 改了什么

- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/CloudHome/CloudExecutionViewModel.ets`：`executionResources()` 的链接提取改用上述边界，并在入结果集合前做配平括号回接与句末标点裁剪；`seen` 去重、`titles` 映射（查不到时回退到未修剪的原始匹配）、文件路径提取、其他规则都不变。
- `tests/unit/cloud-execution-view.test.mjs`：新增 6 个测试（边界、括号、合法 URL 语法、去重计数、文本紧邻中文、`]`/`}` 包裹），**没有改动任何既有断言**（diff 里 `^-[^-]` = 0）。

修好后：来源行展示与点击打开的 URL 一致；同一 URL 带不同尾部标点只算一个来源。

## 可达链与单一数据通路（release 路径）

- 渲染：`CloudMessageCard.ets:392-405` → `onOpenProcessLink(link.url)`；详情面板 `Index.ets:1996-2001` → `openProcessLink(item.url)`
- 打开：`Index.ets:1927-1938`，只校验 `/^https?:\/\//` 就 `host.openLink(url)`
- 计数：`CloudExecutionViewModel.ets:237`（`executionWebSourceCount` 内部 `flatMap(step => executionResources(...))`）、`:254-256`（`executionDetailLabel` 同样 `flatMap(executionResources(...))` + `new Set(...)`）——**没有第二条正则**，计数跟着同一个函数走

## 证据（`main@7fbaa28`，node v24.22.2）

命令：`node --test tests/unit/cloud-execution-view.test.mjs`

| 状态 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 未修（仅加断言） | `32 tests / 26 pass / 6 fail` |
| 修复后 | `32 tests / 32 pass / 0 fail` |
| M1 边界换回旧字符类 `[^\s"'<>\]\}]+` | 6 红（边界、括号、计数、中文路径/正文、括号注释、标题） |
| M2 `balancedParenTail()` 直接 `return end;` | 1 红（只有括号那条） |
| M3 去掉 `trimSourceUrl` 尾部剥离 | 1 红（只有边界那条） |
| M4 从边界里删掉 `\]` | 1 红（只有 `]`/`}` 包裹那条） |
| M5 从边界里删掉 `\u3000-\u303f`（中文标点区段） | 4 红（边界、计数、中文路径/正文、标题） |
| M6 去掉括号组里的 `#` 守卫 | 1 红（只有「括号注释不回接」那条） |
| 还原 | 30/30 绿 |

每次变异后都回读了被改行（例：M4 回读 `219: const SOURCE_URL: RegExp = /https?:\/\/[^\s"'<>()\}\u2000-…]+/g;`，M5 回读同位置只剩 `\u3400-\u4dbf`），确认改动真的落盘再跑测试。

既有 importers 回归：`cloud-chat.test.mjs` 157/157、`cloud-page-state.test.mjs` 22/22、`execution-status-header.test.mjs` 2/2。

未运行：`hvigorw` 构建、真机 Hypium、全量 `tests/unit`（只跑与本文件相关且会 import 它的用例）。

## 提交

- `a27aa09e545488bcca1ba8642449b7ef6f6679d2`：边界 + 括号 + 尾部标点 + 4 条测试
- `0766d416949d02bad9c8bdef6ed37be5ba28e017`：补回 `]`/`}` + 2 条测试（M4 的落点）
- `376d004493d853a5c3b95043ed660d04b0cca4b7`：CJK 汉字留在地址里（评审 High）+ 括号注释守卫 + 2 条测试（M5/M6 的落点）

42 个 open PR 里没有任何一个改动这两个文件（#408 占 `CloudMessage.ets`、#472 占 `A2uiHome/Index.ets`，都不重叠）。

pr:506.body:
The evaluation contract job can spend its entire timeout in Git checkout on the self-hosted runners. PR #501 hit repeated connection resets before its tests could start.

Download the exact source commit through the same GitHub archive route used by server regressions, allow time for a slow connection, and record that commit in the evaluation report when the archive has no Git metadata. Cap the download and all retries at 20 minutes, with a 10-second termination grace, so the 25-minute job has time for the tests and failure summary.

Refs #501.

Validation:

pr:509.body:
Refs #505. This PR covers the initial removal and module relocation phase of the broader backend refactoring plan. Class-level decomposition and delivery acceptance remain tracked by the RFC.

This PR targets the new `refactor/backend` integration branch, created at `8cc72139`. App connection implementations are retained. The `main` branch is unchanged.

DigitalMate business tasks now select one primary Agent. Product Teams, independent Agent delegation, cross-Agent review, Agent handoff and automatic Agent relay within a room are removed. WorkSwarm's executor-internal subagents, user questions, tool approvals, App connections and human collaboration remain available.

### Changes

- Replace business delegation with `user.ask` for questions to the user. The legacy `agent.ask` action accepts only the user/person recipient. Historical Team/delegation records remain readable but cannot execute, resume, reroute into active work or reuse a Team session.
- Keep internal subagent events separate from the primary reply. A child's completion or error cannot prematurely close the main stream; normal primary completion and errors still settle the task.
- Move the product backend to `backend/src/digitalmate_backend/{server,application,harness,workspace,memory,source,contracts,shared,adapters}`. Extract shared record/ID primitives and the location contract, update imports and package resources, and add import-boundary checks.
- Split wire types/resources into `packages/protocol`; `packages/core` keeps client helpers and depends on protocol. Update deployment, startup, packaging and CI paths.
- Move pinned WorkSwarm and agent-core sources to `vendor`. All **2,771 + 2,894 source files, Git object IDs and executable modes match the existing manifests**. The platform implementation is unchanged.
- Remove hidden phone Team entries and background Team recommendations. There is no new visible page or layout.

### Review guide and scope

The first commit removes behavior in the original layout; the second establishes the module layout. Most changed files are byte-identical vendor moves. See `docs/developer_guide/backend-modules.md` for responsibilities and `backend-module-map.csv` for old/new file locations and extraction reasons.

This is the deletion and initial module migration step. `EngineService`, models colocated with `EngineStore`, and grouped stage records remain explicit migration facades; this PR does not claim their full class-level decomposition. No plugin loader or JiuwenSwarm plugin integration is introduced. Existing database transaction boundaries and memory coordination are retained.

### Validation

- Migrated business regression selection: **447 passed, 132 subtests passed, 4 deselected**.
- Credential-free server/fake Gateway regression runner: **55 tests passed**.
- Primary-Agent boundaries, historical workflow rejection, artifacts and installable package tests: **59 passed, 9 subtests passed**.
- Location/artifact/room/primary-Agent regression selection: **56 passed**.
- `npm run typecheck` and Core tests: **24 passed**; focused phone skill tests: **18 passed**.
- Vendor/deployment path tests: **12 passed**; runtime wheel contracts: **4 passed**; import-linter: **3 contracts kept**.
- Backend wheel built from the final local project; imports and packaged resources verified from an extracted wheel outside the source tree. Vendor source verification and staged object/mode comparison passed. `git diff --check` passed.

Validation uses temporary local stores and fake Gateways. No live model, container deployment or phone-device acceptance was run. The inherited full Python suite is not green at base `8cc72139` (obsolete executor/settings fixtures and optional SDK dependencies); the focused suites above are the verified scope. Two pre-existing undefined-name findings remain in `_history_directory_key` (`project_key_for_directory`) and `_gate_confirm` (`device_change_arguments`), reproduced on the clean upstream baseline.

### Follow-up validation

At head `f9b04e47`, the HarmonyOS package built successfully and was installed in a separate local emulator; startup reached the login screen. Workflow contracts passed 14/14 and workflow-driver unit tests passed 51/51. No Nightly E2E case ran, no refactored cloud backend was deployed, and this does not establish end-to-end acceptance.

pr:513.body: ## What The aggregate-search renderer treated any `http(s)` address as a valid source, so `https://a.com@evil.test/y` rendered as a clickable source button and as the "打开原文" preview, while the WebView/browser lands on `evil.test`. The host that receives the click was never checked. ## Fix - `validSourceUrl()` now also rejects an address whose authority carries userinfo (`url.username || url.password`). It is the single gate behind three consumers: the card source anchor, `normalizedRelatedUrl()`, and the related-image filter — including the `coverUrl` fallback, which used to bypass it. - The aggregate post preview is built outside the template by `renderPostLink()`, which wrote the row URL into `href` with no check at all (`javascript:` included). It now goes through a named `safeExternalUrl()` helper using the repository's existing predicate from `workers/WaterfallPoolWorker.ets:429` (http(s) only, no userinfo in the authority). - An `@` inside the path (`https://a.com/x@evil.test`) is not userinfo and keeps working. The template string runs in the WebView, `renderPostLink()` is ArkTS: the template function is not reachable from native code, so the **same judgement exists once per runtime, as two implementations** — not one shared implementation. The divergence is listed below. ## Files - `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/html/HtmlAggregateSearchHomeRenderer.ets` **+12/−2** - `tests/unit/aggregate-search-link-userinfo.test.mjs` **+144/−0** (new independent test file; the existing `waterfall-renderer-interaction.test.mjs` is untouched and still passes) ## Evidence Red on the unmodified `main` tree (`8cc7213`), module byte-identical to main, only the new test file added: ``` $ node --test tests/unit/aggregate-search-link-userinfo.test.mjs ✖ validSourceUrl rejects a host that is not the one in the address bar ✖ the card source anchor is not rendered for a userinfo address ✖ normalizedRelatedUrl drops a userinfo address and keeps an ordinary one ✖ related markup filters a userinfo image and keeps an ordinary one ✖ the aggregate post link preview does not link to a userinfo address ℹ tests 5 / pass 0 / fail 5 ``` After the fix commits (`7ea044c8`, `4e44321e`): ``` $ node --test tests/unit/aggregate-search-link-userinfo.test.mjs ℹ tests 5 / pass 5 / fail 0 $ node --test tests/unit/waterfall-renderer-interaction.test.mjs ℹ tests 1 / pass 1 / fail 0 ``` Mutation checks (each reverted afterwards): | mutation | result | |---|---| | delete `if (url.username || url.password) return false;` | 4 template blocks red, native block green | | `renderPostLink`: `safeExternalUrl(postLinkUrl(block))` → `postLinkUrl(block)` | only `the aggregate post link preview does not link to a userinfo address` red | | `relatedMarkup`: `validSourceUrl(item.coverUrl) ? … : ''` → `item.coverUrl` | only `related markup filters a userinfo image and keeps an ordinary one` red (5/4/1) | Reverse guards: `https://a.com/x`, `http://a.com`, `https://a.com/x@evil.test` stay valid and still render; `javascript:alert(1)` is rejected on both halves; an ordinary `coverUrl` still renders. ## Known residual: the two implementations diverge on 4 malformed inputs A 24-case truth table run against both shipped implementations (job output, not copied code) found 4 divergences: | input | template `validSourceUrl` | native `safeExternalUrl` | |---|---|---| | `https://@evil.test/y` | true (empty userinfo; host evil.test, label also shows evil.test) | false | | `https://a.com%40evil.test/x` | **false** (WHATWG parser rejects the invalid host) | **true** | | `https:a.com/x` | true (normalised to `https://a.com/x`) | false | | `https://a.com\@evil.test/x` | true (`\` treated as `/`, host stays a.com) | false | Three are the native half being **stricter** (a rare malformed address loses its link; the safe direction). pr:519.body:
## What this fixes

`popupTitleFromUrl()` decided the popup title by searching the **whole URL** for provider names (`indexOf('google')`, `indexOf('paypal')`, `indexOf('checkout.stripe.com/')`, `indexOf('alipay')`), and `popupSubtitleFromTitle()` then gave every non-neutral title the subtitle **`安全确认页面`**. A page could therefore borrow a provider label with a longer domain label, a userinfo authority, a path or a query string, while the popup has no address bar to correct it:

```
https://notpaypal.com/                       -> "PayPal 确认"     / "安全确认页面"
https://www.paypal.com@evil.test/checkout    -> "PayPal 确认"     / "安全确认页面"
https://paypal.com:443@evil.test/checkout    -> "PayPal 确认"     / "安全确认页面"
https://evil.test/?ref=google                -> "Google Pay 确认" / "安全确认页面"
https://evil.test/checkout.stripe.com/pay/x  -> "支付确认"        / "安全确认页面"
```

Fixes #518.

## Change

One function in `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/components/HtmlHomeSurfaceView.ets`: parse the authority, reject anything that is not `http(s)`, has userinfo, is an IPv6 literal or ends with a dot, strip the port, then name a provider only when `host === domain || host.endsWith('.' + domain)`. The Google Maps branch keeps both the `maps.google.com` host and the `google.com` + `/maps/` path form; `checkout.stripe.com` stays an exact host. `popupSubtitleFromTitle()`, `shouldOpenWaterfallSourceExternally()` and the three call sites (`:181`, `:238`, `:832`) are untouched.

## Commits (4, two files, +174/−5)

1. `1460f3df` — test only (+142): slices `popupTitleFromUrl()` and `popupSubtitleFromTitle()` out of the shipped ArkTS file and executes them; red on unmodified `main`.
2. `ce401058` — the fix (+21/−5).
3. `cac7ba8b` — test only (+5): the first mutation run showed the userinfo guard was **not load-bearing**. `https://www.paypal.com@evil.test/checkout` fell back to the neutral title even with the `@` check deleted, because the allowlist alone rejects a host that still contains `@`. The case that does depend on the check is a userinfo authority **with a port**: port stripping runs after the userinfo test, so `paypal.com:443@evil.test` reduces to `paypal.com` and is labelled `PayPal 确认` again. Commit 3 pins both port forms, and deleting `authority.indexOf(@) >= 0` now fails exactly those two cases.
4. `3a3cb666` — follow-up after the bot review (+5 test, +2/−1 code): reject a backslash in the authority.

## Follow-up fix after bot review

`agent-ci-infra-bot` flagged that a special URL scheme rewrites `\` to `/`, so `https://evil.test\.paypal.com/` opens `evil.test` while the raw authority still ends with `.paypal.com` — the popup said `PayPal 确认`; `https://evil.test\.google.com/maps/x` said `Google Maps 路线` the same way. The repository already rejects such addresses in `workers/WaterfallPoolWorker.ets:429` (`[^/?#@\s\\]+`), so this file was looser than the existing policy.

The authority now also has to be free of backslashes before any provider is named. All three backslash shapes are pinned: on the previous head (`cac7ba8b`) the first two were red and `https://paypal.com\.evil.test/` was already neutral; it stays neutral, because the function does not model the backslash rewrite, it just refuses the shape.

## Evidence (all from a full unpack of `main` at `9cd6dc62`; the branch blobs match the API sha1)

```
# red: unmodified main tree + the final test file
node --test tests/unit/home-popup-title-host.test.mjs
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 3  ℹ fail 16

# green: head 3a3cb666 tree (same blobs)
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 19  ℹ fail 0

# red on the previous head cac7ba8b, before the backslash guard
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 17  ℹ fail 2
✖ https://evil.test\.paypal.com/          actual "PayPal 确认"      expected "内容详情"
✖ https://evil.test\.google.com/maps/x    actual "Google Maps 路线" expected "内容详情"

# M2 on 3a3cb666: delete the @ check
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 17  ℹ fail 2   (the two port-userinfo cases)

# M3 on 3a3cb666: host.endsWith('.paypal.com') -> host.endsWith('paypal.com')
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 18  ℹ fail 1   (https://notpaypal.com/)
```

The 16 red cases on `main` are the look-alike hosts (including `notpaypal.com`, `google.com.evil.test`, both port-userinfo forms, the backslash forms and `evil.test/checkout.stripe.com/pay/x`); the 3 passing ones are the real-provider reverse guard, the subtitle mapping guard and `https://evil.test/#checkout.stripe.com`, which is already neutral on `main` and is kept as a guard next to its red variant.

## Known behaviour change

`https://user@www.paypal.com/` changes from `PayPal 确认` to `内容详情`: any address carrying userinfo is now neutral. This is deliberate — the reader cannot see the userinfo, and the popup has no address bar.

- `https://checkout.stripe.com` (no path) changes from `内容详情` to `支付确认`: matching the exact host is wider than the old substring `checkout.stripe.com/`.
- `https://foo.checkout.stripe.com/pay` changes from `支付确认` to `内容详情`: subdomains of the checkout host are no longer accepted.
- `https://paypal.me/someone` changes from `PayPal 确认` to `内容详情`: the old substring match accepted the `paypal` token anywhere, and `paypal.me` is a different registrable domain. It is a genuine PayPal link domain, so adding it to the allowlist is a follow-up decision.
- `https://gpay.app/x` changes from `Google Pay 确认` to `内容详情`: `gpay.app` is not a Google host, so the old label was wrong; it now falls back to the neutral title.
- `https://paypal.com\` and `https://paypal.com\@evil.test/` fall back to `内容详情` even though a browser would open `paypal.com`: the contract is "any authority containing a backslash is neutral". The function refuses the shape instead of modelling the `\`-to-`/` rewrite, which is the conservative direction.

## Not covered here

- `https://evil.test%5c.paypal.com/` (percent-encoded backslash) still resolves to `PayPal 确认`: WHATWG decodes `%5C` inside the host, which makes the address invalid, so the popup loads nothing (fail-closed). Rejecting `%5c` case-insensitively in the authority would close it; recorded as a follow-up rather than added to this minimal fix.

- `https://www.google.com/search?q=1` keeps `Google Pay 确认 / 安全确认页面` before and after: the mapping is host-level, not path-level, and tightening it beyond the maps branch is a separate decision. `https://www.google.com/maps?q=1` and `https://www.google.com/maps` (path `/maps`, without the trailing slash) keep the same title for the same reason; that is pre-existing behaviour on `main`, not introduced here. Accepting them would take `path === '/maps' || path.startsWith('/maps/')`, which is a behaviour widening and is left for a follow-up issue.
- The popup still renders no URL or host anywhere (`popupUrl` is only assigned/loaded, never rendered as text), so the title remains the only site hint. Giving the sheet a host line is a follow-up.

## Who did what

- Issue text: Lead (Product did not deliver in this round).
- Failing test and the port-userinfo hardening: DigitalMate Test.
- Fix in `HtmlHomeSurfaceView.ets`: DigitalMate Dev-1.
- Integration, red/green/mutation runs and this PR: Lead.

Fixes #521

## What this changes

`deepSearchSourceHost()` in `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/html/HtmlHomeRenderer.ets` (`HTML_HOME_JS`, `:3749-3771`) derives the domain label rendered next to every deep-search citation (`:3856`). It used to strip the scheme and cut at the first `/`, so the label kept the URL userinfo, the port, the query string and the fragment:

```
https://alice:pw@example.com/a   ->  alice:pw@example.com   (rendered as the site name)
https://user@www.paypal.com/     ->  user@www.paypal.com
https://example.com?q=1          ->  example.com?q=1
https://example.com:8443/x       ->  example.com:8443
http://[::1]:8080/x              ->  [::1]:8080
```

The function now parses the authority in a single character pass: it ends at the first `/`, `?`, `#` **or `\`**, and TAB/LF/CR are dropped instead of being kept in the label (that is what a browser does with whitespace inside a URL). After that the userinfo is dropped at the last `@`, and the port is dropped, except that an IPv6 literal keeps its brackets. The scheme test is case-insensitive, and an empty or non-http(s) input yields `''` instead of the raw value.

Only this one function changed. `openWaterfallSource()` (`:3861`), the click path and the `title || url` fallback at `:3855` are untouched.

## Red first

```
cd <tree at upstream main 1432414e> && node --test tests/unit/deep-search-source-host.test.mjs
ℹ tests 20
ℹ pass 6
ℹ fail 14
```

Six positive cases stay green there, so the red is the assertions and not a broken load. The test slices the shipped `text()` and `deepSearchSourceHost()` out of the real `.ets` (brace matching that skips string literals and comments), strips the types and runs both in a `vm` context — no copy of the implementation and no assertion on the source text.

## Green on the head

```
cd <tree at 55df4a9a> && node --test tests/unit/deep-search-source-host.test.mjs
ℹ tests 20
ℹ pass 20
ℹ fail 0
```

Related page baseline: `tests/unit/waterfall-renderer-interaction.test.mjs` `1/1`.

Whole `tests/unit` suite, same checkout pair (measured on the 17-case revision of this branch, `d45838c1`):

| tree | tests | pass | fail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| main `1432414e` | 1699 | 1657 | 35 |
| head `d45838c1` | 1716 | 1674 | 35 |

The difference is exactly the new cases, and the failing set is byte-for-byte the same 28 files on both sides — all of them stop at `Cannot find module 'typescript'` / `'playwright'`, which this sandbox does not install and CI does.

## Follow-up fix after bot review

`agent-ci-infra-bot` raised one finding (F1, medium): the authority scan stopped only at `/`, `?` and `#`, so a crafted citation could label a host the click does not open — `https://evil.test\@example.com/x` was labelled `example.com`, and `https://example.com\@evil.test/` was labelled `evil.test`.

Fixed in two commits on this branch:

- `bac3c5a2` — adds the three cases (both `\@` directions, plus a TAB inside the host), test file only.
- `55df4a9a` — the scan now also breaks on `\` (char code 92) and skips TAB/LF/CR (9/10/13).

Verified against the previous head with the same 20-case file:

```
cd <tree at d45838c1>        ℹ tests 20  pass 17  fail 3
cd <tree at 55df4a9a>        ℹ tests 20  pass 20  fail 0
```

The three red cases on `d45838c1` are exactly the F1 cases, so the new assertions pin the gap rather than restating the fix.

## Mutation

Each mutation is one edit to the shipped `.ets`; the test file is unchanged.

| mutation | result |
| --- | --- |
| M1 — delete the two userinfo lines | `20 / 16 / 4` |
| M2 — remove the `\` break (char code 92) | `20 / 18 / 2` |
| M3 — remove the TAB/LF/CR skip | `20 / 19 / 1` |

Restoring each edit returns `20/20`. The four M1 reds are the userinfo cases, the two M2 reds are the `\@` cases, the single M3 red is the TAB case — so every branch of the rewrite is pinned by an assertion instead of being dead code.

## Not covered here

- `deepSearchSourceTitle` at `:3855` (`text(source && source.title) || url`) still falls back to the whole URL when a source has no title. That is a citation-title decision, not the host label, and it is left for a follow-up.
- A percent-encoded `%5c` in the authority is kept in the label as-is; such a URL does not open, so the label fails closed.
- The upstream source filter at `:3850` compares the scheme case-insensitively only in this function; a `HTTPS://…` source never reaches it today because the filter above is case-sensitive.

pr:536.body:
## What

Every self-hosted gate job now resolves `runs-on` from a `RUNNER_*` repository variable, keeping the current labels as a literal fallback:

```yaml
runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(vars.RUNNER_CI_NODE_UT || '["self-hosted","Linux","X64","dm-nodeut"]') }}
```

Changing which machine runs a job no longer needs a workflow edit or a pull request. Setting the variable applies to the next workflow run; jobs already running keep their assigned runner.

This branch now includes `main` after #526 consolidated `ut.yml` into `ci.yml`; the routing catalog follows the new `node-ut` / `hypium-ut` / `st` / `gate-report` jobs.

## Changes

- `.github/ci-runners.json`: job → variable → default-label catalog for all 15 self-hosted jobs.
- `scripts/ci-runners.mjs`: `list`, `set`, `reset`, `apply`; supports dry-run, comma lists, JSON arrays and runner groups.
- Converted `ci.yml` (`node-ut`, `hypium-ut`, `st`, `gate-report`), `code-check.yml`, `server-regression.yml`, `eval.yml`, `nightly.yml` and `bench.yml`. GitHub-hosted jobs are unchanged.
- `tests/unit/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs`: keeps each workflow fallback in sync with the catalog, and covers the CLI against a mock Actions variables API.
- `docs/developer_guide/ci.md`: usage, caveats and the full variable table.
- **Also:** `Eval contract (replay)` no longer runs on pull requests. The replay fixtures validate the eval harness, not the product, and its `actions/checkout` step repeatedly timed out on the self-hosted runner. It remains available on pushes to main (eval paths) and `workflow_dispatch`. Covered by a unit test so the PR trigger does not come back.

## Usage

```bash
node scripts/ci-runners.mjs list
node scripts/ci-runners.mjs set ci_node_ut self-hosted,Linux,X64,dm-utility
node scripts/ci-runners.mjs apply /tmp/runner-routing.json
node scripts/ci-runners.mjs reset --all
```

## Behavior and caveats

- With no variables set, behavior is unchanged: every default is the label set that was hard-coded before.
- Changing a default still needs a PR; switching machines does not.
- `pull_request_target` workflows execute the default branch's workflow file, so the runner-routing mechanism becomes effective on PRs once this merges.
- The target runner must already carry the configured labels (or belong to the named runner group).
- Changing variables needs repository admin; `--dry-run` previews the plan.

## Verification

- `node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs tests/unit/ascf-device/*.test.mjs tests/e2e/workflow/workflow.test.mjs`: 2526 tests, 2524 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed (after merging main).
- `actionlint` on the changed workflows: no new findings (only pre-existing shellcheck warnings).
- YAML parse check on all workflow files and `.github/ci-runners.json`.

  finalized turns, deduped by `trace_id`, with the board's per-call fields
  (`model`, `status`, `duration_ms`, `ttft_ms`, `tpot_ms`, token counts, `stream`). Cloud
  `task.profiling` model calls are attached by `task_id`, either before or after the local turn
  finalizes.
- **Reporter** (`entry`: `DigitalMateTelemetryReporter.ets`): HTTPS POST with the current Gateway
  session token and CA, 5 s debounce, exponential backoff, redirect refusal, bounded response.
  Missing endpoint, `401/403/404/405/501` and a rejected payload never enter the chat path.
- **Context**: trajectory now records coarse `region` (system region, e.g. `CN`) and `timezone`
  (`Asia/Shanghai`) plus `client_sent_at_ms`; no location permission, IP, SSID or device identifier.
- **Runtime**: `DigitalMateTaskRuntime` enables reporting from local config and stops it on logout;
  both turn and model-call reporting stay behind the existing “性能记录” opt-in.
- **Receiver** (`harness/personal-agent` `agent_bridge`): opt-in `POST /digitalmate/telemetry`
  that validates the contract and writes only normalized fields to a per-deployment SQLite store.

## Wire contract

`POST` JSON body, schema `digitalmate-client-metrics@1`, scope **`client-observed`**:

```json
{"schema":"digitalmate-client-metrics@1","scope":"client-observed",
 "environment":"adx-jiuwen-test-0","generated_at_ms":1762300000000,
 "turns":[{"trace_id":"tr-1-...","task_id":"task-...","request_id":"digitalmate-...",
   "action":"room.message","outcome":"completed","network_type":"wifi",
   "app_version":"x.y.z","region":"CN","timezone":"Asia/Shanghai",
   "message_chars":12,"started_at_ms":0,"client_sent_at_ms":0,"ended_at_ms":0,
   "attempts":1,"request_bytes":0,"response_bytes":0,
   "timings":{"tap_ms":0,"queued_ms":0,"dequeued_ms":0,"wire_send_ms":0,
              "ack_ms":0,"first_text_ms":0,"last_text_ms":0,
              "task_done_ms":0,"display_done_ms":0},
   "model_calls":[{"model":"DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017","status":"ok",
     "duration_ms":1200,"ttft_ms":300,"tpot_ms":12.5,
     "input_tokens":900,"output_tokens":120,"total_tokens":1020,"stream":true}]}]}
```

No message text, attachments, prompt/response content, credentials or local identifiers are sent.

## Receiver

`server_engine/engine_client_telemetry.py`, mounted from `create_app` only when the deployment sets
a directory:

| Variable | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `DIGITALMATE_TELEMETRY_DIR` | Enables the route and holds `client-observed.sqlite3`; unset means no route (the fail-closed client stops). |
| `DIGITALMATE_TELEMETRY_RETENTION_DAYS` | Retention for `received_at_ms`, default 30, clamped to 1..365. |
| `DIGITALMATE_TELEMETRY_EXPORT_TOKEN` | Enables the aggregate-only read route for the dashboard collector; unset means that route is 404. |

- Authorization mirrors `/digitalmate/ws`: Gateway mode requires a Bearer token and validates the
  Origin, and refuses `digitalmate-tool.`/`orp_` scoped credentials; otherwise `authorize_client`
  applies (loopback or `DIGITALMATE_ACCESS_TOKEN`).
- Strict validation: schema/scope, ≤20 turns per batch, ≤32 model calls per turn, ≤256 KiB body.
  Unknown keys are dropped, never stored; there is no path from a device field into
  `classified-production`.
- Idempotent by `(trace_id, task_id, request_id, started_at_ms)`, so a retried batch writes once and
  two devices whose local counters coincide cannot overwrite each other. Writes are normalized
  columns plus JSON; the raw request body is never kept.
- A client-claimed `environment` is **untrusted** and stored only as `client_environment` for
  diagnosis; the deployment identity is the store directory. Write failure → `503` (the device
  retries); invalid batch → `400` (the device drops it). An unwritable directory logs a warning and
  leaves the product service running without metrics.

### Aggregate read for the dashboard

Setting `DIGITALMATE_TELEMETRY_EXPORT_TOKEN` mounts `GET /digitalmate/telemetry/summary?days=N`
(default 7 days, clamped to the retention window). It accepts **only** that deployment secret
(constant-time compare) and refuses device `digitalmate-tool.`/`orp_` credentials, so a device
credential never reads aggregates. The response, `client-observed-aggregate@1`:

- `turns`/`outcomes`/`networks` — turn count, completion and network mix;
- `client_ttft` — click-to-first-text duration (count/avg/p50/p95);
- `end_to_end` — click-to-rendered duration;
- `segments` — the eight stages derived from consecutive client marks;
- `models` — calls, successes, streamed calls, TTFT/TPOT distributions and token sums per model.

It contains no `trace_id`, `task_id`, `request_id`, message content or client-claimed
environment label; the dashboard collector labels each deployment from its own configuration.

## Local configuration (never committed)

`app_config.json` → `digitalmate`:

```json
{"telemetryUrl":"https://<same host as url>/digitalmate/telemetry",
 "telemetryEnvironment":"adx-jiuwen-test-0"}
```

`telemetryUrl` absent disables reporting. Cross-host, plain-HTTP, query or fragment URLs and
malformed environment labels are rejected at startup by both the app and `sync-app-config.mjs`.
No token from the test-environment announcement is stored in the repository; each device keeps
using the Gateway login credential it already has.

## Trust boundary

Device data is advisory only. It is sent as `client-observed` and must never be merged into the
trusted `classified-production` snapshot, which continues to come exclusively from LiteLLM
`/spend/logs/v2` with `traffic_type=production`. `request_id` is included for correlation only and
must be stripped from any published dashboard snapshot.

## Verification

- `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-client-metrics.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-telemetry-reporter.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-trajectory.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-config.test.mjs tests/unit/sync-app-config.test.mjs` — 49 passed.
- Related suites (`digitalmate-notifications`, `digitalmate-stop-control`, `digitalmate-task-runtime-memory`, `digitalmate-shared-binding`, `digitalmate-device-st`, `digitalmate-profiling`, `digitalmate-gateway-auth`) — 156 passed.
- `pytest tests/test_client_telemetry.py` (personal-agent `agent_bridge`) — 21 passed, covering
  normalization, idempotency, retention, the 404/400/413/403/202 route behaviour, Gateway and
  private auth modes, the unwritable-directory fallback, and the aggregate's TTFT/segment/model
  arithmetic, window, privacy and export-token behaviour.
- Four pre-existing failures in `test_bridge.py`, `test_bridge_startup_imports.py` and
  `test_bridge_shutdown.py` on this branch are unrelated (`Bridge.dispatch_guest` and
  `_claude_hooks` do not exist here; one fixture needs `server_engine` installed).
- Full `node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs` is not fully runnable in this worktree: tests that need
  the untracked `node_modules` (`typescript`, `playwright`) fail on `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`
  independently of this change.
- No device build, live upload, deployment to the five test environments or production validation
  has been performed.

## Dashboard side

Companion PR: `agent-CI-Infra/dashboard#28`. It reads the aggregate into a separate
`client-observed-metrics@1` file and a separate 「端侧观测」 tab: KPI tiles, end-to-end segment
bars, an environment comparison table and a model comparison table with an environment selector.
It shares no file, schema or rendering path with the `classified-production` view, publishes no
identifiers or message content, and labels environments from the deployment configuration rather
than from device claims. A deployment that cannot be read on a run reuses its last record marked
as a historical snapshot.

## Still required

1. Deploy the receiver to the test environments with `DIGITALMATE_TELEMETRY_DIR` and
   `DIGITALMATE_TELEMETRY_EXPORT_TOKEN`, and verify the phone → store → dashboard path end to end.
2. Merge the companion dashboard change.

Keep this PR in **draft** until the receiver is deployed and verified end to end.

主屏任务浮层 `WaterfallTaskOverlay.ets` 的三个可点控件，父节点都有 `.accessibilityText(...)` 标签，但**父节点内部的纯装饰图标**没标 `.accessibilityLevel('no')`，读屏念完标签后会紧接着再停一个「图片/符号」（ArkUI 里 `.accessibilityText` 不合并子树）。同文件另外三处（`statusIcon()` 的两个图标、预览行的 `chevron_down`）已经标了 `'no'`，所以这是漏标，不是新规矩。

## 问题

读屏在每个返回按钮后面多停一个「图片」节点，同一个控件被念两遍；心上事列表里每条记录后面也一样多一个停靠点。父节点已经有可读名，缺的是把纯装饰的箭头图标移出无障碍树：

- `pages/A2uiHome/components/common/A2uiButtonView.ets` 的 `shape === 'back'` 分支：`Button` 内 `Image($r('app.media.icon_back'))`，父 `Button` 已有 `.accessibilityText(label || '返回')`。该组件被 6 个返回按钮复用（`ComposioAuthPage`、`HomePage`、`TrainPresalePanel`、`ConfigPage`、`A2uiHome/Index.ets`、`SharedWaterfallCard`）。
- `pages/A2uiHome/components/BimDetailPage.ets` 的 `Header()`：44×44 返回 `Stack` 内 `Image(icon_back)`，父 `Stack` 已有 `.accessibilityText('返回心上事列表')`。
- `pages/A2uiHome/components/BimHomePage.ets` 的 `@Builder RecordRow`：记录行尾部的装饰箭头（`.rotate({ angle: 180 })`），父 `Row` 已有拼接的 `.accessibilityText(...)`，**每条记录**都多一个「图片」停靠点。

三处 `Image($r('app.media.icon_back'))` 各追加 `.accessibilityLevel('no')`，父节点的 `accessibilityText`、`onClick`、尺寸、颜色、事件一律不动。`accessibilityLevel('no')` 只把组件自身移出无障碍树（`'no-hide-descendants'` 才隐子树），与本文件族既有写法一致（`WaterfallTaskOverlay.ets` 的 `statusIcon()` 等）。

## 测试

pr:563.body:
Fixes #449

## 问题

英文设备的用户走的是同一条云端连接状态链路，但连接横幅的文本与动作按钮都是硬编码中文：读屏聚焦横幅时整块播报未翻译的中文状态（例如「正在连接云端…」），英文用户看到的按钮是「重新加载」「正在连接」「立即重试」，既读不懂当前状态，也不知道按下去会重连。连接链路其余文案都经 `digitalmateUserFacingError()` / `digitalmateBusinessError()` 收敛成可读句子，唯独这一处把中文字面量直接渲染进 `Text` 与 `Button`，没有任何语言分支。

## 修法

- `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets`：`digitalmateConnectBanner()` 与 `digitalmateUserFacingError()` 增加可选 `language` 参数（默认 `'zh-CN'`），`en` 开头（`/^en\b/i`）输出英文，其它语言逐字节维持现状；新增 `digitalmateConnectionActionLabel(kind, language)` 统一产出三个按钮文案（`reload` / `connecting` / `retry`）。`digitalmateBusinessError()` 的透传分支保持原样——服务端业务原文不翻译。
- `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionBanner.ets`：组件字段初始化器里取一次 `digitalmateClientContext().language`（不进 `aboutToAppear`，既有 banner fixture 不受影响）（仓库现有唯一语言入口，与 `model/DigitalMateDeviceContext.ets` 同源），把该语言传给横幅文案、`accessibilityText` 与三个按钮文案；显隐条件、重试逻辑、样式与 5 秒 slow 定时器不变。
## 未纳入本 PR

- 客户端自有文案经调用方传入、仍未英文化的一批：`'正在同步云端会话…'`（会话加载中）与网关恢复态的两句 `'正在恢复云端连接…'` / `'云端连接暂不可用，请重试连接'`（`pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets` 的 `beginGatewayRecover()` 与横幅入参）。这句是客户端自有文案，但走的是 `digitalmateBusinessError()` 的业务消息透传分支，因此本 PR 的 `language` 参数管不到它——英文设备在这一态仍会看到中文状态，按钮已是英文 `Reload`。
- 本轮不改的原因：该文件同时被多项未合入 PR 占用（本 PR 开题时抓取的占用快照命中 `#334`、`#391`、`#441`、`#474`、`#481`、`#555`），改它会与这些 PR 直接冲突。
- 已建独立 tracking issue 跟进：见 #564（含改法、验收标准与前置占用清单）。
- 范围确认：`#563` 的生产代码只改 `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` 与 `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionBanner.ets`，不碰 `pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets`。

- **二次本地化兜底（F1）**：调用方会先把错误本地化成中文再存进 `this.error`（`pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets`、`DigitalMateConversationBinding.ets`），横幅再以英文渲染时原本会原样透出中文。现在 `DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` 持有本模块**自有文案**的 zh→en 对照（10 条 + `正在重新连接云端（第 N 次）…` 正则），英文路径先查表再走正则；`state === 'open'` 的业务透传分支只在命中自有文案时才替换，**服务端 / 模型原文照旧原样透传**。英文路径同时把 `证书|certificate|SSL|TLS` 提到 `网络|…` 之前，避免 TLS 失败被报成「网络不可用」；中文路径的判定顺序一字未改。
- 共 2 个生产文件，不动 `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConversationBinding.ets`（被 #481 占用），不碰 `cloud-adapter/.../CloudMarkdown.ets`（#547 / #403）。

## 可达性

1. `entryability/EntryAbility.ets` 冷启动 `loadContent('pages/A2uiHome/Index')`。
2. `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets` 的 `CloudConversationBody()` 在 `cloudBackend === 'digitalmate'` 时渲染 `DigitalMateConversationBinding`；该后端是默认值（`resources/rawfile/app_config.example.json` 的 `"cloudBackend": "digitalmate"`）。
3. `DigitalMateConversationBinding` 的 `build()` 里 `if (this.state !== 'open' || this.error)` 渲染本组件，而 `state` 初值为 `'closed'`——冷启动第一帧横幅必然出现；断开、超时、重连中也走同一分支。
4. 全屏会话页 `pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets` 也直接使用同一组件，两个入口共用这份文案。

## 测试

先红后修：`tests/unit/connection-banner-bilingual.test.mjs` 把 `DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` 去掉类型后在 vm 里**真执行**（不复制实现），并静态守卫组件装配。

pr:588.body:
## Summary

Makes the runtime dependencies that DigitalMate never starts optional. The image now installs only what the default path uses; everything else lives behind an extra and is imported on first use.

This PR folds #584 (transformers) into #588 so the dependency trim lands as one review.

| Component | Removed from default install | Now behind |
| --- | --- | --- |
| agent-core | transformers | `openjiuwen[local-models]` |
| workswarm | python-telegram-bot, discord.py, slack-bolt, dingtalk-stream, wecom-aibot-sdk, lark-oapi | `workswarm[im-channels]` |
| workswarm | google-genai | `workswarm[google-ai]` |
| workswarm | playwright | `workswarm[browser]` |
| workswarm | chromadb, faiss-cpu | `workswarm[vector-backends]` |
| workswarm | google-adk, google-api-core | dropped — nothing imports or needs them |
| agent-core | pymilvus | `openjiuwen[milvus]` |
| agent-core | anthropic, dashscope | `openjiuwen[model-providers]` |
| agent-core | matplotlib, mermaid-py | `openjiuwen[charts]` |
| agent-core | pyoxigraph | `openjiuwen[ontology]` |
| agent-core | docx2txt, cacheout | dropped — nothing imports them |

## Why the default path stays intact

- Reachability was checked by parsing every module-level import in both packages and doing a transitive closure from the real entry points (`jiuwenswarm.server.app_agentserver`, `jiuwenswarm.server.agent_ws_server`, `jiuwenswarm.gateway.app_gateway`). After these changes the closure contains **zero** module-level imports of any removed package.
- `transformers` is used only by local-model features (guardrail local backend, transformers-backed progressive retrieval, RL/SFT tokenizer helpers), all of which already import it lazily. The only eager import (the veRL SFT dataset tokenizer types) is now behind `TYPE_CHECKING`.
- `gateway/channel_manager/__init__.py` resolves IM channel classes through PEP 562 `__getattr__`, so a channel SDK is imported only when that channel is first used. `app_gateway` already imported each platform module lazily.
- `image_tools.py` imports `google.genai` inside `_invoke_gemini_vision`.
- `checkpointer/inmemory.py` had an unused `pymilvus` import on the startup path; it is removed. `MilvusConnector` imports `pymilvus.utility` at its three call sites.
- `dashscope_embedding.py` now imports the SDK only when it builds a request. This matters because `openjiuwen.core.retrieval.lazy_load._load_openai()` imports that module for every OpenAI/VLLM embedding lookup, so a module-level `import dashscope` would have made DashScope mandatory for OpenAI embeddings.
- `mermaid` was already behind a `try/except ModuleNotFoundError` guard; `matplotlib` is only imported inside functions.
- `agentdescent` and `gitcode-api` stay base dependencies: `openjiuwen.rsi` imports them at module level, and that package is loaded from the workswarm auto-harness path.
- `openjiuwen[all]` / `all-vector` now include the new extras so a full install still installs what used to be unconditional.
- `harness/UPSTREAM.json` records every customized file and the recomputed imported Git trees for both components.

Behaviour change to note: a deployment that enables an IM channel, the Gemini vision backend, a local model or an external vector backend must install the matching extra; nothing else changes. The DigitalMate image builds only the base wheels, so image/video generation continues to use the HTTP-based `visual_gen`/`video_gen` paths, not the DashScope SDK.

## Verification

- `python -B harness/verify_sources.py` — both components OK (manifests, overrides, recomputed imported Git trees).
- Module-level import audit from the startup entry points — 0 imports of the removed packages.
- `python -B -m unittest discover -s harness/tests` — merged with current `main`; the only errors in this sandbox are four `test_tool_index_reuse` cases importing `pydantic`, which is not installed here. Those tests are unrelated to this change.
- Docker-level wheel build was not run locally (the environment has no working build backend); CI/image build will exercise it.

pr:627.body:
## Summary
Fixes #581 — same-conversation count pacts (“问满十遍…”) and their fulfillment/count were recomputed from a short history window, so after a few quiet minutes the assistant treated an already-fulfilled pact as pending and restarted the count at 1.

This change keeps an authoritative per-conversation `SessionPact` on disk under the workspace (`session_pacts.json`), reconciles it from the **full** thread task history (not `WINDOW_TURNS` / `THREAD_TURNS`), and injects a `[session_pact]` block into every turn’s brief so the model must honour the stored count and fulfillment. Higher persisted counts never roll back on a truncated re-scan.

## Changes
- New `engine_session_pacts` module: parse Chinese/English establish phrases, count multi-trigger hits in one message, durable `PactStore`, `reconcile` + brief injection + `after_run` refresh
- Wired via `engine_stage.MODULES` (after `engine_todos`) using `replace_registered_hooks`
- Allowlist entry in `test_engine_memory_changes` PROVIDERS scan
- Unit tests for parse/count/reconcile/persist/no-rollback/fulfilled brief

## Verification
```bash
cd harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge
PYTHONPATH=tests python -m pytest tests/test_engine_session_pacts.py -v
# 5 passed
```

- Product name in prose: DigitalMate
- **Do not merge from this bot** — leave for maintainer review

Fixes #358

pr:659.body:
When explicitly configured for a trusted Linux realm, the Runtime can identify a lost process that owned an open question. A duplicate submission checks the persisted scope, claim generation and question. It transitions that exact run to unknown only after a same-domain kernel absence check and successful Store compare-and-set. It does not repeat inference or tool execution. A live competitor, changed namespace, historical claim without proof, or unsupported configuration cannot authorize that transition.

On delivery Linux/Python 3.13.16, 17 focused tests passed, including real fork, killed subprocess and live competitor, answer-before-CAS, stale generation, permission ambiguity, and default behavior. Broader independent review pending. Related to #649 and #656.

pr:660.body:
The frozen phone quote selector currently has no safe published-reference read operation. This accepted first slice adds Gateway-owned read-only resolution for exact published {room_id,message_id} and legacy {task_id,part} selectors. It calls public Runtime.read_submission with the verified owner and published M, checks M/S/R, part eligibility and exact authoritative text, and returns only the selected text plus checked identities.

Unknown/restarted-away mappings fail unavailable; cross-owner/principal/room and client authority fields fail before history access. Modern/legacy selectors of the same source are aliases. EARLY remains the selected source even when the frozen caller's follows points at a later turn. No ID-prefix decoding, other component private state, lease, source-version token or quote submission is introduced. Only projection.py gains an additive public read operation; shared Gateway dispatch, navigation/protocol, Runtime/Router/Manager/Store and their types remain unchanged. The branch is rebased onto merged #640. Production quoted task.create stays UNSUPPORTED.

Validation at integrated architecture base 1ae184231f49f5791f1bc534f3f06574b78b4978 (includes #640): all 55 Gateway UT and 53 Gateway ST pass, zero skips (0.284s and 14.445s) in the pinned delivery image. This includes 11 new UT and 7 new ST covering real public Runtime/SQLite publication, same-S source/part distinction, wrong scope, missing source, facade reopen with empty projection, authorized non-home room publication from public history, substituted history identities/text/type, UTF-8 output limits, rich-reader field isolation and disabled production submission. Resolver reads add zero model/classifier work. Existing artifact WSS/Core, attachment, date, replay, disconnect and authority revocation regressions also pass with their controlled providers.

Independent review found an admitted-state gap; a real Runtime test pauses on_admitted before claim and reproduced RED, then passed after accepting admitted asks. Replies still need a completed authoritative answer and published result. The updated code was freshly rerun; peer review of the fix was requested but the team tool hit its thread limit, so no independent fixed-head approval is claimed.

Authorization is the existing trusted AccountAuthority call path, not construction of a VerifiedScope dataclass. Revocation observed before request authorization denies; later revocation can race with reads/admission; delivery reauthorization can suppress a response without undoing acceptance. The output has a64KiB UTF-8 ceiling, but the unchanged history facade reads the full record first; no bounded-allocation claim is made. Publication is transient and is not rebuilt by guessing IDs after restart. This is a component read slice, not phone quote acceptance or atomic admission. #657's proposal is separately revised to remove a mandatory lease, settle retry/alias/follows correlation, and leave atomic sealing plus both execution paths for later owner-approved work.

pr:663.body:
A JSON-valid but structurally invalid `ask_user` call could fail inside the pinned rail before a durable question was opened. Validate the bound declaration and actual single-select `Question` invariants before dispatch, preserving the original tool-call ID and the existing bounded rejection so inference can correct the call. The bound schema is not silently narrowed; supported `card_id`, `multi_select: false`, header and option descriptions remain accepted. An explicit schema restriction is still enforced, and multi-select remains unsupported.

The updated tests cover supported metadata, invalid and whitespace card IDs, explicit schema restrictions, original call identity, and bounded retry. The new Runtime test exercises invalid card → corrected legacy metadata → answer on the original run; it is **not yet run**.

At head `8f124f67eb7125e836a72c53f9d028c31edef16c`, six focused tests passed using an offline AST-isolated boundary driver on Python 3.12.13 with actual SDK/public types; this is not full Core/Runtime integration. Both review regressions were reproduced before the fix. The normal test-module import failed because the local environment lacks `pdfminer` (no test methods ran). The supported remote Python 3.13.16 full Harness/Runtime gate remains **unrun for this head**; earlier 16-test results apply only to the prior head. No local server, container, emulator or live model was started. Independent review and integrated verification remain open.

pr:665.body:
Selecting EARLY versus LATER within one product session previously changed only routing and produced no selected-quote distinction in model input. This core slice adds optional canonical QuoteSelection(source_submission_id, part, expected_sha256), with no submitter-supplied source text, owner, room or S/R. The expected digest is SHA-256 of the exact authoritative selected UTF-8 text, not a preview or a permission token.

Manager owns validation/policy and canonical M identity. Router uses the originating M to choose S. Inside Store's existing BEGIN IMMEDIATE admission transaction, duplicate M is reconciled first; a new M then rechecks the owner-scoped source M/S/R, part, digest and selected text before committing its binding and sealed typed input. A nullable quote_manifest independently binds quote identity, with old rows defaulting to no quote. The run start snapshot carries unchanged user text plus a versioned quote data envelope. Existing HostAPI context.read and direct-model execution consume that same sealed view; Core/HostAPI implementation did not need a second quote path.

The transaction checks rollback, source changes around admission, exact same-M replay/conflicts, concurrent M, parent disappearance and old data. Ask references the original visible text, not an embedded earlier quotation; reply requires a completed answer. Quote plus attachments and competing explicit routes are rejected in this first text-only scope. Current-call owner/read authorization remains required: an M or digest never authenticates a caller, and cross-owner replay/context reads fail. Gateway wire/room/publication code is untouched and legacy quoted wire sends remain disabled. Active-window/paged-history lookup limitations are separately retained in #660.

Execution evidence and open gate:

- Before the instruction to move execution to adx-jiuwen-test-3, all 419 server tests passed, zero skips,43.200s at b933d8c9 on base1ae18423. Those tests used an ephemeral local Docker delivery image, NOT remote gVisor. They include real Runtime, actual Core/HostAPI and direct ModelGateway over real loopback HTTP with controlled providers, plus existing ask_user/Stop/tool denial/attachments/Office regressions.
- The branch is now rebased on architecture f25f53595279742c5e7e812127f395db1ebc8426 (#661/#662 included). Integrated server execution on that head has NOT run. Per user direction, no further local server/test was started; the lead owns remote gVisor execution and independent review. Static Python parsing and diff checks pass.
- The previous long-lived own dm-room-637-independent QA container was identity-checked, manifest-frozen, stopped and retained with state plus a hashed offline copy. Other live endpoints/devices were untouched.

Implementation is split into admission, Runtime consumption and consistency-hardening commits. docs/specs/authoritative-quote-input.md describes the contract; docs/verification/authoritative-quote-input.md names the exact evidence source and a remote handoff command. This is an initial reviewable draft, not a remote-pass, production quote-wire or phone acceptance claim. Full wire alias/opaque ingress correlation remains later work.

pr:666.body:
The frozen mobile client can display clarification cards and send `task.answer`, but the architecture Gateway has no question adapter. This draft adds a standalone, scoped adapter over the public Runtime question, answer and stop APIs. It keeps the originating run and question identity, rejects permission confirmations, and does not install production dispatch.

The remote ST fixture uses the frozen client's request envelope with real Runtime/Core/SQLite and substituted model, account authority, room resolver and WebSocket entry. pr:699.body:
Closes #698

## What

A task's selected project directory was stored but dropped before the Bridge opened its WorkSwarm session. File operations could consequently use a generated task folder instead of the selected directory.

Forward `Task.project_path`, select or create the native WorkSwarm project, and pass its binding during session creation. Include the normalized directory in scope ownership so a continuation cannot reuse a session from another project. Preserve projectless identities and `work` mode; refuse incompatible existing bindings.

## Validation

- Reproduced the forwarding failure against unmodified main `fc08933b4a3fa1ac5e95f9843afe7a756ddda42d`, without a model call.
- 105 WorkSwarm tests passed, including forwarding, same/different-project reuse, restart, rotation, missing-directory rejection, binding drift and lost-create-response recovery.
- 37 existing conversation and task-clear tests passed.
- Contributor guide Node command: 2,658 passed, two skipped, no failures, with CI-pinned test dependencies.
- Docker native API check passed: explicit directory binding, unchanged `work` mode, same-project session reuse and different-project isolation. The v0.1.8 runtime used the changed product service source read-only, with networking disabled and no model calls.
- `git diff --check` passed.

[Reproduction, commands, limits and visual evidence](docs/developer_guide/evidence/project-workspace-binding/README.md).

## Risk and limits

Explicit project requests now register/select a WorkSwarm project and require an existing absolute directory. An existing project in another mode is rejected rather than modified. The directory becomes part of session identity; switching projects starts a distinct session. Projectless sessions retain their existing identities.

No prompts, model settings, tools, vendored execution sources or execution modes were changed. Live model-driven file editing and HarmonyOS device behavior were not tested. This PR does not claim improved answer accuracy.



## Main branch integration

Conflict resolved in `5753a89b61f47187fe7a0f6c069d7f49acef6cf5` by merging main `3088fdf9f8b0ae16eacecdaf842addd7d6e893bc`. Both project binding and upstream runtime-generation tracking are retained. pr:968.body:
## What this fixes

Issue #956 asks for the startup screen to stop showing detailed connection steps, and for failure
and retry detail to stay off the screen. Investigating on latest `main` showed the request is not
about one sentence: **the connection UI accepted free text from the transport and the gateway, and
the only thing between a user and a `wss://` address was a regex.**

This is the fourth round of the same defect (#138 → #136 → #422 → #956). Each earlier round patched
the regex, so the next sentence the team wrote walked straight through it. This PR fixes the pipeline
and adds two suites that fail the build if it regresses.

## What was actually on screen

Measured by running the real `digitalmateUserFacingError` against the real copy tables on `a78b20b1`:

- **9 transport sentences** reached the banner verbatim, including
  `'DigitalMate 握手失败，请检查测试凭据'` — the team talking to itself — and
  `'DigitalMate 连接异常（1006），请检查地址、网络和测试凭据'`, which carries an SDK error code and
  an address hint.
- **15 of the gateway's 21 public strings** reached it unchanged. The worst:
  `'云侧鉴权接口未找到（HTTP 404）。请核对：鉴权入口地址、/auth/* 转发规则，以及 ADX 版本与账号路由是否已启用。'`
  A 64-character operator sentence, under the 80-character length guard that was supposed to catch it.
- `GatewayAccountPanel` printed `snapshot.message` with no sanitizer at all, so one failure showed
  one wording in the banner and a different one in settings.
- The banner printed `'正在重新连接云端（第 3 次）…'`.

`CloudHome/Index.ets` still has `'正在连接 ' + endpoint.url + ' …'`, but it is unreachable under the
shipped config (`cloudBackend: "digitalmate"` makes `A2uiHome` render `Blank()` instead of
`CloudConversation`), so it is not touched here.

## The change: a code, one table, one boundary

**1. The failure travels as a code.**

- `DigitalMateTransportReason` in `DigitalMateSocket`: `handshake_timeout`, `handshake_failed`,
  `receive_failed`, `connection_error`, `closed`, `not_started`, `send_failed`, `client_closed`.
  The native error code still goes to `hilog`.
- `DigitalMateClientReason` in `DigitalMateClient`: `not_configured`, `auth_changed`,
  `login_required`, `connecting`, `not_connected`, `cancelled`, `request_timeout`, `send_failed`,
  `session_expired`, `foreground_resume`, `closed`.
- `GatewaySessionSnapshot.failureCode` carries the `GatewayAuthError.code` beside the diagnostic
  `message`, which stays for the log sheet.
- `DigitalMateConnectionUx` gains `CODE_KINDS` (a `Map`: ArkTS rejects untyped object literals)
  mapping both closed code sets to a `DigitalMateFailureKind`, and `digitalmateFailureText` as the
  single place a sentence is written. `TEXT_RULES` survives only so a record saved before this
  change still classifies.

The gateway's public copy loses the operator detail. **Nothing is lost diagnostically:**
`logFailure`/`logAgcDiagnostic` already record target, port, route, prefix, status and code for the
same failure, so the address, the HTTP status, `/auth/*` and the ADX version move to the log instead
of the banner.

**2. The UI has no field for prose.**

- `DigitalMateConnectionBanner` takes `failure` (classified through the one table) and `notice`
  (business prose, only while the transport is open). The `error` prop is gone — that is what makes
  a new sentence structurally unable to reach the screen.
- The line it shows comes from one function, `digitalmateBannerLine`, which the **device suite also
  calls** — so a device assertion covers exactly what a person reads.
- `GatewayAccountPanel` renders `digitalmateFailureText(digitalmateFailureKind(failureCode, message))`
  and no longer prints `snapshot.message`.
- `DigitalMateHome` drops the `gatewayRecoverMessage` field entirely.
- The retry ordinal is gone. `attempt` is still accepted so callers did not change, but it only
  distinguishes "connecting" from "still connecting".

#136 is preserved: a healthy transport with a business failure (`state === 'open'`) still shows its
own readable wording.

**3. Two suites guard it.**

`tests/unit/connection-copy-boundary.test.mjs` (new, **7 tests**, Node):

1. the banner accepts a failure to classify, never a finished sentence;
2. no connection surface renders the gateway diagnostic field;
3. the transport names a reason code instead of writing a sentence;
4. public copy carries no address, HTTP mechanic, `/auth/*`, ADX or test-credential wording;
5. the banner narrates no retry ordinal;
6. every `SAFE_ERROR_CODES` entry has a kind;
7. classifying an already-classified failure does not change its meaning.

`digitalmate/entry/src/test/ConnectionCopyBoundary.test.ets` (new, **8 tests**, registered in
`List.test`):

The same rules asserted in the **real ArkTS runtime**, not a type-stripping VM. It needs no account
and no network — every input is a string — so it runs on the device in CI.

## Review findings fixed in this PR

I reviewed this change as a reviewer and found four problems in my own work, plus one in my own
verification method. All are fixed:

1. **Re-classifying already-classified copy changed its meaning** — real, and introduced by this PR.
   `digitalmateUserFacingError` ran the text rules over its own output. `'没有访问该云端资源的权限'`
   matched no rule, fell to `unknown`, and was redrawn as `'云端连接暂不可用，请重试'`: a permission
   failure reported as a connectivity one. Reachable, because the binding sanitises a message
   (`DigitalMateConversationBinding.ets:529`) and then the banner classifies what it is handed
   (`:628`). Fixed by making the classifier idempotent.
2. **A comment claimed a coverage guard that did not exist.** `CODE_KINDS`'s docblock said "a guard
   test fails when a gateway code has no kind"; nothing read `SAFE_ERROR_CODES`. Guard 6 now does.
3. **A doubled semicolon** (`]];;`) left by the `Record`→`Map` rewrite that ArkTS required.
4. **`unknown` and `config` shared near-identical wording**, so a reader could not tell "we cannot
   tell" from "the gateway is misconfigured". `unknown` now says it does not know.
5. **My first device run reported a false pass.** After injecting a defect, the suite still said
   `Failure: 0`, because hvigor skips the test target when nothing it tracks changed and I read the
   previous `test_result.txt`. Both proof runs are now clean (`.test` removed, `hvigor clean`).

## Verification

### Node

`node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs`, both worktrees, same dependency set:

| | tests | pass | fail |
|---|---|---|---|
| baseline `a78b20b1` | 2646 | 2637 | 2 |
| this branch | 2648 | 2639 | 2 |

The same two tests fail on both, and they fail on `main` without this branch: an AGC SMS case and
the pinned WebSocket opcode case. **+7 tests, 0 regressions.** Targeted:
`connection-copy-boundary` 7/7, `gateway-auth-client` 41/41, `gateway-session-store` 126/126,
`digitalmate-connection-ux` 7/7, `digitalmate-adapter` 83/83.

### Device (local emulator, `dm_phone`, `127.0.0.1:5555`)

Clean build of the current tree:

```
hvigor test        -> Tests run: 2310, Failure: 0, Error: 0, Pass: 2310, Ignore: 0
hvigor assembleHap -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL
```

The HAP installs and the app launches. The startup splash shows only the pet and "DigitalMate" and
hands over to the login page — the behaviour the issue asks for on the screen reachable without an
account.

**The device guard is proven to bite.** Injecting `return 'HTTP 502 wss://private.test/ws'` for the
network kind turns exactly two tests red:

```
never lets a transport sentence reach the banner verbatim           -> Failure
shows a classified cause with no address, HTTP status or retry...   -> Failure
Tests run: 2310, Failure: 2, Error: 0, Pass: 2308
```

Restoring the source returns it to `2310 / 0 fail`.

### CI on the pushed head

`node-ut`, `hypium-ut`, `ArkTS Code Check`, `architecture-conformance`, `gate-report` and
`pr-ready` (device ST) are the required checks.

Remote tree sha equals local tree sha, so the branch content is byte-identical to what was tested.

## What this PR deliberately does NOT decide

- **The 8-second startup cap** (`A2uiHome/Index.ets:4759-4761`). The splash is force-closed after
  8s, so a slow handshake cuts to a connection screen. Whether to lengthen it, or to add a
  splash → skeleton → content state machine, is a product call and is not changed here.
- **The degradation strategy** the issue body's decision gate asks for.
- **The English-locale siblings** (#563, #564, #429, #449). Those four all rewrite connection copy in
  different files. With this table in place they should all read from it, in one follow-up, instead
  of being fixed four times.

## Measured A/B

Exact string comparison, not a screenshot: the base commit's `DigitalMateConnectionUx` and this
branch's version, loaded from their own trees and run over 32 inputs (15 transport sentences + 17
gateway strings), each through `digitalmateConnectBanner('closed', …)`.

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| inputs compared | 32 | 32 |
| **leaked infrastructure** | **13** | **0** |
| wording changed | — | 23 |

"Leaked" means the rendered sentence still contained a `wss://` or `https://` address, an
`HTTP \d{3}` status, `/auth/`, `ADX`, `ECONN`, `测试凭据`, the word `Gateway`/`gateway`, a
`DigitalMate 握手…`/`DigitalMate 连接…` internal phrase, or the raw English
`Invalid credential header`.

The characteristic cases:

```
"DigitalMate 握手失败，请检查测试凭据"
  before: "DigitalMate 握手失败，请检查测试凭据"          <- the team talking to itself
  after : "云端连接暂不可用，请重试"

"Invalid credential header"
  before: "Invalid credential header"                    <- raw English, straight through
  after : "云端连接暂不可用，请重试"

"云侧鉴权接口未找到（HTTP 404）。请核对：鉴权入口地址、/auth/* 转发规则，以及 ADX 版本与账号路由是否已启用。"
  before: the whole 64-character operator sentence
  after : "云端连接暂不可用，请重试"
```

The account panel, which used to print `snapshot.message` with no filter at all:

```
  before: "云侧鉴权接口未找到（HTTP 404）。请核对：..."
  after : "云端连接暂不可用，请稍后重试"
```

Retry ordinal, the other half of the issue:

```
attempt=1  before: "正在重新连接云端（第 1 次）…"   after: "正在连接云端…"
attempt=3  before: "正在重新连接云端（第 3 次）…"   after: "正在连接云端…"
attempt=9  before: "正在重新连接云端（第 9 次）…"   after: "正在连接云端…"
```

Six of the 32 inputs already rendered safely before this change, because the old regex happened to
match them - `'DigitalMate 连接异常（1006），请检查地址、网络和测试凭据'` contains `网络`, so it
became `网络不可用，请检查网络后重试`. That is the point: the old design leaked whatever did not
happen to hit a regex, and 13 of 32 did not.

### On the device

The same build, with `app_config.json` pointing at an unreachable gateway
(`wss://127.0.0.1:1/digitalmate/ws`), renders:

```
Beebou 正在恢复云端连接…
连接较慢，仍在努力连接中…          正在连接
连接中，消息将稍后发送…
```

No address, no status code, no credential vocabulary, no retry count — in a real failure state, on
the emulator, not a unit test.

## Screenshots

HarmonyOS emulator `dm_phone` (`127.0.0.1:5555`), this branch's `assembleHap` debug build,
installed with `bm install`. The point of the change is what is **absent** from these images: no
`wss://` address, no `HTTP 404`, no `/auth/*`, no ADX version, no "测试凭据", no retry count.

**Cold start** — the splash the issue's title is about, carrying no connection detail:

![Cold start: only the pet and the product name](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/fix/956-connection-copy-classification/docs/developer_guide/evidence/issue-956-connection-copy-2026-11-10/01-startup-splash.jpeg?raw=true)

**A real connection failure** — `app_config.json` (gitignored, never committed) pointed the gateway
at `wss://127.0.0.1:1/digitalmate/ws`, so the handshake could not complete:

![A real connection failure: no address, no status code, no retry count](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/fix/956-connection-copy-classification/docs/developer_guide/evidence/issue-956-connection-copy-2026-11-10/02-gateway-unreachable-banner.jpeg?raw=true)

**The same failure seconds later** — the copy is unchanged and still counts no attempts, which is
the "retry detail stays off the screen" half of the issue:

![The same failure later: the copy is unchanged and still counts no attempts](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/fix/956-connection-copy-classification/docs/developer_guide/evidence/issue-956-connection-copy-2026-11-10/03-gateway-unreachable-steady.jpeg?raw=true)

The full-resolution originals and a reproduction recipe live in [`docs/developer_guide/evidence/issue-956-connection-copy-2026-11-10`](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/tree/fix/956-connection-copy-classification/docs/developer_guide/evidence/issue-956-connection-copy-2026-11-10).

The account panel and the business-error path need a signed-in session, which needs a reachable
gateway, so no screenshot covers them; the two test suites and the A/B table above do.

Closes #956

pr:989.body:
## Summary

Refs #464 and #1010. The two reported forms have regression coverage; end-to-end device and live-model acceptance remains outstanding.

After a conversation is summarized, routing snapshots carry only the topic card and summary (`retrieval=True`), so the previous assistant bubble is not part of the routing document. When that reply proposed a concrete action but the summary does not repeat its wording, a short confirmation such as `加上` / `加吧` / `发吧` has no lexical or semantic evidence to continue the discussion. The router then returned NEW, the turn ran without plan history, and the assistant re-asked which domain and which PR to act on.

This change binds a message that only confirms or continues the previous turn and names no subject of its own to the recent focused conversation. Because the selected conversation is admitted with its full exchanges, the turn again sees the previous proposal (the named PR and label) instead of losing it.

The rule deliberately stays narrow:

- requires an existing focus (`focused_conversation_id`),
- requires the focus to be inside the existing recency window,
- ignores messages with attachments,
- ignores the focused snapshot when it is `control_only`,
- also recognizes a bounded label instruction with a recent, uniquely identified PR in the visible original exchanges; ambiguous or ineligible cases use ordinary routing.

`Basis.FALLBACK` is used for the EXISTING decision to keep the public `Basis` contract unchanged.

## Review follow-up

- **F1 (compound confirmations) — fixed.** `_is_continuation_only` accepts a message whose clauses, split on punctuation/whitespace, all match the continuation vocabulary; a trailing courtesy word (`谢谢` / `多谢` / `please` / `pls`) is stripped first. A clause with its own subject (`好的，帮我订机票`) still keeps the whole message on ordinary routing.
- **F2 (Chinese negatives) — fixed.** `取消` / `不用` / `不了` / `不行` / `否` now bind like their English counterparts (`cancel` / `no`).
- **F3 (subject-bearing label follow-up) — implemented with bounded evidence.** Recent visible original exchanges supply a unique PR for the reported `Markt the ready label` case, including when the continuity judge is unavailable. This selects a conversation, not an action authorization. Multiple PRs and missing, stale, archived, control-only or attached context do not use this fallback. Live product acceptance is still required.
- **F4 (polite confirmations and `开始`) — fixed.** `_COURTESY_SUFFIX` now strips `please` / `pls` and re-normalizes the clause so the separating whitespace does not survive, and `开始` joins the subject-free continuation verbs. Covered by `yes please`, `sure, please`, `ok please`, `开始`, `开始吧`, `好的，开始吧`, `开始吧谢谢`, `好，开始 please`; `please add the label` and `开始处理购物清单` still route NEW.

## Tests

Added to `tests/session_proximity/test_routing.py`:

- `test_bare_continuation_binds_the_focused_discussion_after_its_reply_is_summarized` (covers `加上`, `加吧`, `发吧`, `好的`, `继续`, `收到`, `sounds good`, `go ahead`, `取消`, `不用`, `开始`, `开始吧`, `yes please`, `sure, please`, `ok please`)
- `test_compound_confirmation_clauses_bind_the_focused_discussion` (covers `好的，加上吧`, `好，加上`, `加上吧谢谢`, `好的、加上`, `加上,发吧`, `好的！加上吧`, `好的，开始吧`, `开始吧谢谢`, `好，开始 please`, plus the `好的，帮我订机票`, `please add the label` and `开始处理购物清单` counterexamples)
- `test_bare_continuation_does_not_follow_a_stale_focus`
- `test_bare_continuation_still_needs_a_focus`
- `test_short_instruction_with_its_own_subject_does_not_bind_focus`

Commands run (`PYTHONPATH=harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src`, `PYTHONUTF8=1`):

- `python -m unittest tests.session_proximity.test_routing` — 36 tests, OK
- all `tests/session_proximity/test_*.py` modules — 96 tests, OK (1 benchmark test skipped: local Ollama not reachable)
- `tests.session_proximity.test_contracts.ImportIsolationTests` — OK (the suite's `path.read_text()` needs `PYTHONUTF8=1` on this Windows host; without it the pre-existing locale decode issue appears)

Not executed: `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_session_proximity*.py` integration tests, because this environment lacks the harness runtime dependencies (`aiosqlite` first). No build or runtime verification of the HarmonyOS client was performed.


## Follow-up verification at 7834bbb7

- python -m unittest discover -s tests/session_proximity -p 'test_*.py': 99 tests passed, one local Ollama benchmark skipped (before the final additional negative case); targeted routing: 40 passed.
- Repository integration: 15 passed, including real SQLite retrieval, no-judge routing and rebuilding the selected conversation history. Model provider serialization: 7 passed using a controlled provider.
- Architecture manifest and static gate: passed, zero findings.
- Interpreter: E:/miniforge3/python.exe; mandate loaded from the repository vendor wheel. The broader source-discovery run did not pass: three imports required missing telethon and three installed-package/provenance checks failed under this source environment.
- Not yet verified: live model, deployed server, HarmonyOS emulator and the actual GitHub label operation. No screenshot or end-to-end acceptance is claimed.
