items.author: hsliuustc0106
items.body:
## 🚀 Background Description

DigitalMate 需要一套「名片 / 身份柜」，让用户把**公司身份、开源项目角色、社媒账号**挂在同一套名片上，而不是只认开源身份。

类比 Grok Bot 的 Vault：Vault 管的是卡号/密码等密钥；**身份柜管的是身份与权限面**（我是谁、对外用哪套身份、能代表什么）。跨生态填表、授权连接、代表发言时，应能选用柜里已登记的身份，而不是每次重新粘贴或口头说明。

动机：Personal Agent 场景下，用户会在多个生态间切换（公司邮件、GitHub org、X/微信等）。若九问记不住「谁、管什么、对外用哪套身份」，授权与代办会反复卡在身份确认上，也容易用错身份。

相关：正式授权连接（勿在聊天粘 token）见 [#95](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/95)。本 issue 不替代 #95，但身份柜选出的身份在走外部授权时应复用正规 OAuth/连接流程。

## Design Ideas

**MVP（先做窄，避免一次铺太多）：**
1. 身份类型只开放三类：`公司` / `开源` / `社媒`。
2. 每张名片至少包含：显示名、类型、关联账号或组织标识、可选备注（「管什么」）、启用/停用。
3. 入口：设置或个人中心可见「身份柜」；聊天/授权/填表场景出现「选用身份」时，从柜中挑选，不要求用户粘贴密钥。
4. 与 Vault 边界：身份柜**不存**密码、token、卡号；敏感凭证走现有正规授权连接。身份柜只存身份元数据与选用关系。

**明确不做（本期）：** 完整 IAM、任意自定义类型无限扩展、自动爬取全网账号、替代设备级密钥库。

备选方案（未采纳）：只做「开源身份」——覆盖面太窄，公司/社媒场景仍会反复问身份；做成通用 Vault——与密钥库职责混淆，用户更困惑。

## Involved Public APIs

- 端侧：身份柜 CRUD UI；选用身份的交互卡/选择器。
- 云端（若已有账户模型）：身份档案的读写 API；与现有账号/专家/授权连接的关联字段。具体是否新增公开 API 待实现方确认，本期以「可选用、可列举、可停用」为验收底线。

## Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- 授权连接 / OAuth（[#95](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/95)）：选用身份后走正规连接，不粘 token。
- 专家 / 插件：若某专家需要「以某开源身份发言」，应从身份柜选取。
- A4P / 动手前确认：敏感动作前确认卡应展示**将使用的身份**（可核验、可记入溯源），但不把「先确认」本身当卖点。

## Test Design and Test Plan（验收）

1. **登记**：用户能为三类身份各至少登记一张名片（公司 / 开源 / 社媒），列表可见显示名、类型、启用状态。
2. **选用**：在一次需要对外身份的流程中（例如连接外部服务或授权代表发言），用户能从身份柜挑选一张启用中的名片，确认卡上写明将使用的身份。
3. **边界**：身份柜界面与流程中**不出现**要求粘贴 password / token / 卡号的步骤；缺凭证时引导走正规授权连接。
4. **停用**：停用某名片后，选用列表中不再出现；已完成的历史记录仍可查到当时用过的身份标识（溯源可读）。
5. **困惑控制**：设置里身份类型入口不超过上述三类；首次进入有一句说明「管身份，不管密码」。

未满足以上任一条则本期不算完成。

## Additional Information

- 来源：hs 经 AdminBot 转 digitalmate-bot 提案（2026-10-24 Asia/Shanghai）。
- 对外说法建议：讲「跨生态记住并用对身份」，不要讲「我们有 Vault」或「别家没有授权」。
- Claim 收窄：本期只宣称「能登记并选用公司 / 开源 / 社媒三类身份」，不宣称完整身份平台。

## 动机
靠新版本人工点测跟不上 bug 堆积（#330/#335–#339/#343–#345 等）。需要可回归的冒烟 + 泛化模板，把「用户截图」变成门禁，而不是开发队列。

## 目标
- PR：<10 分钟确定性壳/会话冒烟（mock LLM）
- Nightly：槽位化扩展集 + 能力类（天气/行情 mock）
- 发版：冒烟全绿才标可测；新截图只填失败模式库

## 可执行方案（分阶段）

### P0（1 周）— 冒烟表 + Promptfoo/Playwright 骨架
1. 文档：`docs/qa/smoke-matrix.md`（10～15 条）映射现有 issue
2. 壳：LibreChat/OpenHands 模式 — mock LLM + Playwright（可点链、气泡不横向溢出、产物菜单有删除）
3. Agent：Promptfoo YAML 负例（无 DSML 泄漏、连发不覆盖首条回复、问题单默认不含 RFC）
4. Actions：`smoke.yml` 跑上述；失败阻断 merge（或标 required）

### P1（2 周）— 泛化模板
1. 槽位：`{{city}}` / `{{repo}}` / `{{filename}}` 多值矩阵
2. 变体：同意图 3 说法 × 同一断言
3. 失败模式库：泄漏 / 裸 URL / RFC 混入 / 宽表 / 覆盖回复 — 新 bug 只加槽，不新开类
4. 分桶：壳 vs Agent vs 数据源 mock，避免全链路真网慢测

### P2 — Nightly 与效率
1. PR 只跑 P0 确定性；扩展集 + 红队（Promptfoo）进 Nightly
2. flake 隔离：不稳定用例标 `quarantine`，不挡 PR
3. 与 DSH 对照验收：问题单分栏、首轮可点链（#335/#336）

## 非目标
- 不替代模型榜单（lm-eval）
- 不要求首期真连天气/美股外网

## 验收
- [ ] smoke-matrix 落地且映射 issue
- [ ] PR CI 含 mock 壳 + Promptfoo 负例
- [ ] 至少 3 个历史 bug（如 #330/#336/#339）被自动化抓住
- [ ] 发版 checklist 引用冒烟绿

## 相关
#335 #336 #339 #330 #343 #345；评测体系 #209

items.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

同批多图（刘聪 NLP / Anthropic「Agent 折叠」相关小红书图文）下，DigitalMate 与豆包并排对比：DM 能认出附件并做 1–5 编号说明，但整体可读性、结构化与收束明显弱于豆包。

对标场景：一次丢 5 张图问「这几张图说啥呢」/「这是什么」。

相关：多图附件呈现；解读类回复质量；[#344](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/344) 结果卡形态；[#349](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/349) ↩ 绑定。截图见首评（DM + 豆包）。

### Design Ideas

**现象**
- DM：先列文件卡，再平铺编号段；几乎无小标题/列表/加粗；无来源条、无免责、无答末 CTA。
- 豆包：开场定位 → 分张拆解 → 整体一句话 → 主动要约；有检索引用、「AI 可能有误」、底部创作快捷入口。

**预期（质量门槛）**
1. 开场一句总览（作者/主题/为何相关）
2. 每图：`图N ↔ 文件名` + 标题 + ≤3 要点 + 一句
3. 全文总结 + 1 个可点追问建议
4. 结构化渲染（小标题 / 列表 / 关键术语加粗）
5. 能搜则「参考 N 篇」；不能搜也标图内可见出处
6. 解读类顶部一行免责

**实际**
答完即停的电报体编号段；文件卡有锚点但正文弱；无出处/免责/CTA。

### 决策门禁（产品拍板后再拆实现）

| 项 | 选项 |
| --- | --- |
| 来源条 | A 必须联网检索 / B 仅标图内出处 / C 两者都要 |
| 答末 CTA | A 固定模板一句 / B 按意图生成 / C 先不上可点按钮只出文案 |
| 免责 | A 解读类一律顶部一行 / B 仅有检索时显示 |
| 范围 | A 仅多图解读 / B 所有长答统一结构模板 |

未拍板前保留 `needs-template`。

### Involved Public APIs

壳侧：多图消息渲染、结果卡/ Markdown 结构化、答末 CTA 组件。Agent/Orbit：多图解读 prompt 模板、可选检索引用。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

与附件文件卡、[#344](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/344) 宽表/表形态、[#348](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/348) smoke（多图解读用例）相关。

### Test Design and Test Plan

1. 固定 5 图素材：DM vs 豆包（或金标）并排，检查是否含总览 / 图N锚点 / 总结 / CTA / 出处或免责。
2. 单图、0 图、无法 OCR 的图：不崩，降级文案明确。
3. 无网：仍能标图内出处或明确「未检索」。
4. e2e：多图提问 → 回复结构字段齐全（纳入 [#348](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/348) P1 候选）。

### Additional Information

对比结论摘要：差距主因是**结构化表达 + 来源可信度 + 可行动收束**，不是「完全看不懂图」。DM 文件卡清单可保留为对图锚点优势。

items.body:
### 🚀 Background Description


DigitalMate代码仓用例补充

### Design Ideas

# DigitalMate 自动化用例补充跟踪

## 用例清单

| 完成状态 | 用例类型 | 用例描述 | 测试功能 |覆盖范围
|---|---|---|---|---|
| □ | 文本输入 | 输入普通文本问题并提交 | 验证端侧文本输入、发送和结果展示 |E2E|
| □ | 图片输入 | 选择图片并提交问题 | 验证图片上传、传输和云侧处理 |ST|
| □ | 多模态输入 | 同时输入文字和图片 | 验证文字与图片组合请求 |
| □ | 长文本输入 | 输入较长内容并提交 | 验证输入长度限制和异常处理 |
| □ | 空输入校验 | 不输入内容直接提交 | 验证空内容提示 |
| □ | 网络异常 | 断网后提交用户请求 | 验证网络异常提示和重试机制 |
| □ | 云侧异常 | 云侧服务返回错误 | 验证错误信息展示和失败处理 |
| □ | 响应展示 | 云侧返回正常结果 | 验证结果内容、格式和展示效果 |

items.body:
## 动机

长任务（今日卡、Orbit 分派、跨 App 执行）需要可回放的 **trajectory**，方便调试、建立信任，并快速定位失败。参考 DeepSeek Harness 的 Input / Model / Tools 三轨时间线 + 下方 ASSISTANT / TOOL 交错日志。

DigitalMate 是 **分发入口**：壳 UI 必须简单，完整轨迹不应做成手机上的 dense workbench。

## 参考

- 顶区：Duration / Turns / Calls 汇总
- 三轨 Gantt：Input（灰/蓝/绿）· Model（紫）· Tools（橙成功 / 红超时失败）
- 底区：逐步日志（ASSISTANT 推理摘要 + TOOL 调用与输出片段）
- 失败点（如 `TOOL_TIMEOUT`）醒目标红，可点击定位

## 提案

### 壳上（手机统一入口）

- 任务状态条可点进「轨迹」详情
- 默认仍是 **结果卡 + 一行进度**（时长 / turns / calls），不默认展开全文思考
- 失败时结果卡上露出红色失败摘要，一键进轨迹失败点

### 详情（Orbit 或二级页）

- 完整三轨 Timeline + 交错日志
- 支持跳到失败 / 超时 tool call
- 可选：按 turn 折叠 ASSISTANT 文本

## 非目标

- 不在手机壳复刻完整 Harness IDE
- 不默认把完整 chain-of-thought 铺在对话流里
- 不替代现有确认闸门（对外写操作仍需确认）

## 验收

- [ ] 任一多步 agent 任务可打开轨迹视图
- [ ] Tools 失败 / 超时在时间线与日志中可见且可定位
- [ ] 壳上默认仍是轻量结果卡，详情才展开完整 timeline
- [ ] 配套 e2e：超时标红 + 点击定位到对应 TOOL 条目

## 开放问题

- 轨迹数据落在本地会话、Orbit 后端，还是两边都有？
- 首版是否只覆盖 Orbit 长任务，壳内短对话是否只记轻量 turns？

## 上下文
手机端 DigitalMate。「发现」负一屏瀑布流体验可用（新闻/视频卡片、底部提示「试试说：多给我推荐点足球内容」）。产品侧需确认：当前流是否已由个人记忆驱动。报告人判断「应该还和个人记忆没关系」——经对照代码后记录为观察/条目标清，非立刻修 bug。

## 测试环境
- **版本（暂无正式版本号/分支）：** 按报告时间记为 `build≈2026-10-20`（Asia/Shanghai）
- 截图状态栏时间：约 08:13
- 设备型号 / 正式 App 版本号：暂无，待补
- 客户端：DigitalMate 手机端（Orbit phone client）
- 路径：底栏「发现」

## 原图

![发现负一屏](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-20-discovery-vs-memory.jpg?raw=true)

证据分支：`bot/issue-evidence` · [文件](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-20-discovery-vs-memory.jpg)

## 结果
- **实际（体感）：** 发现流为通用信源内容（如医保、时政视频、妈祖等），未见明显由对话个人记忆个性化的证据；更像冷启/探索 + 发现页自有偏好（composer/标签）。
- **代码对照（现状，非实现任务）：**
  - 存在预留 `DiscoveryMemoryProjection`（`entry/.../waterfall/DiscoveryMemoryProjection*.ets`）：可把长期记忆投影为发现偏好信号。
  - 重建门槛：`DISCOVERY_MEMORY_PROJECTION_COUNT_THRESHOLD = 8`，且默认等待约 7 天（`DISCOVERY_MEMORY_PROJECTION_WAIT_MS`）——不是装上即读个人记忆。
  - 发现 PES 实验：P（profile）初始为空，经发现 composer/标签填充；新账号先走 E（探索）冷启。与对话「个人记忆」不是同一条即时通路。
- **期望（条目标清）：** 产品文档/验收写明：发现负一屏当前 **不依赖** 个人记忆即可用；若要「记忆 → 发现」接通，另开实现 issue，并写清门槛与验收。

## 验收
- [ ] README / 能力说明写清：发现 ≠ 已接个人记忆（或写明接通条件）
- [ ] 若做接通：有独立验收（记忆事实变更后发现偏好可见、可关、可解释）
- [ ] 本观察不阻塞发现负一屏作为独立体验继续迭代

## 上下文
手机端 DigitalMate（Orbit 客户端）。用户让 agent「帮我给openjiuwen-ai下面的digitalmate仓库提issue」，agent 弹出「需求收集」卡，要求用户去 github.com/settings/tokens 生成并**在聊天里粘贴 GitHub Token**（勾选 repo），否则无法调用 GitHub API。用户回复「我手机上没有版本找到token」，流程卡住。

## 测试环境
- 客户端：DigitalMate 手机端（Orbit phone client）
- 场景：在对话中让 agent 代提 GitHub issue
- 时间：约 2026-10-21 12:20–12:21（Asia/Shanghai，截图状态栏）
- **版本（暂无正式版本号/分支）：** 按报告时间记为 `build≈2026-10-21`（Asia/Shanghai）
- 设备型号 / 正式 App 版本号：暂无，待补
## 原图

![要求粘贴 GitHub Token](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-21-github-token-ask.jpg?raw=true)

证据分支：`bot/issue-evidence` · [文件](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-21-github-token-ask.jpg)
（上下文）![后续需求收集卡](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-21-card-pending-banner.jpg?raw=true)

证据分支：`bot/issue-evidence` · [文件](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-21-card-pending-banner.jpg)
## 结果
- **实际：** 无应用内 GitHub 连接/OAuth；只能让用户手动创建 PAT 并在聊天中明文粘贴。手机用户基本无法完成，且在聊天中索要原始 token 有安全风险（token 进入对话记录/上下文）。
- **期望：** 提供授权连接流程（OAuth / GitHub App，范围可见、可撤销）；未支持时明确提示「暂不支持」。任何情况下不在聊天中索要原始 PAT。

## 验收
- [ ] 手机端可通过授权流程连接 GitHub 并提 issue，或给出明确的「暂不支持」提示
- [ ] 对话中不再出现索要原始 token 的文案

# 🚀 [Roadmap] 项目核心能力演进与 Demo 演示追踪

> **Issue 类型:** Feature / Roadmap  
> **当前状态:** 持续更新中 (Active)  
> **说明:** 本 Issue 用于统一追踪 Agent 核心能力的开发进度及 Demo 演示状态。按周（Weekly）粒度持续更新，请在完成特性与 Demo 验证后更新对应的复选框。

---

## 📅 每周 Roadmap 与进度追踪

### 📅 10.19 ~ 10.25

- [x] **Bot 主对话与话题自动管理**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **自然语言发起任务：** 用户在 Bot 主对话中直接提出需求，无需手动创建会话、选择 Agent 或 Skill。
    - **话题切换与续接：** 根据输入自动创建或接续话题，支持在多个任务之间切换，并回到已有话题继续交流。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **跨话题连续对话：** 输入“帮我找找上海的篮球场” $\rightarrow$ 输入“帮我计划一个去南京的旅游” $\rightarrow$ 输入“浦东新区的球场呢” $\rightarrow$ 输入“南京有啥好吃的”。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 对话中出现新建或续接话题提示；最后一轮接续“南京三日游行程规划”，返回南京美食建议，内容不与篮球场任务混淆。

- [x] **主动澄清与需求收集**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **主动补全需求：** 面对范围、偏好等信息不完整的请求，Agent 通过交互卡片向用户提问。
    - **反馈驱动执行：** 用户选择并提交回答后，Agent 依据补充条件继续任务，回答记录保留在对话中。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **篮球场需求澄清：** 输入“帮我找找上海的篮球场” $\rightarrow$ 选择“徐汇/静安一带（推荐）”和“免费室外场” $\rightarrow$ 提交回答 $\rightarrow$ 获取场地推荐。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 卡片支持问题切换和发送回答，提交后显示“已回答”；结果体现所选区域和免费室外偏好，并说明未核实的开放、收费或预约信息。

- [x] **多任务后台执行与进展通知**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **后台持续执行：** 用户切换话题或离开聊天页面后，已发起的任务继续运行。
    - **多入口跟踪：** 通过聊天状态、实时活动面板、负一屏卡片和完成通知查看任务进展与结果。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **切换页面跟踪任务：** 发起上海篮球场和南京旅游任务 $\rightarrow$ 查看实时活动面板及负一屏卡片 $\rightarrow$ 返回聊天继续询问浦东球场 $\rightarrow$ 查看此前任务的完成通知。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 不同任务分别显示名称、进度和摘要；切换后仍能看到原任务状态更新，完成通知能够对应到具体任务。

- [x] **结构化结果呈现与异常降级**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **结构化交付：** 将复杂需求整理为文字结论、表格、清单和预算，方便用户阅读与继续追问。
    - **异常降级交付：** 当网页获取或交互式产物生成受阻时，说明限制，并提供可用的文字或表格结果。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **南京旅行规划：** 输入“帮我计划一个去南京的旅游” $\rightarrow$ 观察执行进度和结果逐步呈现 $\rightarrow$ 查看三日行程表、预约事项及预算。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 行程按天、时间和安排组织，包含一人三天两晚约 1300–1700 元预算；交互式行程板未生成时明确说明，并提供文字行程与清单。

- [x] **Cross-Session Long-Term Memory (跨会话记忆与动态更新)**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - 支持 Agent 在多个独立的日常短会话中，隐式提取用户的个人偏好、生活习惯与健康约束（如座位习惯、饮食偏好、过敏源及工作日程规则）。
    - 具备时效性更新与信息覆盖（Overwriting）能力，能够自动识别偏好或规则的变更（如从肉类偏好更新为素食，或日程规则调整）。
    - 在复杂的多约束综合任务中，实现跨领域记忆的精确检索与多源信息综合应用。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **场景搭建：** 模拟 3~4 次跨越不同时间的自然短对话（订机票、餐厅菜单咨询、日程调整）。
    - **大考验证：** 发起一次“下周五出差规划”的综合指令，展示 Agent 如何自动避开花生过敏原推荐纯素食餐厅、优先勾选过道座位，并自动适配周五特有的团队例会时间表。
---

### 📅 10.26 ~ 11.01

- [ ] **Bot 会话与多应用信息汇聚打通整合**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **文字呼出与交互：** 支持在 Bot 主对话中通过自然语言/文字指令主动呼出并触发多应用信息整合特性。
    - **多源记忆接入：** 支持将多应用（Mail, Calendar, Chat 工具等）汇聚整合的信息与记忆实时接入 Bot 上下文中。
    - **主动推送与聚合：** Bot 具备主动推送能力，能将跨应用聚合后的关键动态、日程提醒与待办摘要主动推送给用户。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **主动推送与指令呼出 Demo：** 演示用户在 Bot 主界面通过文本指令（如“汇总一下各渠道最新消息”）唤醒多端整合，且 Bot 主动向用户推送包含邮件、日程与消息提醒的跨应用简报。

- [ ] **Single Agent + Single App: To-Do Creation & Follow-up**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - 读取邮件内容并精准理解上下文，自动生成结构化的待办事项（To-Do Items）。
    - 依据正文中提到的时间节点自动设定明确的截止提醒（Reminders）。
    - 在后续的任务规划和日程询问中，主动进行进度跟进与状态更新。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **自动提炼待办：** 演示 Agent 从合作方发来的紧急技术评估邮件中提取任务，自动创建包含明确 Deadline（如周三中午前）的 Google Task。
    - **动态跟进与汇总：** 演示当用户询问本周未完成事项时，Agent 自动汇总并提醒即将到期的待办任务。

- [ ] **Single Agent + Single App: Email Operations & Priority Management**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - 协助用户高效管理收件箱（Inbox），自动识别垃圾推广和低价值营销邮件并执行删除或归档操作。

### 📌 新增开发事项：手机本地能力接入

数据来源均为手机本地：系统日历、系统通讯录、华为健康、手机自带待办、手机定位和本地照片。

每项特性包含所需的授权或数据选择、实际读取、结果适配、来源与时间标记、对话或目标任务接入，以及开发者自测。权限变化、数据更新、页面切换和重启恢复等验收场景直接写入对应特性。

| 优先级 | 开发事项 | 暂估工作量 |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| 优先开展 | 统一连接入口、权限管理、日历读取、定位读取、系统待办读取 | 6.5人日 |
| 随后开展 | 通讯录读取、华为健康读取、照片读取 | 4.5人日 |
| **合计** | **8项开发事项，包含各自的数据接入、自测和问题修复** | **11人日** |

  - **开发内容：** 验证手机本地健康数据读取通路，完成对应授权，首期读取睡眠记录；统一来源、时间和数据格式，供对话及目标任务使用，处理无记录、授权变化和读取失败。
  - **工作量依据：** 含约0.5人日真机通路验证，健康专项接入、授权、读取、结果适配、调用接入和自测均计入本项；通路确认后校准。
  - **验收 Demo：** 手机存在真实睡眠记录 → 完成授权 → 在DigitalMate读取近期记录并查询 → 与华为健康中的时间、时长核对 → 验证无记录或授权失效时的提示。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 回答依据手机真实记录，时间与来源可核对；无数据和失败不产生虚构记录。

- [ ] **照片读取与对话引用｜0.5人日**
  - **开发内容：** 复用已有本地照片选择能力，读取用户选定照片并接入对话或任务引用；处理取消选择、页面切换和读取失败。
  - **工作量依据：** 选择、引用衔接及回归合并在本项，复用现有照片选择和附件通道。
  - **验收 Demo：** 选择两张本地照片 → 在对话中查看并引用 → 核对内容与选择范围 → 取消选择或切换页面后返回。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 读取与引用对应用户选定照片，内容正确；取消不影响原对话，错误和状态变化可见。

---

### 📌 后续候选（可后置）


- [ ] **独立插件：Agent DM 加好友（撞上即可开聊）**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **独立插件边界：** 相对九问核心、Orbit 主线与名片/身份柜（#190）单独交付；装上即可用，不绑定 Orbit 宿主。
    - **DM 撞上加好友：** 用户在 DM 场景直接加对方 handle / agent，发出请求；对方同意后建立私聊，无需 invite link / grant 流程作为唯一入口。
    - **私聊开聊：** 加好友成功后可双向私信；默认不开放发现广场、不支持随便加陌生 agent 的公开社交图。
    - **与身份柜协作：** 发送时可选名片/身份（#190）；本项只管「跟谁建立 DM」，不管密钥保管。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **撞上加好友：** 在九问 DM 输入对方 handle → 发送好友请求 → 对方同意 → 进入私聊并发一条消息。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 好友关系可复用；拒绝/未同意时不能开聊；不出现公开广场或跨 harness 随意加好友；与 #190 选身份发送可同屏演示但不混为同一需求。


---

## 📌 更新规范 (Update Protocol)

1. 每周任务或 Demo 完成后，将对应的 `- [ ]` 更新为 `- [x]`。
2. 可在具体项下补充对应的 PR 链接、测试用例脚本或 Demo 演示链接。

## 🚀 Background Description

DigitalMate 需要一套「名片 / 身份柜」，让用户把**公司身份、开源项目角色、社媒账号**挂在同一套名片上，而不是只认开源身份。

类比 Grok Bot 的 Vault：Vault 管的是卡号/密码等密钥；**身份柜管的是身份与权限面**（我是谁、对外用哪套身份、能代表什么）。跨生态填表、授权连接、代表发言时，应能选用柜里已登记的身份，而不是每次重新粘贴或口头说明。

动机：Personal Agent 场景下，用户会在多个生态间切换（公司邮件、GitHub org、X/微信等）。若九问记不住「谁、管什么、对外用哪套身份」，授权与代办会反复卡在身份确认上，也容易用错身份。

相关：正式授权连接（勿在聊天粘 token）见 [#95](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/95)。本 issue 不替代 #95，但身份柜选出的身份在走外部授权时应复用正规 OAuth/连接流程。

## Design Ideas

**MVP（先做窄，避免一次铺太多）：**
1. 身份类型只开放三类：`公司` / `开源` / `社媒`。
2. 每张名片至少包含：显示名、类型、关联账号或组织标识、可选备注（「管什么」）、启用/停用。
3. 入口：设置或个人中心可见「身份柜」；聊天/授权/填表场景出现「选用身份」时，从柜中挑选，不要求用户粘贴密钥。
4. 与 Vault 边界：身份柜**不存**密码、token、卡号；敏感凭证走现有正规授权连接。身份柜只存身份元数据与选用关系。

**明确不做（本期）：** 完整 IAM、任意自定义类型无限扩展、自动爬取全网账号、替代设备级密钥库。

备选方案（未采纳）：只做「开源身份」——覆盖面太窄，公司/社媒场景仍会反复问身份；做成通用 Vault——与密钥库职责混淆，用户更困惑。

## Involved Public APIs

- 端侧：身份柜 CRUD UI；选用身份的交互卡/选择器。
- 云端（若已有账户模型）：身份档案的读写 API；与现有账号/专家/授权连接的关联字段。具体是否新增公开 API 待实现方确认，本期以「可选用、可列举、可停用」为验收底线。

## Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- 授权连接 / OAuth（[#95](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/95)）：选用身份后走正规连接，不粘 token。
- 专家 / 插件：若某专家需要「以某开源身份发言」，应从身份柜选取。
- A4P / 动手前确认：敏感动作前确认卡应展示**将使用的身份**（可核验、可记入溯源），但不把「先确认」本身当卖点。

## Test Design and Test Plan（验收）

1. **登记**：用户能为三类身份各至少登记一张名片（公司 / 开源 / 社媒），列表可见显示名、类型、启用状态。
2. **选用**：在一次需要对外身份的流程中（例如连接外部服务或授权代表发言），用户能从身份柜挑选一张启用中的名片，确认卡上写明将使用的身份。
3. **边界**：身份柜界面与流程中**不出现**要求粘贴 password / token / 卡号的步骤；缺凭证时引导走正规授权连接。
4. **停用**：停用某名片后，选用列表中不再出现；已完成的历史记录仍可查到当时用过的身份标识（溯源可读）。
5. **困惑控制**：设置里身份类型入口不超过上述三类；首次进入有一句说明「管身份，不管密码」。

未满足以上任一条则本期不算完成。

## Additional Information

- 来源：hs 经 AdminBot 转 digitalmate-bot 提案（2026-10-24 Asia/Shanghai）。
- 对外说法建议：讲「跨生态记住并用对身份」，不要讲「我们有 Vault」或「别家没有授权」。
- Claim 收窄：本期只宣称「能登记并选用公司 / 开源 / 社媒三类身份」，不宣称完整身份平台。

### 🚀 Background Description

Establish E2E coverage for **16 DigitalMate cases: 7 in E4 (artifacts and system integration), 7 in E5 (lifecycle and recovery), and 2 in E6 (installation, release, and compliance)**.

Reuse existing workflows, complete deterministic criteria, and collect actual local execution with traceable evidence. #533 retains the original scenarios and historical records. This issue tracks their migration and re-acceptance under the tiered specification; historical passes do not count as stable passes of the current case version.

### Design Ideas

- Criteria are defined in `tests/cases`; workflows, drivers, assertions, and evidence entry points are in `tests/e2e`.
- #585, #586, and #587 retain the original definitions and partial results. Replacement delivery consists of one PR per E tier, linked to this issue, with the cases, execution entry points, actual results, and screenshots.
- Track specification, implementation, execution, stability, PR, and merge status separately by case version. JSON validation, mocks, historical passes, and CI success do not establish current business acceptance.
- Complete each current case once and retain all required assertions. Repeat only after a relevant change or a new failure; report repeated-run stability separately.

### Involved Public APIs

Use the actual App and normal cloud protocol to verify files, attachments, tasks, interactions, and system resources. Fault controls must be restricted to isolated resources owned by the current run. Server success receipts, login state, and assertions must not be fabricated or bypassed.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Coverage includes `tests/e2e/workflow`, file and attachment operations, task recovery, permissions, reminders, first launch, and upgrades. Tier groups share assertion support. This issue does not expand the separate E0–E3 or ST supplementation scope.

### Test Design and Test Plan

E4 checks external file contents and hashes, artifact versions, attachment ownership, permissions, and system resource differences. E5 checks the in-flight state before interruption, actual device controls, task uniqueness, drafts/cards, and terminal state after recovery. E6 checks clean installation, agreement state, package signing/version/release configuration, and retained upgrade data.

<!-- e4-e6-progress:start -->

| Tier | Cases | Cases with local execution records | Complete local passes | Replacement PR | Original definition PR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|

| E5: Lifecycle and recovery | 7 | 7 | 5 | [#713](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/713) (MERGED) | [#586](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/586) (MERGED) |
| E6: Installation, release, and compliance | 2 | 2 | 2 | [#714](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/714) (MERGED) | [#587](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/587) (MERGED) |
| **Total** | **16** | **16** | **13** | | |

Local execution records include partial and failed runs. A complete local pass requires all business criteria and GPT-6 Astra screenshot review. Repeat execution is reserved for failures or changes that require verification. Definitions, framework regressions, and CI success do not add to business completion counts.

Local testing uses the available emulator, installed packages, and test service. Unknown cloud deployment and model versions are recorded as unknown and do not block local business execution. GPT-6 Astra reviews the relevant screenshots and records. Replacement cases are grouped into one PR each for E4, E5, and E6, with manual merging.

The original room and fixture matched the removed source. One plain control reached the target room without an attachment. A separate 1 MiB upload showed the guard after the switch tap, which ended 8.50 seconds before the response. Both native previews showed FINAL. One execution; no repeated-run stability claim. | #670 | [Record 1](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e34a4d2549c0f243e7cadf4008ed84fa3668f433/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/README.md); [Record 2](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e34a4d2549c0f243e7cadf4008ed84fa3668f433/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/verification.json) |

DELETE stayed absent and KEEP stayed visible after refresh, restart and verified same-process App gateway reconnect. The original local inventory matched. The previous device-wide trial remains BLOCKED in the prior assessment. | #670 | [Record 1](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/67fca4d5a90ed84174b2ab6f7f002d236961777e/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/README.md); [Record 2](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/67fca4d5a90ed84174b2ab6f7f002d236961777e/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/verification.json); [Record 3](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/67fca4d5a90ed84174b2ab6f7f002d236961777e/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/delete-reconnected.png) |

The read returned FORBIDDEN after revocation, the App showed recovery guidance, and restored bytes and revision matched. The provider UI and ordinary WorkSwarm path remain unverified. Bug #868. | #670 | [Record 1](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/9f4ea7b1833cc6ef11a460a8a552cd71d36b1503/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/README.md); [Record 2](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/9f4ea7b1833cc6ef11a460a8a552cd71d36b1503/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/verification.json); [Record 3](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/9f4ea7b1833cc6ef11a460a8a552cd71d36b1503/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/perm01-tool-denied.png); [Record 4](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/9f4ea7b1833cc6ef11a460a8a552cd71d36b1503/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/perm01-tool-restored.png); [Record 5](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/a7706055f99faa70e6ff72249b31c49bf62f3d16/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/perm01-denied.png) |

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/backend/session_manager/proxy.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/backend/session_manager/proxy.py) — `SessionManagerProxy`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [docs/adr/0001-session-ownership.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/adr/0001-session-ownership.md) — `recovery policy`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Stable S and separate per-run R
- Recorded bindings
- Complete retained context

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Router/Harness selection of private recovery state
- Calling full history archive recovery

**Writable boundary:**
- server/agent_service/backend/session_manager/proxy.py
- tests/server/st/test_dm31_a04.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-A03](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/751)

**Blocks:** [DM31-A07](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/755), [DM31-A27](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/818)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A05](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/753), [DM31-A06](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/754), [DM31-A31](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/757), [DM31-A32](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/758)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** - A19 defines Live/Offloaded/Archived details; this slice creates no additional SLA

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Public reads enforce scope, revision and binding
- Missing versions/material fail explicitly
- Restoration never replays historical effects automatically

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.server.st.test_dm31_a04

**Cases:** - Real Store reopen through Manager to run-start material
- Foreign scope and missing binding

**Participants:** Real Manager and Store with file-backed SQLite; synthetic bound-session records and injected runtime-handle availability. No provider execution.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** foundation, recovery. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** ADR0001, ADR0003.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

手机号登录失败时，页面只显示固定文案“手机号验证未完成，请稍后重试。”，无论底层是验证码错误、验证码过期，还是 AGC 拒绝当前应用签名，用户看到的提示都一样，日志里也只有原始错误码，没有类别或修复方向。

本次复现中，底层真实错误是 AGC 认证服务返回 `code=12000006`（应用签名与 AGC 登记指纹不一致时出现）。同一时刻切到“使用华为账号登录”，页面能显示“应用签名与 AGC 配置不匹配，请检查证书指纹。”，说明华为账号路径已区分类别，而手机号路径把错误统一吞成了通用文案。

复现步骤：

1. 在模拟器上安装一个签名证书与 AGC 登记指纹不一致的构建（本次使用本地 release 证书签名，versionCode 10016）。
2. 启动应用，进入登录页。
3. 点击“手机号登录”，输入已注册手机号与任意验证码后点击“登录”。
4. 页面稳定显示“手机号验证未完成，请稍后重试。”；`hilog` 过滤 `DigitalMateAuth` 可见唯一线索：

```text
11-11 09:33:02.654  4204  4204 E A00000/DigitalMateAuth: Account credential failed: code=12000006
```

同一构建点击“使用华为账号登录”时，界面显示：

```text
应用签名与 AGC 配置不匹配，请检查证书指纹。
```

代码位置与原因：

- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/account/CloudAccountService.ets` 的 `signIn()` 在 `credential.kind === 'phone'` 时，对任何异常都走 `credentialError(error, '手机号验证未完成，请稍后重试。')`，没有把 AGC 错误码传给用户可见文案。
- `credentialError()` 只映射 AGC 业务码（`203818032`、`203818129`、`203818134`、`203817986`、`203818038`、`203818039`、`203818081`）和网络错误码，`12000006` 落到 `fallback`。
- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/account/HuaweiAccountService.ets` 的 `huaweiLoginErrorMessage()` 已经为指纹不匹配（`1001500001`）准备了专门文案，但手机号路径没有复用这类分类。

期望行为：

1. 手机号登录失败时区分“验证码错误/失效”“验证码格式错误”“网络异常”“应用签名或 AGC 配置不匹配”等原因，给出可操作提示。
2. 至少把 AGC 原始错误码写进可见的诊断信息或结构化日志，避免只留下 `code=<数字>`。
3. “应用签名与 AGC 配置不匹配”这类环境问题应在登录入口统一提示，而不是按登录方式给出互相矛盾的文案。

说明：本次现象由本地非 AGC 登记证书签名触发，在 AGC 登记指纹的 debug 签名包上未复现登录失败。因此本 issue 聚焦“失败原因被统一吞掉、无法区分”的可诊断性缺陷，而不是要求应用在签名不匹配时完成登录。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 设备：DevEco Studio HarmonyOS 模拟器，HarmonyOS 6.0.0.130，API 22，分辨率 1280×2832。
- 主机：Windows 11，DevEco Studio 26.0，hvigor 构建。
- 应用：`com.jiuwen.digitalmate`，versionName 0.1.0，versionCode 10016，debug `buildMode` 的 `assembleHap` 产物。
- 签名：本地 release 证书（`DM-release-signing`），未在 AGC 登记同一指纹。
- 网络：模拟器网络正常，能访问 AGC 认证服务并返回业务错误码。
- 复现稳定性：每次登录均复现；切换华为账号登录也会提示签名与 AGC 不匹配。

### Additional Information

- 该构建安装后，升级启动恢复日志为 `DigitalMateUpdate: Upgrade startup recovery completed: version=10016, route=signed_out`，随后进入登录页，与“签名变化导致本地会话不可用”一致。
- 若能提供把 AGC 错误码映射到用户文案的统一入口，可同时覆盖登录、绑定、验证码重发等路径，避免各调用点各自兜底。

### Version Information

- 客户端源码：`feat/session-artifact-history` 分支，commit `dd62f89ca6f484dc3a459941246e9ecf581c6c99`
- 应用版本：versionName `0.1.0`，versionCode `10016`
- AGC Auth SDK：随工程 `@hw-agconnect/auth` 依赖引入，具体版本未单独记录
- 设备系统：HarmonyOS `6.0.0.130`（API 22）

### Screenshots / Recordings

![手机号登录只显示通用失败文案](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/fd0e1de19a3a1fc443682634bb1b6d72e9cfa1d7/.github/issue-assets/login-agc-signature/phone-login-error.jpeg)

![华为账号登录提示应用签名与 AGC 配置不匹配](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/fd0e1de19a3a1fc443682634bb1b6d72e9cfa1d7/.github/issue-assets/login-agc-signature/agc-fingerprint-mismatch.jpeg)

#### Final objectives, acceptance criteria and benefit reporting (confirmed 2026-11-09)

**Overall objective:** Preserve supported functionality, client compatibility and data semantics while migrating the server to components with clear responsibilities, a single writer for each authoritative state domain, and collaboration through public contracts. Complete source-directory and documentation-governance convergence, make common feature changes and component substitutions local in scope, and demonstrate through actual execution that critical paths have no significant performance regression.

This section consolidates maintainer-confirmed final deliverables and reporting requirements for this master tracker and Q11 #828. **Accepted requirements do not establish completed implementation or verification.** The existing frozen baselines, supported scope, contracts, client acceptance and stricter gates below remain binding. This section authorizes no new product semantics, relaxes no existing gate, reopens no accepted task, and does not accumulate all final acceptance under a single foundation component such as A02. Each child task closes against its original, explicit deliverable boundary; its owning task retains any outstanding final integration obligation, summarized here.

**1. Required deliverables and evidence-based acceptance**

| Objective | Observable acceptance criteria | Primary evidence and ownership |
|---|---|---|
| Clear component responsibilities and dependency boundaries, independently verifiable and replaceable through contracts | Components in migration scope have named owners, public interfaces and declared acyclic dependencies. Each authoritative state domain has one writer. Cross-component calls use public proxies, without accessing another component's private objects or authoritative tables. The actual default production entry reaches the new owner; migrated capabilities have no duplicate authority, silent legacy-executor fallback or reconnectable bypass. Representative implementation substitutions use established extension interfaces without modifying callers' internal logic. Independent deployment of every component and zero dependencies are not required. | Ownership/interface inventory, real call and write traces, boundary counterexamples, substitution and component tests; existing architecture, component and G05/G10 gates apply. Transitional legacy deviations still require an owner, cleanup task and bounded exit condition; they do not establish final migration completion. |
| Remove duplicate responsibilities and retired execution paths; converge the source layout | Every affected old path has an explicit migrate, retain or retire disposition. Server layout converges on the accepted architecture-foundation target while preserving unrelated `digitalmate/` client code, business code and dependencies with pinned provenance. Entry points, builds, imports, tests and deployment use the correct paths. Deletions require reference, call-path and functional evidence. Do not remove functionality to meet a line-count target or mechanically copy an entire branch. | D01 #845 path dispositions, entry mapping, clean installation/build and execution verification; code measurements are reported separately under the rules below. |
| Bounded impact and verification cost for common changes | Compare 3–5 representative changes before and after migration, such as model/tool adaptation, implementation substitution and an internal component-rule change. Internal changes stay with their owner; adapter changes use the adapter and necessary registration without modifying unrelated core code. Genuine shared-contract changes still require owner coordination; there is no promise that every request changes only one component. Developers can locate owners, contracts, entries and verification commands from documentation. | For each case, record baseline/candidate implementations or a reproducible change exercise, affected components/owners/files, unrelated core changes, verification environment/steps/time and component-level testability. Directory counts alone do not establish development efficiency. |
| Preserve functionality, client compatibility and data semantics | Retain the original frozen-baseline, supported configuration/API, full default Harness and unchanged-HAP A/B acceptance obligations, including files/artifacts, history, answer/retry/continue/cancel and the other established capabilities. Preserve persisted records and identities. Simplified probes, fake owners and component tests cannot replace actual client acceptance. | Existing Q04–Q10, capability matrix, identical HAP/driver/assertions, real production participants and deployment evidence; retain original failures and disposition differences individually. |
| Explainable and traceable failure, cancellation and recovery behavior | Verify duplicate requests, lost post-commit receipts, concurrency, Stop and unknown-outcome handling under existing contracts. Execution authority cannot resume after Stop. Correlate requests with M/S/R, attempts/actual implementations, commits and outcomes to identify the responsible component. Prove only the accepted recovery and bounded history-retention scope, without extending it to automatic continuation after arbitrary crashes. | Normal and fault evidence through real owners/persistence, Q03 tracing, existing lifecycle/Store contracts and negative cases; identify controlled substitutes and their scope. |
| Reproducible delivery and authoritative contributor guidance | Trace source, dependencies, build configuration, images and actual installed/runtime identities; verify clean deployment and existing rollback boundaries. AGENTS.md contains stable principles and protocol entry points while retaining effective constraints. Documentation establishes authoritative sources, navigation, old-document dispositions and repaired links under `protocols/specs/adr/procedures/lessons/verification/updates`, distinguishing proposed, accepted, implemented and verified status. | Existing build/deployment and G05 verification, D02 #847, D03 #848 and D01 final reference reconciliation; historical evidence proves only its named revision and scope. |
| No significant critical-path performance regression | Measure server overhead under comparable environments and workloads, reporting actual end-to-end behavior separately. Meet existing stricter service objectives and deadlines. Freeze baselines, measurement methods and tolerances before the final comparison; do not infer performance from architecture or widen thresholds after observing failures. | Comparative report under the performance rules below, included in Q11's final verdict; no unmeasured claim of “no regression.” |

**2. Required factual benefit reporting, without promised improvement percentages**

- **Code reduction:** Fix start/end SHAs and the first-party production-code counting scope. Separately report (1) evidenced removal of duplicate, unreachable or retired code, (2) added contract, adapter and reliability code, and (3) net production-code change. Report changes outside the first two categories separately so totals reconcile. Moves, copying followed by deletion, and formatting-only changes do not count as deduplication benefits. Count tests, documentation, generated code and third-party code with pinned provenance separately. Supply the counting tool, configuration, exclusions and representative deletion evidence. No reduction of N lines or N% is promised; a net increase does not automatically fail acceptance.
- **Development cost:** For the representative cases above, report change impact, environment preparation, required verification steps and elapsed time. Distinguish human work, tool waiting and test execution, and state sample limitations. Do not directly translate agent concurrency, model differences or one exercise into developer-productivity gains. Report measured improvement, no improvement or trade-offs without promising a productivity percentage.
- **Performance:** Keep hardware/resource limits, data volume, concurrency, workload and warm-up strategy comparable for server measurements. Use fixed model/tool responses to isolate external variability. Cover applicable queuing/submission, history reads, cancellation acknowledgement and execution-scheduling overhead. Report p50/p95, applicable throughput under fixed-load and saturation conditions, peak memory, and success/error/timeout rates so dropped work cannot appear as a speed gain. Separately report real end-to-end time using the same client and scenarios, explicitly identifying model/network and other external effects instead of combining the two into one conclusion. Record sample counts, repetitions, variability, commands and raw results.
- **Performance tolerances for baseline calibration only:** Evaluation may start from “p95 latency and peak memory increase by no more than 10% relative to baseline; throughput remains at least 95% of baseline.” These are **candidate tolerances, not active gates, passing results or exemptions from existing stricter objectives**. First measure baseline noise and applicable service objectives. The responsible owner then specifies absolute deadlines, applicable metrics and final thresholds, freezes them, and runs the candidate comparison. Record and disposition every unmet condition. Test-scanning/CI speed improvements count only toward verification cost, not product runtime performance.

**3. Consistent acceptance and progress reporting**

1. Trace every conclusion through “requirement/objective → owner and task → exact baseline/candidate SHA → actual entry and participants → commands, environment, results and evidence → outstanding work/blocker and next responsible owner.” Label evidence as source, component, integration, deployment or unchanged-HAP scope; these scopes are not interchangeable. Retain initial failures and subsequent runs without overwriting history.
2. Keep `proposed / accepted / implemented / verified` distinct, and keep execution outcomes `PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT_RUN / INVALID` distinct. Completed documentation, a merged PR, increased test counts, reachable infrastructure or a successfully built image does not automatically establish production migration or client acceptance.
3. Close child tasks against their original acceptance criteria and backfill post-merge evidence, residual work and downstream dependencies. Do not expand a foundation package merely to close the master tracker. Report overall task counts, source integration, deployment and client acceptance separately. Without new formally tracked tasks, this section changes no denominator and manufactures no completion count.
4. The final #737 / Q11 #828 report consolidates the required deliverables, measured benefits and unresolved differences above. No minimum positive reduction in net code, development effort or additional runtime cost is promised, but the corresponding measurements and reproducible reports are required. Outstanding unrun, invalid or blocked mandatory acceptance prevents an unconditional refactor-completion claim. Existing difference-disposition and authorization rules continue to apply; retain visible limitations and their scope.

### Proposed Solution

**Architecture:** Message/Session/Run are core identities. Router selects Session and execution path; Session Manager owns admission/recovery; SQLite Store owns authoritative DM records; backend owns execution coordination/controls/final publication; Harness owns loop policy; Runtime owns same-process Python assembly/readiness/lifecycle. Every parent/child/summary/compression/vision/skill model/tool/context effect follows HostAPI. Public proxies mediate cross-component operations. Exact Registry factories bind sessions; replacement works without installed default Core. Room is a compatibility projection. Artifact bytes survive execution workspace release. Gateways dispatch/normalize evidence, host hooks own application policy, BudgetProvider alone owns balances, Store owns attempt/turn accounting. Stop permanently closes execution authority; late accounting cannot reopen it or change terminal outcome.

**Main reuse strategy:** retain the pinned normal DeepAgent/task-loop/ReAct algorithms, prompt attachment logic, default general-purpose children and six controls, six office skills, pure file/image/office validation and provider business leaves. Both ordinary/simple main modes currently select `agent.work.normal`; do not mistake simple heuristics for a current model-only path. Team is off by default but supported explicit configuration must have a migration path. Rehome model/tool dispatch, SDK checkpoint/history, child persistence, compaction inference, vision reads and skill process I/O to their host/provider owners. Do not retain WorkSwarm supervisor, Session DB, EngineService or DeepAdapter global bootstrap as a second execution authority. Existing UI and wire consumers remain the comparison target.

recent.author: HugoXK
recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched related issues but did not get the expected help.（已检索并关联 #379、#373、#322、#367）
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.（main @ 0fb0456 的客户端里没有任何"长时间无输出"的兜底提示）
- [x] I have provided a minimal reproduction and the code paths that cause it.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：一轮回复在只输出一句话后就彻底没有下文，界面一直停留在"运行中"，既不说明还在处理，也不报错，用户只能换话题或手动停止。#379 的现场证据（2026-10-30，内测群）：用户问「翠果打烂他的嘴，是谁的名言」，回复只有「我核对一下具体是谁说的。」，之后没有任何输出，也没有失败提示或重试入口。

**根因在客户端这一侧（本 issue 只覆盖客户端）**：客户端只在**连接断开**时才会去核对任务状态，socket 正常但没有事件时它没有任何判断依据，于是 `state` 一直停在 `running`：

- `CloudSession` 里只有两个定时器：`flushTimer`（流式合并 40 ms）和 `controlTimer`（停止/暂停结果 30 s 超时）。没有"多久没收到事件"的看护。
- `CloudChatManager.reconcileAfterReconnect()` 只由连接状态变化触发；连接没断，就不会跑一次状态核对。
- 结果：气泡停在半句话，`state === 'running'`，composer 一直是"停止"状态，用户无法区分"模型还在想"和"云端已经不会再回了"。

**最小复现（仓库内可执行，不需要真机）**

```js
// tests/unit/cloud-session-quiet-watch.test.mjs（本 issue 附带的回归测试）
const session = new CloudSession('s', 40);   // 40 ms 阈值，生产默认 60 s
session.beginTurn('turn');
event(session, 'chat.delta', { request_id: 'turn', content: '我核对一下具体是谁说的。' });
// 之后云端不再发任何事件，等过一个阈值
// 实际：session.state === 'running'，session.notice === undefined —— 界面没有任何提示
// 期望：出现一条 warn 提示「云端仍在处理，近一分钟没有新的输出…」
```

真机侧同一现象见 #379 的两张截图（「我核对一下…」后无下文；另一张是长任务尾部重复文本）。

**实际结果**：超过一分钟没有任何输出时，界面状态与刚开始执行时完全一样，没有任何说明。

**期望结果**：

- 仍有未完成输出的轮次，若超过阈值没有任何云端事件，要明确告诉用户"仍在处理"，而不是让用户自己猜。
- 用户能据此选择继续等待或停止任务（停止入口已有，不需要新增协议）。
- 任何新事件到达、轮次正常结束、轮次报错、等待用户确认时，都不能残留这条提示。
- 提示不得覆盖已经存在的真实错误提示。

**影响**：用户把"云端没回应"误判为"回答就是这样"，直接损毁对回复完整性的信任；#379 的另一半（尾部重复文本）与 #322（工具调用回复非流式）让这种长静默更容易出现。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 客户端：`digitalmate/cloud-adapter`（WorkSwarm 云对话），HarmonyOS 手机端；本 issue 的复现基于 `main` 的 `tests/unit` Node 测试（加载真实 `CloudSession` 业务类，不需要真机与后端）。
- 真机环境（原报告 #379）：HarmonyOS，4G/5G 移动网络，ADX 测试云 `wss://1.94.211.46/orbit/ws`，模板 `v15-workspace-20261028-a974262d1-8ed6d181-no-split`。
- 网络：本缺陷与网络质量无关——连接正常、无事件即触发。

### Additional Information

- 与 #379 的关系：#379 是用户可见的完整现象（尾部重复文本 + 静默停止），根因可能多方；本 issue 只做客户端可独立完成的那一半——"静默要有说法"，不改服务端、不改失败判定。
- 与 #373（执行中状态信息量不足）同属"过程黑盒"，但 #373 关注执行中过程展示，本 issue 只关注**完全没有事件**的静默窗口。
- 与 #322（带工具调用回复为非流式）相关：非流式工具阶段本来就可能长时间无事件，因此本提示必须是"仍在处理"这种中性说明，不能是错误。

### Version Information

- 仓库：`openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate`，`main` @ `0fb0456`
- App 版本/构建号：原报告未记录，不影响客户端状态机层面的定位

### Screenshots / Recordings

真机复现截图（原报告 #379 的同一现象：「我核对一下具体是谁说的。」之后没有任何输出）：

![回复在「我核对一下具体是谁说的。」之后没有下文](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/test-evidence-20261028/test-evidence/20261030/20261030_2013_reply_stall.jpg?raw=true)

![同一类静默：长任务后回复尾部残缺，界面没有终态提示](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/test-evidence-20261028/test-evidence/20261030/20261030_2016_east_africa_no_reply_then_fail.jpg?raw=true)

### 背景与证据

- `CloudSession` 中不存在"多久没事件"的判断：只有 40 ms 流式合并定时器与 30 s 控制结果超时。
- 状态核对 `reconcileAfterReconnect()` 仅由连接状态变化触发，健康连接下的静默轮次永不被核对。
- 用户在 #379 中的反馈与截图：一句话之后没有下文，界面无失败提示、无重试入口。

### 用户故事

作为用户，当云端超过一分钟没有任何输出时，我需要界面告诉我"仍在处理"，这样我才能决定继续等还是停止，而不是把半句话当成完整回答。

### 现状与差距

| 差距 | 证据 |
| --- | --- |
| 静默轮次没有任何看护 | `CloudSession` 只有 `flushTimer` / `controlTimer` |
| 状态核对只在断线后发生 | `CloudChatManager.reconcileAfterReconnect()` 由连接状态变化触发 |
| 气泡停在半句话且无提示 | #379 截图 + 本次最小复现 |

### 验收标准

- [ ] 运行中的轮次超过阈值（默认 60 s）没有任何云端事件时，会话出现 warn 级提示"仍在处理"，不改写 `state`、不伪造失败。
- [ ] 任何新事件到达后提示立即消失，且不残留到下一轮。
- [ ] 轮次正常结束、报错、暂停、等待用户确认时不出现该提示。
- [ ] 已存在的真实提示不会被它覆盖。
- [ ] 提示在同一段静默里只出现一次，不会每分钟重复刷屏。
- [ ] 回归测试先失败后通过，并进入 `tests/unit/*.test.mjs` 的既有发现路径。

### 非目标检查

- 不自动把轮次判定为失败，不新增终态，不改服务端协议。
- 不新增"重试上一轮"这类需要后端能力的动作（用户已可用停止 + 重新发送）。
- 不记录 prompt/response 正文，不新增依赖，不扩大权限。
- 不改执行过程的展示方式（那是 #373/#375 的范围）。

### 风险

- 误报：非流式工具阶段本来可能长时间无事件。缓解：提示是中性的 warn 说明（"仍在处理"），不改状态、不阻断输入，任何事件立刻清除，且同一段静默只提示一次；阈值可配置，默认 60 s。
- 遗留风险：若云端最终确实不再返回，客户端仍停在 `running`，需要服务端补终态（不在本 issue 范围，见 #367/#379）。

### 优先级与预估

- 优先级：P1（静默无终态直接损毁对回复完整性的信任，且 P1 连续性体验的核心是"知道它还在"）
- 预估：0.5 天（一个看护定时器 + 3 个生命周期接入点 + 7 条回归测试）
- 标签说明：目标要求的 `goal:P1`、`type:bug`、`priority:P1` 等标签在仓库中不存在，创建标签属设置变更，本 issue 使用仓库既有 `bug` 标签。

### 相关链接

- 完整现象：#379（静默停止 + 尾部重复文本）
- 相关：#373（执行中状态信息不足）、#322（工具调用回复非流式）、#367（失败信息回写上下文）
- 修复 PR：`fix/cloud-session-quiet-watch`（引用本 issue）

### 🚀 Background Description

长答 / Today 类调研对比当前默认整屏文字墙，难扫、易崩溃。提案：默认**一次卡片 + 渐进式披露**（总览与分条摘要先出，详情点开），与结果卡形态一致。

证据与 UX 讨论见 [#374](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/374)；结构化质量见 [#356](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/356)、[#344](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/344)。截图见首评。

### Design Ideas

1. 默认：总览卡 + N 条摘要卡（标题/一句话/标签）
2. 展开：单条详情或「查看全文」
3. 不适用：极短答复仍可纯文本
4. 备选：仅折叠「查看更多」但首屏仍长文（不足，不推荐作默认）

### Involved Public APIs

壳侧结果卡 / 卡片列表组件；Agent 输出结构化字段（summary + items[]）。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Today / 信息聚合、多图解读、宽表结果卡；执行可见 [#373](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/373)。

### Test Design and Test Plan

1. 多产品对比类提问：首屏无文字墙，可见卡片摘要
2. 点开一条可见详情；极短答不强制卡片
3. e2e 可纳入 [#348](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/348) 候选

### Additional Information

产品侧明确为 **proposal**（非仅 UX 报障）。#374 可作证据/UX 跟踪，实现以本 Feature 为准。

recent.author: qq56734
recent.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

本轮客户端把「话题」路由整体移除了，先按会话线程（thread）呈现，后续再把话题路由接回来。本 issue 用于追踪这次重新接入，避免相关工作散落在已关闭的缺陷单里。

**当前形态**

- 「实时活动」按 thread 聚合：一张卡片是一个会话，展开后列出该会话的每一轮。相关实现见 `OrbitConversation.threadItems()`。
- 话题入口已不可达：`Index.ets` 中的 `selectedTopic` 自 `eed99a9` 起只会被赋值为空串，没有任何代码路径能把它设成非空。原先点击活动条目进入单个话题聊天的能力随「继续对话」一起撤掉了。
- 话题数据仍然存在：服务端照常返回 `topic_id`，客户端 `OrbitConversation` 也仍在用 `topic_id` 计算 `topics`、`taskTopic()`、`rowsForTopic()`。也就是说底层话题信息没丢，只是没有 UI 入口，属于「断电但线路还在」的状态。

**为什么要移除**

移除前，同一个会话里的追问会被服务端分配新的 `topic_id`，列表随即把它拆成两条互不相干的记录，用户看到的是「明明在聊同一件事，却变成两个话题」。在话题切分本身不可靠的前提下，话题入口会把这个问题放大成导航问题——点进去只能看到半段对话。详见 #206 的讨论与 #208 的复现。

**重新接入的前提**

1. 服务端话题切分要能覆盖「完成一轮之后再派生」的续接，不能只在短时间 burst 内合并。Orbit 侧对应 PR #2218（旧轨 #2209 已撤回重做），尚未合入。
2. 客户端要能拿到「话题 → 该话题下全部轮次」的完整映射，而不是只拿到当前轮。

在 1 和 2 都成立之前，不建议恢复话题入口，否则会重现「进得去但看不全」的问题。

### Design Ideas

**模型层**

话题与会话的关系需要先定死：一个会话（thread）可以包含多个话题（topic），话题是会话内的一段连续上下文，而不是与会话平行的另一个维度。#206 曾定稿「话题 = 会话线程」，那是当时话题路由作为唯一入口时的妥协；重新接入时应改为「会话是容器、话题是容器内的分段」，两者不再混同。

`OrbitConversation` 现有的 `topics` / `taskTopic()` / `rowsForTopic()` 可以保留复用，只需补一层「按话题聚合轮次」的视图，与 `threadItems()` 并列。

**交互层**

建议在展开的会话内部做话题分段，而不是在活动列表这一层再平铺一层话题卡片——列表已经承载了会话，再叠一层话题会让层级过深。可选方案，按倾向排序：

1. 展开会话后，轮次之间插入话题分隔；点击分隔可折叠该段。
2. 展开会话后按话题分组显示，组标题即话题名。
3. 保留活动列表平铺话题（回到旧形态）——不推荐，除非服务端切分准确率足够高。

无论哪种，都需要明确：进入某话题时看到的是该话题的完整对话，而不是从该话题第一轮开始的孤立片段。

**兼容**

`selectedTopic` 这套状态机目前是死代码，重新接入时要么真正接上入口，要么先删掉，避免长期留着误导后续维护者。

### Involved Public APIs

无端侧公开 API 变更。涉及内部结构：

- `OrbitConversation`：新增按话题聚合的视图方法，`threadItems()` 保持不变。
- `OrbitTopicView` / `OrbitActivityItem`：`topicId` 字段已存在，预计无需改动。

服务端依赖 Orbit 的话题切分修复，不新增客户端接口。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- **Orbit 服务端**：话题分配逻辑（`topic_id` 的生成与续接）是本次接入的前置条件，对应 Orbit PR #2218。
- **实时活动列表**：话题分段会改变展开区的结构，与本轮已完成的 thread 聚合、轮次行状态展示相互影响，需要一起回归。
- **通知与跳转**：`OrbitNotificationRoute` 目前按 task 跳转；若话题成为可导航维度，通知跳转目标是否需要带话题需要一并确认。

### Test Design and Test Plan

**功能**

1. 同一会话内连续追问（含「完成一轮后再派生」的场景），应归入同一话题，展开会话后该话题包含全部轮次。
2. 进入任一话题，能看到该话题的完整对话，而不是从中间轮开始。
3. 不同会话的同名话题不得合并。

**回归**

1. 不涉及话题的普通多轮对话，列表与展开行为与本轮版本一致。
2. 停止、重试仍作用于单个轮次，不因话题分组而变成话题级操作。
3. 归档、重命名、删除会话的行为不受影响。

**可靠性**

话题切分失败或缺失 `topic_id` 时，退化为按会话呈现，不得让轮次消失或重复。

### Additional Information

- 相关讨论：#206（话题与会话的语义澄清，本轮已关闭）、#208（话题关联失败的具体复现，本轮已关闭）。
- 关闭说明：上述两个 issue 的问题在当前「按会话呈现」的形态下不再出现，因此先关闭，由本 issue 承接后续接入。

recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**

正常对话的首 token 时延（从点击发送到界面出现第一个可见字符）约 **5s**；一旦涉及联网搜索或工具调用，首次可见反馈常常超过 **20s**，期间界面基本空白，用户容易误以为卡住或失败。

**复现步骤**

1. 手机端 Digital Mate 打开与 Beebou 的对话。
2. 发送一个普通问题，例如「现在从公司回小区，地铁和打车哪个快」。
3. 从点击发送开始计时，到出现第一个可见文本 / 流式片段：约 5s。
4. 再发送一个需要联网搜索或工具调用的问题。
5. 首次可见反馈：>20s，等待期间没有进度或状态提示。

**预期行为**

- 首 token 目标：<1s；业界主流 agent 约 **500ms** 量级。
- 如果必须先做路由 / 分类 / 搜索 / 工具调用，应立即输出可见状态（如「正在检索…」），不要整段空白。
- 最终答案应流式增量输出，而不是全部生成完再一次性显示。

**实际行为**

- 普通对话 TTFT ≈ 5s；
- 含搜索 / 工具调用 ≈ 20s+；
- 等待期间缺少即时反馈，容易被误判为失败。

**可能原因（供参考）**

- 首 token 之前的串行链路过长：route → classify → brief → 工具调用 → 联网搜索，全部完成才开始输出；
- 响应不是增量流式，或流式片段被缓冲到完成后才渲染；
- 云端执行服务（Orbit Cloud）与客户端之间存在额外重连 / 轮询等待；
- 客户端与云端之间的状态同步延迟。

**建议**

- 设定 TTFT 预算：普通对话 p50 < 1s、p90 < 2s；工具类任务先出状态、再出结果。
- 在首 token 之前先发一条轻量状态消息（流式占位），不要空白等待。
- 搜索 / 工具调用尽量并行化，或先把「正在检索」回传给客户端。
- Orbit 已记录每轮 `Run.first_text_ms` 和 step 耗时瀑布，可直接用来量化 route / brief / execute 各阶段并作为回归指标。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 设备：手机（型号未记录）
- 系统：HarmonyOS / Android（具体版本待补充）
- 客户端：Digital Mate 测试包（版本号未记录）
- 服务端：Orbit Cloud
- 网络：正常 Wi-Fi / 运营商网络
- 复现时间：约 03:48（Asia/Shanghai）

### Additional Information

- 同类问题参考：业界主流 agent 在同类问答中约 500ms 量级开始输出，并会先给出「搜索 3 个关键词，参考 14 篇资料」这类过程反馈。
- 度量说明：当前 TTFT 为人工目测估计，建议后续用客户端埋点或 Orbit 的 `first_text_ms` 量化。
- 影响：等待感强，用户容易重复发送或退出；含工具调用时体验接近「卡死」。

### Version Information

- 仓库：openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate
- 分支：fix/foreground-reconnect-recovery
- commit：68a25a3f
- 上游基线：main

## 上下文
手机端 DigitalMate（Orbit 客户端）。用户让 agent「帮我给openjiuwen-ai下面的digitalmate仓库提issue」，agent 弹出「需求收集」卡，要求用户去 github.com/settings/tokens 生成并**在聊天里粘贴 GitHub Token**（勾选 repo），否则无法调用 GitHub API。用户回复「我手机上没有版本找到token」，流程卡住。

## 测试环境
- 客户端：DigitalMate 手机端（Orbit phone client）
- 场景：在对话中让 agent 代提 GitHub issue
- 时间：约 2026-10-21 12:20–12:21（Asia/Shanghai，截图状态栏）
- **版本（暂无正式版本号/分支）：** 按报告时间记为 `build≈2026-10-21`（Asia/Shanghai）
- 设备型号 / 正式 App 版本号：暂无，待补
## 原图

![要求粘贴 GitHub Token](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-21-github-token-ask.jpg?raw=true)

证据分支：`bot/issue-evidence` · [文件](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-21-github-token-ask.jpg)
（上下文）![后续需求收集卡](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-21-card-pending-banner.jpg?raw=true)

证据分支：`bot/issue-evidence` · [文件](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-21-card-pending-banner.jpg)
## 结果
- **实际：** 无应用内 GitHub 连接/OAuth；只能让用户手动创建 PAT 并在聊天中明文粘贴。手机用户基本无法完成，且在聊天中索要原始 token 有安全风险（token 进入对话记录/上下文）。
- **期望：** 提供授权连接流程（OAuth / GitHub App，范围可见、可撤销）；未支持时明确提示「暂不支持」。任何情况下不在聊天中索要原始 PAT。

## 验收
- [ ] 手机端可通过授权流程连接 GitHub 并提 issue，或给出明确的「暂不支持」提示
- [ ] 对话中不再出现索要原始 token 的文案

recent.body:
## 上下文
手机端 DigitalMate。「发现」负一屏瀑布流体验可用（新闻/视频卡片、底部提示「试试说：多给我推荐点足球内容」）。产品侧需确认：当前流是否已由个人记忆驱动。报告人判断「应该还和个人记忆没关系」——经对照代码后记录为观察/条目标清，非立刻修 bug。

## 测试环境
- **版本（暂无正式版本号/分支）：** 按报告时间记为 `build≈2026-10-20`（Asia/Shanghai）
- 截图状态栏时间：约 08:13
- 设备型号 / 正式 App 版本号：暂无，待补
- 客户端：DigitalMate 手机端（Orbit phone client）
- 路径：底栏「发现」

## 原图

![发现负一屏](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-20-discovery-vs-memory.jpg?raw=true)

证据分支：`bot/issue-evidence` · [文件](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-20-discovery-vs-memory.jpg)

## 结果
- **实际（体感）：** 发现流为通用信源内容（如医保、时政视频、妈祖等），未见明显由对话个人记忆个性化的证据；更像冷启/探索 + 发现页自有偏好（composer/标签）。
- **代码对照（现状，非实现任务）：**
  - 存在预留 `DiscoveryMemoryProjection`（`entry/.../waterfall/DiscoveryMemoryProjection*.ets`）：可把长期记忆投影为发现偏好信号。
  - 重建门槛：`DISCOVERY_MEMORY_PROJECTION_COUNT_THRESHOLD = 8`，且默认等待约 7 天（`DISCOVERY_MEMORY_PROJECTION_WAIT_MS`）——不是装上即读个人记忆。
  - 发现 PES 实验：P（profile）初始为空，经发现 composer/标签填充；新账号先走 E（探索）冷启。与对话「个人记忆」不是同一条即时通路。
- **期望（条目标清）：** 产品文档/验收写明：发现负一屏当前 **不依赖** 个人记忆即可用；若要「记忆 → 发现」接通，另开实现 issue，并写清门槛与验收。

## 验收
- [ ] README / 能力说明写清：发现 ≠ 已接个人记忆（或写明接通条件）
- [ ] 若做接通：有独立验收（记忆事实变更后发现偏好可见、可关、可解释）
- [ ] 本观察不阻塞发现负一屏作为独立体验继续迭代

recent.author: hsliuustc0106
recent.body:
## 动机

没有账号连接，消息导不进来，也无法跟 App 互联。用户不会主动去云侧/Orbit 完成授权，**连接必须在 DigitalMate 客户端内完成**。

参考 today.ai 的连接引导，但 DigitalMate 壳要保持简单：轻量连接入口，不做 dense 授权墙 / 工作台。

## 范围（首批）

逐步开放，建议顺序：

1. **飞书**（IM / 日程 / 文档相关导入）
2. **邮箱**（收件汇总、确认闸门前的草稿）
3. **GitHub**
4. **Gitee**

后续可扩展其它源；首版以「能导入关键消息 + 状态可见」为准。

## 产品约束

- **客户端直接连接**：OAuth / 登录在手机（或桌面）客户端完成，不依赖用户去云控制台操作
- **壳 UI 简单**：设置里轻量「已连接 / 去连接」列表 + 结果卡；不做 today.ai 式大卡片矩阵作为主路径（可作可选 onboarding）
- **确认闸门不变**：连接 ≠ 代发；对外写操作仍需用户确认
- **分发入口定位**：连接是为了让分发与结果卡有数据，不是把壳做成账号管理中心

## 非目标

- 首版不追求全量文件夹/本机 Desktop 扫描式连接（today.ai Mac 本地文件夹可后置）
- 不在壳上重建完整企业管理员控制台

## 验收

- [ ] 用户可在客户端完成至少一种源的连接（建议飞书或邮箱）
- [ ] 连接后相关消息/事件能导入，并在今日卡或结果卡可见
- [ ] 可断开连接；断开后停止导入
- [ ] e2e：连接 → 导入一条样例 → 结果卡展示 → 断开

## 开放问题

- 手机端 OAuth 回调与 token 存储放客户端安全区还是经后端换票？
- GitHub / Gitee 首版要读哪些范围（issues / PR / notifications）？

recent.author: huben0423-hw
recent.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

在“对比 iPhone Duo 和华为折叠屏，主要看拍照和续航”场景中，Digital Mate 目前以长文本和 Markdown 表格返回结果；业界 Agent 对照图则展示了商品图片、名称、参考价格及来源入口等结构化卡片。

建议为手机、电脑等商品对比场景提供结构化结果卡片，并把关键参数、价格和发布状态关联到可核验来源，方便用户快速比较和继续追问。该提案不替代 #229 的基础联网检索能力，也不把业界截图中的具体参数或价格视为已验证事实。

### Design Ideas

- 将每个候选商品展示为独立卡片，包含商品图、准确型号、发布状态、关键参数、参考价格、数据来源和更新时间。
- 对比结论中的参数应能回溯到卡片来源；未发布或缺少可靠来源的信息明确标为“未确认”，不得补写确定规格或价格。
- 支持基于当前对比结果继续追问，例如“再比较价格和套餐”，并保留候选项及用户已确认的约束。
- 无可靠商品数据时降级为现有文本/表格结果，不展示空白或误导性商品卡片。
- 替代方案：继续使用纯 Markdown 表格。该方案实现简单，但来源、价格时效和后续追问之间的关联较弱，因此不作为长期方案。

### Involved Public APIs

可能需要新增结构化商品结果及来源元数据协议，供云端向客户端传递商品、参数、价格和引用信息；具体字段及版本兼容策略需在设计阶段确认。应尽量复用现有消息与卡片渲染协议，避免仅在客户端猜测或硬编码商品信息。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- 云端检索与生成：负责获取可靠来源、校验发布状态及参数，并返回引用关系。
- 客户端消息卡片：负责商品卡片、对比表及降级内容的展示。
- 会话上下文：后续追问需复用同一组候选商品和用户偏好。
- 与 #229（联网检索）、#62（事实与引用校验）、#97（表格完整展示）相关，但本提案只跟踪结构化商品结果及后续比较交互。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- 功能：验证多商品卡片、参数来源跳转、参考价格与更新时间、追问“比较价格和套餐”的上下文延续。
- 事实校验：覆盖未发布、型号不存在、来源冲突、参数缺失和价格过期场景；无可靠来源时不得输出确定性规格或价格。
- 降级：断网、检索失败或无商品数据时返回可读的文本说明，不显示空卡片。
- UI：验证长型号、多卡片、深色模式、不同屏幕尺寸及无障碍字体下不截断、不重叠。
- 性能与可靠性：记录检索到首张卡片的时延，重复进入会话时确认卡片与引用可恢复。

### Additional Information

业界对照图仅用于展示信息架构和交互参考，其中具体商品、规格与价格仍需独立核验。

![业界 Agent 机型对比与商品卡片参考](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-26-phone-comparison-industry-agent.jpg?raw=true)

### Context

对话页 → 输入“对比 iPhone Duo 和华为折叠屏，我主要看拍照和续航”→ 查看用户消息及助手回复。

截图中 Beebou 形象浮层出现在用户气泡上方，遮住问题正文的中部，用户无法完整核对自己刚刚发送的内容。

### Test Environment

- 产品：Digital Mate 手机端
- 系统：HarmonyOS
- 设备型号、系统版本、App 版本：未提供
- 截图时间：04:53（Asia/Shanghai）
- 测试日期：2026-10-26

### Problem Description & Suggestions

**实际表现**

Beebou 形象及名称浮层与用户消息气泡重叠，遮挡“对比 iPhone Duo 和华为折叠屏……”中的部分文字。浮层出现期间，用户无法完整阅读消息。

**预期表现**

助手形象展示、加载动画或身份提示不应遮挡用户消息、助手回复及输入区；无论消息长度和滚动位置如何，正文都应完整可读。

**建议**

- 将 Beebou 形象放置在独立的顶部区域或消息之外的非阻塞区域，避免绝对定位覆盖正文。
- 如必须临时覆盖，应缩短展示时间、支持点击关闭，并确保不遮住当前交互内容。
- 补充不同屏幕尺寸、字体大小、长消息及滚动状态下的布局回归测试。

当前截图观察到一次，浮层持续时长和稳定复现条件待进一步确认。

### Screenshots / Recordings

![Beebou 形象浮层遮挡用户消息](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-26-phone-comparison-digitalmate.jpg?raw=true)

### Additional Information (optional)

该问题与 #235 的状态栏内容重叠不同：本问题仅跟踪 Beebou 形象浮层对用户消息的遮挡。

items.body:
Restores **1 E4 workflow, DM-WF-FILE-02**, and repairs the existing **DM-WF-ATTACH-01** Nightly adapter. The two cases have **2 complete passes, 0 failures and 0 blocked results** in their linked executions.

| Case | Verified behavior | Actual result and evidence |
|---|---|---|
| DM-WF-FILE-02 | Two successful writes to the same original path; exact FIRST and FINAL bytes; one artifact card; FINAL before and after background recovery. | 13 assertions and cleanup passed. [Complete Nightly run](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/42939739447) · [Report and screenshots](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/3b4abacde6c7fd993cd51ffb4cfebf22df45263b/tests/e2e/results/e4-nightly-hk/DM-WF-FILE-02/README.md) |
| DM-WF-ATTACH-01 | Switch attempt during a real 3.5 MiB upload; attachment remains in room A; removal clears the HK record; room B receives one plain control submission without an attachment. | 8 assertions and cleanup passed. The final inspection completed in one read with no retries. [Complete Nightly run](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/42946573362) · [Report and screenshot](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/3b4abacde6c7fd993cd51ffb4cfebf22df45263b/tests/e2e/results/e4-nightly-hk/DM-WF-ATTACH-01/README.md) |

ATTACH-01 previously required every task source reference to resolve to a visible file-source record. The backend also stores remembered message references whose records may be outside that snapshot. The reader now follows that distinction. Actual attachment records, conflicting identities and unknown missing sources remain checked. A bounded read-only retry never resends the control message; fixed diagnostic codes preserve the failing stage without exposing private errors.

FILE-02 ran on `3d64adf622c3378679a84f0fba22811bed3f0a58`; ATTACH-01 ran on `71e57c84340ecf3b7481d945459a19811d0f38c5` with the already installed App. This PR integrates the tested reader with main and limits its diagnostic-code handling to ATTACH cloud inspection. No business assertion was removed. Each result is one complete execution; repeated stability and release acceptance are not claimed.

Validation:

- Main `7facb03df6adb537e34878a0bd59235c5bd145a3` (including #1090) was merged into this branch at `5e9ba3b91ae526c6c8360b5c3cee7c73a328aa54`. GitHub reports no conflicts; checks for this integration are running. The preceding head passed all checks ([CI run](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/42947874616)).
- After integration, 190 targeted Node checks, all 30 active workflows and the daily baseline validated successfully. Both cases retain their existing execution evidence.
- Both complete GitHub Nightly workflows succeeded, including evidence publication and final reports.
- 66 targeted ATTACH and supplemental-driver checks passed on the integrated source. Counterexamples retain real attachments, reject conflicting bindings and missing file sources, and prevent error-code exposure outside ATTACH inspection.
- FILE adapter, receipt, archive, reset and workflow validation checks passed during its integration.
- Nightly YAML, shell syntax and `git diff --check` passed.

GPT-6 Astra review of the latest integration and evidence remains pending because the review quota is unavailable. Related to #565.

items.author: qq56734
items.body:
## What this fixes

Issue #956 asks for the startup screen to stop showing detailed connection steps, and for failure
and retry detail to stay off the screen. Investigating on latest `main` showed the request is not
about one sentence: **the connection UI accepted free text from the transport and the gateway, and
the only thing between a user and a `wss://` address was a regex.**

This is the fourth round of the same defect (#138 → #136 → #422 → #956). Each earlier round patched
the regex, so the next sentence the team wrote walked straight through it. This PR fixes the pipeline
and adds two suites that fail the build if it regresses.

## What was actually on screen

Measured by running the real `digitalmateUserFacingError` against the real copy tables on `a78b20b1`:

- **9 transport sentences** reached the banner verbatim, including
  `'DigitalMate 握手失败，请检查测试凭据'` — the team talking to itself — and
  `'DigitalMate 连接异常（1006），请检查地址、网络和测试凭据'`, which carries an SDK error code and
  an address hint.
- **15 of the gateway's 21 public strings** reached it unchanged. The worst:
  `'云侧鉴权接口未找到（HTTP 404）。请核对：鉴权入口地址、/auth/* 转发规则，以及 ADX 版本与账号路由是否已启用。'`
  A 64-character operator sentence, under the 80-character length guard that was supposed to catch it.
- `GatewayAccountPanel` printed `snapshot.message` with no sanitizer at all, so one failure showed
  one wording in the banner and a different one in settings.
- The banner printed `'正在重新连接云端（第 3 次）…'`.

`CloudHome/Index.ets` still has `'正在连接 ' + endpoint.url + ' …'`, but it is unreachable under the
shipped config (`cloudBackend: "digitalmate"` makes `A2uiHome` render `Blank()` instead of
`CloudConversation`), so it is not touched here.

## The change: a code, one table, one boundary

**1. The failure travels as a code.**

- `DigitalMateTransportReason` in `DigitalMateSocket`: `handshake_timeout`, `handshake_failed`,
  `receive_failed`, `connection_error`, `closed`, `not_started`, `send_failed`, `client_closed`.
  The native error code still goes to `hilog`.
- `DigitalMateClientReason` in `DigitalMateClient`: `not_configured`, `auth_changed`,
  `login_required`, `connecting`, `not_connected`, `cancelled`, `request_timeout`, `send_failed`,
  `session_expired`, `foreground_resume`, `closed`.
- `GatewaySessionSnapshot.failureCode` carries the `GatewayAuthError.code` beside the diagnostic
  `message`, which stays for the log sheet.
- `DigitalMateConnectionUx` gains `CODE_KINDS` (a `Map`: ArkTS rejects untyped object literals)
  mapping both closed code sets to a `DigitalMateFailureKind`, and `digitalmateFailureText` as the
  single place a sentence is written. `TEXT_RULES` survives only so a record saved before this
  change still classifies.

The gateway's public copy loses the operator detail. **Nothing is lost diagnostically:**
`logFailure`/`logAgcDiagnostic` already record target, port, route, prefix, status and code for the
same failure, so the address, the HTTP status, `/auth/*` and the ADX version move to the log instead
of the banner.

**2. The UI has no field for prose.**

- `DigitalMateConnectionBanner` takes `failure` (classified through the one table) and `notice`
  (business prose, only while the transport is open). The `error` prop is gone — that is what makes
  a new sentence structurally unable to reach the screen.
- The line it shows comes from one function, `digitalmateBannerLine`, which the **device suite also
  calls** — so a device assertion covers exactly what a person reads.
- `GatewayAccountPanel` renders `digitalmateFailureText(digitalmateFailureKind(failureCode, message))`
  and no longer prints `snapshot.message`.
- `DigitalMateHome` drops the `gatewayRecoverMessage` field entirely.
- The retry ordinal is gone. `attempt` is still accepted so callers did not change, but it only
  distinguishes "connecting" from "still connecting".

#136 is preserved: a healthy transport with a business failure (`state === 'open'`) still shows its
own readable wording.

**3. Two suites guard it.**

`tests/unit/connection-copy-boundary.test.mjs` (new, **7 tests**, Node):

1. the banner accepts a failure to classify, never a finished sentence;
2. no connection surface renders the gateway diagnostic field;
3. the transport names a reason code instead of writing a sentence;
4. public copy carries no address, HTTP mechanic, `/auth/*`, ADX or test-credential wording;
5. the banner narrates no retry ordinal;
6. every `SAFE_ERROR_CODES` entry has a kind;
7. classifying an already-classified failure does not change its meaning.

`digitalmate/entry/src/test/ConnectionCopyBoundary.test.ets` (new, **8 tests**, registered in
`List.test`):

The same rules asserted in the **real ArkTS runtime**, not a type-stripping VM. It needs no account
and no network — every input is a string — so it runs on the device in CI.

## Review findings fixed in this PR

I reviewed this change as a reviewer and found four problems in my own work, plus one in my own
verification method. All are fixed:

1. **Re-classifying already-classified copy changed its meaning** — real, and introduced by this PR.
   `digitalmateUserFacingError` ran the text rules over its own output. `'没有访问该云端资源的权限'`
   matched no rule, fell to `unknown`, and was redrawn as `'云端连接暂不可用，请重试'`: a permission
   failure reported as a connectivity one. Reachable, because the binding sanitises a message
   (`DigitalMateConversationBinding.ets:529`) and then the banner classifies what it is handed
   (`:628`). Fixed by making the classifier idempotent.
2. **A comment claimed a coverage guard that did not exist.** `CODE_KINDS`'s docblock said "a guard
   test fails when a gateway code has no kind"; nothing read `SAFE_ERROR_CODES`. Guard 6 now does.
3. **A doubled semicolon** (`]];;`) left by the `Record`→`Map` rewrite that ArkTS required.
4. **`unknown` and `config` shared near-identical wording**, so a reader could not tell "we cannot
   tell" from "the gateway is misconfigured". `unknown` now says it does not know.
5. **My first device run reported a false pass.** After injecting a defect, the suite still said
   `Failure: 0`, because hvigor skips the test target when nothing it tracks changed and I read the
   previous `test_result.txt`. Both proof runs are now clean (`.test` removed, `hvigor clean`).

## Verification

### Node

`node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs`, both worktrees, same dependency set:

| | tests | pass | fail |
|---|---|---|---|
| baseline `a78b20b1` | 2646 | 2637 | 2 |
| this branch | 2648 | 2639 | 2 |

The same two tests fail on both, and they fail on `main` without this branch: an AGC SMS case and
the pinned WebSocket opcode case. **+7 tests, 0 regressions.** Targeted:
`connection-copy-boundary` 7/7, `gateway-auth-client` 41/41, `gateway-session-store` 126/126,
`digitalmate-connection-ux` 7/7, `digitalmate-adapter` 83/83.

### Device (local emulator, `dm_phone`, `127.0.0.1:5555`)

Clean build of the current tree:

```
hvigor test        -> Tests run: 2310, Failure: 0, Error: 0, Pass: 2310, Ignore: 0
hvigor assembleHap -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL
```

The HAP installs and the app launches. The startup splash shows only the pet and "DigitalMate" and
hands over to the login page — the behaviour the issue asks for on the screen reachable without an
account.

**The device guard is proven to bite.** Injecting `return 'HTTP 502 wss://private.test/ws'` for the
network kind turns exactly two tests red:

```
never lets a transport sentence reach the banner verbatim           -> Failure
shows a classified cause with no address, HTTP status or retry...   -> Failure
Tests run: 2310, Failure: 2, Error: 0, Pass: 2308
```

Restoring the source returns it to `2310 / 0 fail`.

### CI on the pushed head

`node-ut`, `hypium-ut`, `ArkTS Code Check`, `architecture-conformance`, `gate-report` and
`pr-ready` (device ST) are the required checks.

Remote tree sha equals local tree sha, so the branch content is byte-identical to what was tested.

## What this PR deliberately does NOT decide

- **The 8-second startup cap** (`A2uiHome/Index.ets:4759-4761`). The splash is force-closed after
  8s, so a slow handshake cuts to a connection screen. Whether to lengthen it, or to add a
  splash → skeleton → content state machine, is a product call and is not changed here.
- **The degradation strategy** the issue body's decision gate asks for.
- **The English-locale siblings** (#563, #564, #429, #449). Those four all rewrite connection copy in
  different files. With this table in place they should all read from it, in one follow-up, instead
  of being fixed four times.

## Measured A/B

Exact string comparison, not a screenshot: the base commit's `DigitalMateConnectionUx` and this
branch's version, loaded from their own trees and run over 32 inputs (15 transport sentences + 17
gateway strings), each through `digitalmateConnectBanner('closed', …)`.

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| inputs compared | 32 | 32 |
| **leaked infrastructure** | **13** | **0** |
| wording changed | — | 23 |

"Leaked" means the rendered sentence still contained a `wss://` or `https://` address, an
`HTTP \d{3}` status, `/auth/`, `ADX`, `ECONN`, `测试凭据`, the word `Gateway`/`gateway`, a
`DigitalMate 握手…`/`DigitalMate 连接…` internal phrase, or the raw English
`Invalid credential header`.

The characteristic cases:

```
"DigitalMate 握手失败，请检查测试凭据"
  before: "DigitalMate 握手失败，请检查测试凭据"          <- the team talking to itself
  after : "云端连接暂不可用，请重试"

"Invalid credential header"
  before: "Invalid credential header"                    <- raw English, straight through
  after : "云端连接暂不可用，请重试"

"云侧鉴权接口未找到（HTTP 404）。请核对：鉴权入口地址、/auth/* 转发规则，以及 ADX 版本与账号路由是否已启用。"
  before: the whole 64-character operator sentence
  after : "云端连接暂不可用，请重试"
```

The account panel, which used to print `snapshot.message` with no filter at all:

```
  before: "云侧鉴权接口未找到（HTTP 404）。请核对：..."
  after : "云端连接暂不可用，请稍后重试"
```

Retry ordinal, the other half of the issue:

```
attempt=1  before: "正在重新连接云端（第 1 次）…"   after: "正在连接云端…"
attempt=3  before: "正在重新连接云端（第 3 次）…"   after: "正在连接云端…"
attempt=9  before: "正在重新连接云端（第 9 次）…"   after: "正在连接云端…"
```

Six of the 32 inputs already rendered safely before this change, because the old regex happened to
match them - `'DigitalMate 连接异常（1006），请检查地址、网络和测试凭据'` contains `网络`, so it
became `网络不可用，请检查网络后重试`. That is the point: the old design leaked whatever did not
happen to hit a regex, and 13 of 32 did not.

### On the device

The same build, with `app_config.json` pointing at an unreachable gateway
(`wss://127.0.0.1:1/digitalmate/ws`), renders:

```
Beebou 正在恢复云端连接…
连接较慢，仍在努力连接中…          正在连接
连接中，消息将稍后发送…
```

No address, no status code, no credential vocabulary, no retry count — in a real failure state, on
the emulator, not a unit test.

## Screenshots

HarmonyOS emulator `dm_phone` (`127.0.0.1:5555`), this branch's `assembleHap` debug build,
installed with `bm install`. The point of the change is what is **absent** from these images: no
`wss://` address, no `HTTP 404`, no `/auth/*`, no ADX version, no "测试凭据", no retry count.

**Cold start** — the splash the issue's title is about, carrying no connection detail:

![Cold start: only the pet and the product name](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/fix/956-connection-copy-classification/docs/developer_guide/evidence/issue-956-connection-copy-2026-11-10/01-startup-splash.jpeg?raw=true)

**A real connection failure** — `app_config.json` (gitignored, never committed) pointed the gateway
at `wss://127.0.0.1:1/digitalmate/ws`, so the handshake could not complete:

![A real connection failure: no address, no status code, no retry count](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/fix/956-connection-copy-classification/docs/developer_guide/evidence/issue-956-connection-copy-2026-11-10/02-gateway-unreachable-banner.jpeg?raw=true)

**The same failure seconds later** — the copy is unchanged and still counts no attempts, which is
the "retry detail stays off the screen" half of the issue:

![The same failure later: the copy is unchanged and still counts no attempts](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/fix/956-connection-copy-classification/docs/developer_guide/evidence/issue-956-connection-copy-2026-11-10/03-gateway-unreachable-steady.jpeg?raw=true)

The full-resolution originals and a reproduction recipe live in [`docs/developer_guide/evidence/issue-956-connection-copy-2026-11-10`](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/tree/fix/956-connection-copy-classification/docs/developer_guide/evidence/issue-956-connection-copy-2026-11-10).

The account panel and the business-error path need a signed-in session, which needs a reachable
gateway, so no screenshot covers them; the two test suites and the A/B table above do.

Closes #956

## Provenance

Verbatim copy of personal-fork PR [lh913137941/DigitalMate#14](https://github.com/lh913137941/DigitalMate/pull/14), head commit `a6c064c39cf935b36e12b454d93d952d8b097dd5`, pushed unchanged as upstream branch `codex/calendar-p2-lite-20261111` so the device-side slice lives beside its continuation work. The six file blobs are byte-identical to the fork PR head (same commit SHA).

## Known state against current main (read before reviewing)

- The fork base `14249e88a57e7ed57dc4e7c5c9aa518b40676072` is 72 commits behind upstream `main` and predates upstream PR #1082, which reverted the older P1 calendar foundation (`DeviceCalendar.ets` and its permission helpers). This branch therefore **restores the reverted P1 file** and will not merge cleanly into current `main`; resolving that requires a rebase decision, not a mechanical conflict resolution.
- The same author's draft PR #1066 (`codex/calendar-device-bridge`) implements the broader P2 loop on current `main` and **subsumes this slice**. This copy exists as a discrete, reviewable device-side artifact; it is not a competing full implementation.
- Per the fork PR's own scope note: do not use this branch to restore a P1 path that upstream subsequently removed.

## What this slice contains (from the fork PR)

- Shared calendar request/response types, exported through the existing cloud-adapter entry point.
- `DeviceCalendarTool.ets` calls the existing production CalendarKit reader. It validates the task/submission/turn, independently held local grant, expiry, bounded date window and TTL; wire consent alone cannot prompt or query.
- Seven structured response statuses, ISO timestamps, five-field event whitelist, at most 50 sorted/deduplicated events and a bounded UTF-8 response. Unknown date windows never silently become today.
- The shared reader stops subsequent queries after cancellation/revocation. Oversized collection returns `read_failed` instead of claiming an uninspected calendar-order prefix is globally earliest. Exactly 500 collected events still work; the existing stricter aggregate bound is retained.
- Legacy P1 permission-denied guidance remains compatible; the P2 handler maps revocation after I/O began to `cancelled`. Timeout/late-native-result handling is tested.

Three targeted revocation/collection regressions fail on the original reader and pass on this patch. Native ArkTS build, Hypium UT, real-device ST, full repository CI and cloud/provider E2E **not run** for this commit; no GitHub check-runs exist for it.

- [x] Device-side handler, shared types and focused production-source tests.
- [ ] Actual page-owned grant issuance/expiry and authenticated task/connection binding; duplicate/stale-call rejection.

- [ ] Capability negotiation and one explicit old-client fallback; suppress P1 pre-read for admitted P2 submissions; untrusted-title model-result treatment.
